paras.zh: 上一年 SEMA ADAS 展示和 FutureTech Studio 照片由 SEMA 提供

articles.title: Can Your Class Design a Better Way to Get Work Done?
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Your class has been assigned an innovation project.
paras.zh: 你们班被分配了一个创新项目。

paras.en: Nobody has to invent a new vehicle, build a robot or promise to revolutionize transportation by Friday. The challenge is closer to home: improve one routine that makes your school’s shop harder to use.
paras.zh: 没有人必须在周五之前发明一辆新车、制造一个机器人或承诺彻底改变交通运输。挑战就在我们身边：改进一种使学校商店更难使用的惯例。

paras.en: The idea follows a point Jeremy White made during his keynote at the 2026 Schaeffler Automotive Symposium. The WIRED Senior Innovation Editor argued that the most interesting uses of technology come from reconsidering how work is organized, rather than simply fitting a new tool into an existing routine.
paras.zh: 这一想法遵循了杰里米·怀特 (Jeremy White) 在 2026 年舍弗勒汽车研讨会上发表的主题演讲中提出的观点。 《连线》高级创新编辑认为，技术最有趣的用途来自于重新考虑工作的组织方式，而不是简单地将新工具融入现有的日常工作中。

paras.en: Students can test that thinking on something they understand. Tool checkout, parts requests, inspection documentation or project handoffs could all provide manageable subjects. Instructors should select processes students are authorized to examine and keep safety procedures outside the scope of unsupervised changes.
paras.zh: 学生可以用他们理解的东西来测试这种想法。工具检查、零件请求、检查文档或项目移交都可以提供易于管理的主题。教师应选择学生有权检查的流程并将安全程序保留在无人监督的变更范围之外。

paras.en: Begin with observation. Have teams watch how the current process works and talk with the people using it. Where does someone wait? What information is frequently missing? Which step causes confusion? Require a specific problem statement before students propose a solution.
paras.zh: 从观察开始。让团队观察当前流程的运作方式并与使用该流程的人员进行交谈。有人在哪里等？哪些信息经常缺失？哪一步会造成混乱？在学生提出解决方案之前需要先陈述具体的问题。

paras.en: Next, establish a starting measurement. A team examining tool checkout might record how long the process takes or how often a tool’s location is unknown. Students should collect only appropriate information and avoid identifying classmates unnecessarily.
paras.zh: 接下来，建立起始测量。检查工具检查的团队可能会记录该过程需要多长时间或工具位置未知的频率。学生应仅收集适当的信息，并避免不必要地识别同学的身份。

paras.en: Then design a small improvement. Computing might help through a simple form, shared inventory record or spreadsheet. Students could also discover that clearer instructions or a better physical arrangement solves much of the problem. Their job is to justify the choice, including who will maintain it.
paras.zh: 然后设计一个小的改进。计算可能会通过简单的表格、共享库存记录或电子表格来提供帮助。学生们还可能发现，更清晰的指示或更好的物理安排可以解决大部分问题。他们的工作是证明选择的合理性，包括由谁来维持它。

paras.en: An instructor-approved trial provides the next lesson. Does the proposal work when people are busy? Can a new user understand it? What happens when someone enters incomplete information? Teams should document those exceptions and revise their approach.
paras.zh: 教师批准的试验提供了下一课。当人们忙碌时，该提案是否有效？新用户能看懂吗？当有人输入不完整的信息时会发生什么？团队应该记录这些例外情况并修改他们的方法。

paras.en: Finish with a presentation comparing the result with the original measurement. An unsuccessful trial can still earn a strong evaluation if students explain the evidence and what they would change.
paras.zh: 最后进行演示，将结果与原始测量结果进行比较。如果学生解释证据以及他们将改变什么，那么不成功的试验仍然可以获得强有力的评价。

paras.en: This project brings together communication, observation and practical use of information. It also introduces a business reality: an improvement has to work for the people expected to use it.
paras.zh: 该项目汇集了信息的交流、观察和实际使用。它还引入了一个商业现实：改进必须对预期使用它的人有效。

paras.en: This concept invites industries to rethink familiar practices. Your classroom can begin with a process small enough to change and important enough that somebody notices when it gets better.
paras.zh: 这一概念促使行业重新思考熟悉的做法。你的课堂可以从一个小到足以改变、足够重要到当它变得更好时有人注意到的过程开始。

paras.en: And we’d love to hear about it! Share your ideas with me at [email protected]. I’d love to share them with the rest of the Tomorrow’s Technician audience.
paras.zh: 我们很想听听！通过 [email protected] 与我分享您的想法。我很乐意与《明天的技术人员》的其他观众分享它们。

articles.title: Cartridge or Spin-On? Choosing the Right Oil Filter
articles.author: Eric Garbe

paras.en: Some vehicles may use either a spin-on or cartridge-style oil filter. Identifying the correct filter requires a visual inspection, often from underneath the vehicle.
paras.zh: 有些车辆可能使用旋装式或筒式机油滤清器。识别正确的过滤器需要进行目视检查，通常是从车辆下方进行。

paras.en: Counter professionals should alert customers to this possibility and recommend checking the existing filter before purchasing a replacement to avoid ordering the wrong part.
paras.zh: 柜台专业人员应提醒顾客这种可能性，并建议在购买替换件之前检查现有的过滤器，以避免订购错误的部件。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: Shop Profile: Loveland’s A-OK Transmission
articles.author: Bobby Mace

paras.en: “I’m a guy that started from ground zero. I mean, even though dad was running the place, I came in just like any other grunt, and I was expected to work, like any other grunt,” explains Loveland’s A-OK Transmission shop owner John Haines. “And my son is the same way. He’s starting at the bottom, working his way up.”
paras.zh: “我是一个从零开始的人。我的意思是，尽管爸爸在经营这个地方，但我就像其他人一样进来，并且我被期望像其他人一样工作，”拉夫兰的 A-OK Transmission 商店老板约翰·海恩斯 (John Haines) 解释道。 “我的儿子也是这样。他从底层做起，一步步向上。”

paras.en: John’s son, Macen, represents the third generation of his family involved in the shop. But Loveland’s history goes back still further. This business has been in Springfield, Missouri, for more than 50 years.
paras.zh: 约翰的儿子 Macen 是经营这家商店的家族第三代。但拉夫兰的历史可以追溯到更远的地方。这家企业在密苏里州斯普林菲尔德已有 50 多年的历史。

paras.en: “It was started by Don Loveland who retired in the mid-’70s when he sold the business to Amos Alsup, but retained ownership of the building,” John explains. “Dad [Vern Haines] came in in 1989. He started running the business side of things, taking over ownership in 2004. Then, I ran the day-to-day business for the last eight to ten years and took over the ownership role in January of 2025.”
paras.zh: “它是由唐·洛夫兰 (Don Loveland) 创办的，他于 70 年代中期退休，将公司卖给了阿莫斯·阿尔苏普 (Amos Alsup)，但保留了该建筑的所有权，”约翰解释道。 “父亲 [Vern Haines] 于 1989 年上任。他开始负责业务方面的事务，并于 2004 年接管了所有权。然后，我在过去八到十年里负责日常业务，并于 2025 年 1 月接管了所有权角色。”

paras.en: John says some of their favorite work is on classic vehicles that owners entrust to his shop. “We’d had a little bit of a following with some of the car clubs, and I guess word of mouth just kind of took off from there. We do a lot of work for VL Classics in nearby Strafford, Missouri. And of course, anytime they sell a car, if it’s local, they recommend that those customers come here, and we’ve had the opportunity to work on a lot of those cars.
paras.zh: 约翰说，他们最喜欢的一些作品是车主委托给他的商店的经典车辆。 “我们在一些汽车俱乐部中拥有了一些追随者，我想口口相传就是从那里开始的。我们在密苏里州斯特拉福德附近为 VL Classics 做了很多工作。当然，每当他们出售汽车时，如果是本地的，他们会推荐这些客户来这里，我们有机会为很多这样的汽车工作。

paras.en: “These classic cars are their owners’ babies. They want to make sure they’re treated like their baby, and we make sure that everything is righteous with them. We cover the fenders and the doors anytime we’re doing any repair to keep anything from getting scratched or marked up. We do everything we can to keep them protected. When they get returned, they’re as clean or cleaner as when they got here.”
paras.zh: “这些老爷车是车主的孩子。他们希望确保自己像自己的孩子一样受到对待，而我们确保一切都对他们公平。在进行任何维修时，我们都会遮盖挡泥板和车门，以防止任何东西被刮伤或留下痕迹。我们尽一切努力保护它们。当它们被归还时，它们会像到达时一样干净或更干净。”

paras.en: Beyond the classics, Loveland’s is a busy repair shop. “I enjoy the work,” John says. “I would say we just don’t have a typical customer. We’ve got everybody from schoolteachers and soccer moms to a plumber who’s trying to make a living using their van or truck to get to the next jobsite. Many customers are that blue collar crowd, people who have to make a living too.
paras.zh: 除了经典之外，Loveland’s 也是一家繁忙的维修店。 “我喜欢这份工作，”约翰说。 “我想说的是，我们只是没有典型的客户。我们的客户包括从学校老师、足球妈妈到水管工，他们都试图用面包车或卡车前往下一个工作地点谋生。许多客户都是蓝领人群，他们也必须谋生。

paras.en: “We’ve garnered a reputation of being fair on price. I’m not going be the cheapest guy in town by any means, and I’m going to try not to be the most expensive. I’m making sure my work is comparable for the price I’m asking.”
paras.zh: “我们赢得了价格公平的声誉。无论如何，我不会成为城里最便宜的人，而且我会尽量不成为最贵的人。我会确保我的作品与我要的价格相当。”

paras.en: He achieves this in part by taking another step beyond the initial repair.
paras.zh: 他实现这一目标的部分原因是在最初的修复之外采取了另一步骤。

paras.en: “Anytime we have a customer that has a repair, especially a transmission repair, I remind them that after 500-600 miles, I want to see the car back. They don’t have to have an appointment. It doesn’t cost them anything. I just want to check everything over. That tells the customer, we’re not here just to take their money. We want to make sure that the job’s good when they’ve driven a few hundred miles. If there’s a problem, it usually will show up then. It just gives that perceived notion of, ‘well, hey, they’re not just here to take my money and run.’
paras.zh: “每当我们有客户需要维修，尤其是变速箱维修时，我都会提醒他们，在行驶了 500-600 英里后，我想把车送回来。他们不必预约。这不会花费他们任何费用。我只是想检查一下一切。这告诉客户，我们来这里不仅仅是为了拿他们的钱。我们希望确保他们开了几百英里后工作顺利。如果有问题，通常会出现然后它只是给人一种这样的感觉：“好吧，嘿，他们不仅仅是为了拿走我的钱然后逃跑。”

paras.en: “Another thing I do is remind them about service intervals. Let’s face it, the biggest reason why a lot of transmissions fail nowadays is because somebody bought into the myth of you don’t ever have to change the transmission fluid. That’s not the case! A lot of times I’ll tell the customer I’d like to see it back for a fluid change at 25,000 miles just to keep that relationship going because most customers, if they’ve put a transmission in a car, are going to come back to the same shop, especially if it’s going to be for maintenance work on that transmission.
paras.zh: “我做的另一件事是提醒他们注意保养间隔。让我们面对现实吧，现在很多变速箱出现故障的最大原因是因为有人相信你永远不需要更换变速箱油。事实并非如此！很多时候我会告诉客户我希望在行驶 25,000 英里时再次更换变速箱油，只是为了保持这种关系，因为大多数客户，如果他们在汽车中安装了变速箱，他们会回到原来的状态商店，特别是如果要对变速箱进行维护工作。

paras.en: “I’ve done more R&R work as of lately. It’s been a cost-to-benefit analysis thing. Like if someone wants a 700 R4 in a classic Camaro or something like that, I’ll build it for them. TH350s and 400s or C4s and C6s are units that you can’t really get reman anymore. A lot of the later model stuff, the six-, eight- or 10-speeds, we get from reman. By the time I buy the parts and spend the time and labor to build it, I’m money ahead to buy the reman and just put it in. At the end of the day, I come out a little cheaper on the on the build side, plus if something goes wrong with that unit, I’m being paid to fix it.”
paras.zh: “我最近做了更多的 R&R 工作。这是一个成本效益分析的事情。就像如果有人想要一辆 700 R4 的经典科迈罗或类似的东西，我会为他们制造它。TH350 和 400 或 C4 和 C6 是你不能真正再制造的单位。很多后来的模型，六速、八速或 10 速，我们从当我购买零件并花费时间和劳力来建造它时，我已经预付了钱来购买再制造并将其安装起来。最终，我在建造方面会便宜一些，而且如果该装置出现问题，我会得到报酬来修复它。

paras.en: “As for the CVTs, I don’t build those at all. Mainly, I just don’t have the space to keep all the stuff I need to build them properly. I’d go reman on them anytime I can. About the only CVT that I ever put in as a used unit would be a Subaru. I don’t know why, but they just seem to work.”
paras.zh: “至于 CVT，我根本不制造这些。主要是，我没有足够的空间来保存正确制造它们所需的所有东西。只要有可能，我就会对它们进行重新制造。我唯一使用过的 CVT 是斯巴鲁。我不知道为什么，但它们似乎很管用。”

paras.en: Haines goes on to say that about half the jobs going through his bays are general repair work. “I let customers know that we do more than transmissions,” he elaborates. “If your car needs a tune-up, if you just need a headlight put in, we’ll take care of it. We’ll make sure you’re good and going down the road.”
paras.zh: 海恩斯接着说，他的海湾中约有一半的工作是一般维修工作。 “我让客户知道我们所做的不仅仅是传输，”他解释道。 “如果您的汽车需要调整，如果您只需要装上车头灯，我们都会帮您处理。我们会确保您一切顺利，顺利上路。”

paras.en: Finally, John recognizes that training for the six-member staff at the shop is important. He says the shop pays for the classes, room and board for seminars that are within a day’s drive. He adds that anytime one of the local parts houses puts on a training class, the Loveland’s team will be there.
paras.zh: 最后，约翰认识到对商店六名员工的培训非常重要。他说，商店支付一天车程内研讨会的课程、食宿费用。他补充说，每当当地零件公司举办培训班时，拉夫兰的团队都会在那里。

articles.title: DRiV Adds Wagner Brake Caliper Parts
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: DRiV announced the expansion of its Wagner brake caliper portfolio with the addition of 547 new SKUs, bringing the lineup to approximately 1,100 SKUs.
paras.zh: DRiV 宣布扩大其瓦格纳制动卡钳产品组合，新增 547 个 SKU，使产品阵容达到约 1,100 个 SKU。

paras.en: According to DRiV, the expanded coverage includes the 2015 Nissan Altima and 2013 Hyundai Sonata. Wagner says its calipers are 100% new units, and the program requires no core charge or core return.
paras.zh: 据 DRiV 称，扩大的覆盖范围包括 2015 款 Nissan Altima 和 2013 款现代 Sonata。瓦格纳表示，其卡钳是 100% 全新的，并且该计划不需要核心充电或核心返回。

paras.en: “Wagner continues to invest in the categories and coverage areas that matter most to aftermarket customers,” said Joseph Saoud, vice president and general manager for the U.S. and Canada at DRiV. “With 547 new caliper SKUs, we are expanding availability across high-volume vehicle applications while giving customers a 100% new caliper option that helps simplify the repair and replacement process.”
paras.zh: DRiV 美国和加拿大副总裁兼总经理 Joseph Saoud 表示：“瓦格纳继续投资于对售后客户最重要的类别和覆盖领域。” “凭借 547 个新卡钳 SKU，我们正在扩大大批量车辆应用的可用性，同时为客户提供 100% 全新卡钳选项，有助于简化维修和更换流程。”

articles.title: Imitations Have Limitations. Your Reputation Shouldn’t.
articles.author: Litens Aftermarket

paras.en: You’ve been in the bay long enough to know how this plays out. A customer comes back three weeks after a belt job — cabin full of noise, belt shredded, tensioner shot. They’re not thinking about where the parts came from. They’re thinking about who put them in. That’s you.
paras.zh: 你在海湾待了足够长的时间，知道事情会如何发展。一位客户在完成皮带工作三周后回来——机舱里充满了噪音、皮带碎裂、张紧器射击。他们没有考虑零件来自哪里。他们在想是谁把他们放进去的。那就是你。

paras.en: This scenario is playing out more often as imitation overrunning alternator decouplers (OADs) flood the aftermarket. These knockoffs might look the part on the shelf, but under the hood is a completely different story — and the difference shows up fast, in the worst possible way.
paras.zh: 随着仿制超越交流发电机解耦器 (OAD) 充斥售后市场，这种情况越来越频繁地发生。这些仿制品在货架上看起来可能是一样的，但在幕后却是完全不同的故事——而且差异很快就会以最糟糕的方式显现出来。

paras.en: Here’s the bottom line: Litens invented the OAD and holds the original patent on the torsion spring decoupler design — the specific engineering that makes a genuine OAD function the way it’s supposed to.
paras.zh: 底线是这样的：Litens 发明了 OAD，并拥有扭力弹簧解耦器设计的原始专利——使真正的 OAD 发挥应有功能的特定工程。

paras.en: When imitation manufacturers copy a Litens OAD, they’re working from the outside in. They can match the shape, nail the dimensions, and price it to move — but they cannot replicate the patented internal design. The result is a component that might pass a visual inspection but fails the only test that actually counts: in the field, on a customer’s car.
paras.zh: 当仿制品制造商复制 Litens OAD 时，他们是从外到内进行工作的。他们可以匹配形状、确定尺寸并为其移动定价，但他们无法复制获得专利的内部设计。结果是一个组件可能通过了目视检查，但未能通过唯一真正重要的测试：在现场，在客户的汽车上。

paras.en: Every time an engine accelerates, decelerates and even at idle, it generates torsional pulses — constant vibrations that ripple through the serpentine belt and into every component connected to it. Left unchecked, those pulses create NVH complaints and chew through belts, tensioners, and entire alternators ahead of schedule.
paras.zh: 每当发动机加速、减速，甚至怠速时，它都会产生扭转脉冲——持续的振动，通过蛇形皮带传递到与之相连的每个部件。如果不加以控制，这些脉冲会导致 NVH 投诉，并提前磨损皮带、张紧器和整个交流发电机。

paras.en: The patented Litens torsion spring design absorbs those pulses before they become a problem. By decoupling the alternator rotor from the pulley during decel and cushioning the transition to acceleration, it smooths the load on the belt and tensioner at every revolution. The results are straightforward: quieter operation from the first cold start, and belt and tensioner life that can last up to twice as long as systems without a properly functioning decoupler.
paras.zh: 获得专利的莱顿扭转弹簧设计可以在这些脉冲成为问题之前吸收它们。通过在减速期间将交流发电机转子与皮带轮分离并缓冲加速过渡，它可以在每次旋转时平滑皮带和张紧器上的负载。结果很简单：第一次冷启动时运行更安静，皮带和张紧器的使用寿命比没有正常工作的解耦器的系统长两倍。

paras.en: That’s a repair that holds up long after the customer stops thinking about it.
paras.zh: 这种修复在客户不再考虑它之后仍能持续很长时间。

paras.en: A cheap OAD might save a few bucks at the counter. But when it fails — and imitation units do fail — the math turns ugly fast. You’re looking at a comeback repair, a lost afternoon, and a customer telling everyone at their workplace to go somewhere else next time.
paras.zh: 在柜台购买便宜的 OAD 可能会节省几美元。但当它失败时——而且仿制品确实失败了——数学很快就会变得丑陋。你看到的是一次修复、一个失落的下午，以及一位顾客告诉工作场所的每个人下次去其他地方。

paras.en: In a trade built on word-of-mouth, your name is your most valuable tool. Every part you install either backs that up or puts it on the line.
paras.zh: 在建立在口碑之上的行业中，您的名字是您最有价值的工具。您安装的每个部件要么支持该功能，要么将其投入使用。

paras.en: Drop-In Fit. Original Design. Original Manufacturer.
paras.zh: 插入式贴合。原创设计。原始制造商。

paras.en: Litens OADs install as direct replacements for the standard alternator pulley — no modifications, no adapter, no guesswork. You’re bolting in the component the system was engineered around, built by the same company that holds the patent on it.
paras.zh: Litens OAD 安装后可直接替代标准交流发电机皮带轮 — 无需修改、无需适配器、无需猜测。你用螺栓固定系统设计的组件，该组件是由拥有该系统专利的同一家公司制造的。

paras.en: Knockoffs will keep showing up at the counter, priced to move. But they’re not built to the same spec, and when they fail, it’s your name that takes the hit — not theirs.
paras.zh: 仿冒品将不断出现在柜台上，价格也会变动。但它们并不是按照相同的规格构建的，当它们失败时，受到打击的是您的名字，而不是他们的名字。

paras.en: The comeback is never worth it. The genuine part always is.
paras.zh: 卷土重来永远不值得。真正的部分总是如此。

paras.en: Learn more about Litens OADs and find the right part for your application at
paras.zh: 了解有关 Litens OAD 的更多信息并找到适合您的应用的部件：

articles.title: Can R-444A Help Your Shop Lower AC Costs?
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Every refrigerant change brings another round of questions for shop owners. What equipment do we need? What will it cost? How much training is involved? And how does the investment translate into better service for customers?
paras.zh: 每次制冷剂的更换都会给店主带来新一轮的问题。我们需要什么设备？费用是多少？涉及多少培训？投资如何转化为为客户提供更好的服务？

paras.en: In this episode of Shop Owner Solutions, presented by Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials, we discuss another option: Klea Edge R-444A, which Orbia has positioned as an aftermarket alternative to R-1234yf.
paras.zh: 在 Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials 推出的本期店主解决方案中，我们讨论了另一种选择：Klea Edge R-444A，Orbia 将其定位为 R-1234yf 的售后替代品。

paras.en: Joining the conversation are Chuck Abbott, Orbia’s global marketing manager, and Wade Pugh, owner of Wade’s Fixit Shop. Chuck explains the product’s reported performance and cost advantages, while Wade brings the discussion into the bay with firsthand experience retrofitting vehicles at his shop.
paras.zh: 加入对话的还有 Orbia 全球营销经理 Chuck Abbott 和 Wade’s Fixit Shop 老板 Wade Pugh。查克解释了该产品所报告的性能和成本优势，而韦德则通过在他的商店改装车辆的第一手经验将讨论带入海湾。

paras.en: The conversation moves beyond refrigerant chemistry to the details that affect daily operations: equipment requirements, service time, technician preparation and the potential impact on the shop’s bottom line. They also address retrofit procedures, service fittings, labeling, cross-contamination prevention and safety considerations.
paras.zh: 讨论超越了制冷剂化学，涉及到影响日常运营的细节：设备要求、服务时间、技术人员准备以及对车间利润的潜在影响。它们还涉及改造程序、维修配件、标签、交叉污染预防和安全注意事项。

paras.en: For owners evaluating their next AC equipment purchase, or looking for additional ways to serve customers, those details are important. Understanding an alternative starts with knowing what the work actually involves.
paras.zh: 对于评估下一次购买空调设备或寻找其他方式为客户提供服务的业主来说，这些细节非常重要。了解替代方案首先要了解工作实际涉及的内容。

paras.en: Watch the episode above for a practical conversation about R-444A and what shop owners should consider before bringing it into their AC service business.
paras.zh: 观看上面的剧集，了解有关 R-444A 的实用对话，以及店主在将其引入空调服务业务之前应考虑的事项。

articles.title: NAPA Apprentice Program Builds a New Path Into the Service Bay
articles.author: NAPA

paras.en: As repair shops across the country struggle to recruit qualified technicians, the NAPA Auto Care Apprentice Program offers participating businesses a structured way to develop new talent inside their own service bays.
paras.zh: 由于全国各地的维修店都在努力招募合格的技术人员，NAPA 汽车护理学徒计划为参与的企业提供了一种结构化的方法，以在自己的维修站内培养新人才。

paras.en: More than 700 NAPA Auto Care centers nationwide participate in the program, which combines technical education, hands-on experience and mentorship. Its mission is to educate and cultivate the next generation of automotive repair professionals by providing a broad learning experience that combines online and classroom training.
paras.zh: 全国 700 多个 NAPA 汽车护理中心参与了该计划，该计划结合了技术教育、实践经验和指导。其使命是通过提供结合在线和课堂培训的广泛学习经验来教育和培养下一代汽车维修专业人员。

paras.en: For shop owners, the program offers an alternative to waiting for experienced technicians to appear in an increasingly competitive labor market. A participating shop can identify someone with the right attitude and work ethic, then help that person build technical skills through a defined training path.
paras.zh: 对于店主来说，该计划提供了一种替代方案，让他们无需等待经验丰富的技术人员出现在竞争日益激烈的劳动力市场中。参与的商店可以识别具有正确态度和职业道德的人员，然后通过明确的培训路径帮助该人员培养技术技能。

paras.en: “NAPA is committed to finding solutions that address the national shortage of skilled automotive technicians,” said Jason Rainey, vice president of Auto Care. “Our apprenticeship program is one of several key NAPA initiatives that help pave the way for young people to launch long and fruitful careers in our industry.”
paras.zh: Auto Care 副总裁 Jason Rainey 表示：“NAPA 致力于寻找解决方案，解决全国熟练汽车技术人员短缺的问题。” “我们的学徒计划是 NAPA 的几项关键举措之一，有助于为年轻人在我们行业开展长期且富有成果的职业生涯铺平道路。”

paras.en: The NAPA Apprentice Program uses a nine-stage curriculum designed to give participants a broad understanding of the systems and components found on modern vehicles. Most apprentices can complete the program in two years or less.
paras.zh: NAPA 学徒计划采用九阶段课程，旨在让参与者广泛了解现代车辆上的系统和组件。大多数学徒可以在两年或更短的时间内完成该计划。

paras.en: However, the curriculum is competency-based rather than tied strictly to a calendar. Apprentices can progress through each stage at a pace that matches their learning style and demonstrated abilities. A participant who quickly masters a subject can move forward, while someone who needs additional practice can spend more time developing that competency.
paras.zh: 然而，课程是基于能力的，而不是严格与日历挂钩。学徒可以按照与他们的学习风格和能力相匹配的速度完成每个阶段。快速掌握某一主题的参与者可以继续前进，而需要额外练习的参与者可以花更多的时间来发展该能力。

paras.en: Training is 100% technical and is delivered through several formats:
paras.zh: 培训 100% 是技术性的，并通过多种形式提供：

paras.en: - Classroom training videos exclusive to the Apprentice Program provide in-depth instruction from experienced master technicians.
paras.zh: - 学徒计划独有的课堂培训视频提供经验丰富的技术大师的深入指导。

paras.en: - NAPA Autotech classes offer instructor-led training taught by experienced ASE Master Certified instructors.
paras.zh: - NAPA Autotech 课程提供由经验丰富的 ASE 大师认证讲师授课的讲师指导培训。

paras.en: - Autotech eLearning provides web-based instruction targeting specific systems, procedures and diagnostic topics.
paras.zh: - Autotech eLearning 提供针对特定系统、程序和诊断主题的基于网络的指导。

paras.en: - Hands-on training allows apprentices to apply what they have learned while working in the shop under the guidance of a mentor.
paras.zh: - 实践培训允许学徒在导师的指导下在商店工作时运用所学知识。

paras.en: This combination helps connect classroom theory with real repairs. Apprentices do not just learn how a component operates; they also gain experience inspecting, testing and servicing that component on vehicles.
paras.zh: 这种结合有助于将课堂理论与实际维修联系起来。学徒不仅要学习组件的工作原理，还要学习组件的工作原理。他们还获得了检查、测试和维修车辆部件的经验。

paras.en: The curriculum will continue to evolve as vehicle technology and industry standards change. Planned enhancements include updated training modules and specialized certification options covering emerging service areas, giving apprentices additional opportunities for career advancement.
paras.zh: 随着车辆技术和行业标准的变化，课程将不断发展。计划的增强功能包括更新的培训模块和涵盖新兴服务领域的专业认证选项，为学徒提供更多的职业发展机会。

paras.en: Apprentices earn the work experience requirement for three Automotive Service Excellence certifications as they advance through the program: Maintenance and Light Repair (G1), Suspension and Steering (A4), and Brakes (A5). They also gain the practical know-how to pass the EPA Section 609 refrigerant recovery and recycling credential test administered through ASE.
paras.zh: 学徒在完成该计划时将获得三项卓越汽车服务认证的工作经验要求：维护和轻型维修 (G1)、悬架和转向 (A4) 以及制动器 (A5)。他们还获得了通过 ASE 管理的 EPA 第 609 节制冷剂回收和再循环证书测试的实用知识。

paras.en: That distinction is important: G1, A4 and A5 are ASE professional certifications, while Section 609 is an EPA-required credential for technicians who service motor-vehicle air-conditioning systems. Together, these credentials provide outside validation of the knowledge and skills developed during the apprenticeship.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要：G1、A4 和 A5 是 ASE 专业认证，而第 609 条是 EPA 要求的维修机动车辆空调系统的技术人员的证书。这些证书共同为学徒期间开发的知识和技能提供了外部验证。

paras.en: Because the program is registered with the U.S. Department of Labor, graduates also finish with a nationally recognized journey-level credential in automotive repair. This gives apprentices evidence of completing a structured combination of education and supervised on-the-job training.
paras.zh: 由于该项目已在美国劳工部注册，因此毕业生还可以获得全国认可的汽车维修旅程级证书。这为学徒提供了完成教育和监督在职培训的结构化组合的证据。

paras.en: The program provides the curriculum and training materials, but its success inside a repair facility depends heavily on the shop’s involvement. An apprentice needs an experienced technician who can explain procedures, demonstrate good work habits, supervise repairs and provide constructive feedback.
paras.zh: 该计划提供课程和培训材料，但其在维修厂内的成功在很大程度上取决于商店的参与。学徒需要经验丰富的技术人员来解释程序、展示良好的工作习惯、监督维修并提供建设性反馈。

paras.en: “We need their mentorship, their participation,” said Hannah Klausman, account marketing manager for Auto Care. “We want to support them by providing the materials for their technicians to go through this program, but we need their buy-in by having them provide a mentor and really put their time into taking a chance on these new technicians.”
paras.zh: “我们需要他们的指导和参与，”汽车护理公司客户营销经理汉娜·克劳斯曼 (Hannah Klausman) 说。 “我们希望通过为他们的技术人员提供完成该计划的材料来支持他们，但我们需要他们的支持，让他们提供导师，并真正投入时间来为这些新技术人员提供机会。”

paras.en: For a shop owner, that requires a real commitment. Mentoring can temporarily affect the productivity of an experienced technician, especially during an apprentice’s first months. The potential return is a technician trained around the shop’s procedures, quality standards and culture.
paras.zh: 对于店主来说，这需要真正的承诺。指导可能会暂时影响经验丰富的技术人员的工作效率，尤其是在学徒的头几个月。潜在的回报是一名接受过工厂程序、质量标准和文化培训的技术人员。

paras.en: The program can also create a clearer career ladder. Instead of hiring someone as an entry-level employee with no defined next step, a shop can show the apprentice how training, demonstrated competencies and certifications lead to greater responsibilities.
paras.zh: 该计划还可以创建更清晰的职业阶梯。商店可以向学徒展示培训、展示的能力和认证如何带来更大的责任，而不是雇用某人作为没有明确下一步的入门级员工。

paras.en: “The success of the apprentice program is a reflection not only of the investment NAPA has made but also of its collaboration with Auto Care centers across the country,” said Ryan Ouellette, director of strategic accounts at NAPA. “We are committed to developing future professionals at NAPA, and we look forward to continuing to educate and support the talent in the industry.”
paras.zh: NAPA 战略客户总监 Ryan Ouellette 表示：“学徒计划的成功不仅反映了 NAPA 的投资，也反映了其与全国各地汽车护理中心的合作。” “我们致力于在 NAPA 培养未来的专业人士，我们期待继续教育和支持该行业的人才。”

paras.en: Applicants must be at least 17 years old. Applicants who are 17 require written parental consent, and there is no maximum age.
paras.zh: 申请人必须年满 17 岁。年满 17 岁的申请人需要获得父母的书面同意，并且没有最高年龄限制。

paras.en: Previous professional repair experience is not the program’s defining qualification. Shops should look for candidates who have a positive attitude, arrive ready to work and take initiative beyond their assigned tasks.
paras.zh: 以前的专业维修经验并不是该计划的定义资格。商店应该寻找态度积极、做好工作准备、主动超越分配任务的候选人。

paras.en: Successful apprentices must also be able to build relationships. Automotive repair is increasingly collaborative, particularly when diagnostic information, specialized equipment and technical knowledge must be shared among technicians. An apprentice must be willing to ask questions, accept coaching and learn from the people around them.
paras.zh: 成功的学徒还必须能够建立关系。汽车维修的协作性日益增强，特别是当技术人员必须共享诊断信息、专业设备和技术知识时。学徒必须愿意提出问题、接受指导并向周围的人学习。

paras.en: Most importantly, candidates need to embrace continuous learning. Vehicle technology does not stand still, and neither can a technician’s education.
paras.zh: 最重要的是，候选人需要接受持续学习。汽车技术不会停滞不前，技术人员的教育也不会停滞不前。

paras.en: For aspiring technicians, the program provides an opportunity to learn the trade without taking on the expense of a traditional trade-school program. Apprentices receive a paycheck while learning in an operating repair facility, and the training itself is provided at no cost to the participant.
paras.zh: 对于有抱负的技术人员来说，该计划提供了学习该行业的机会，而无需承担传统职业学校计划的费用。学徒在运营的维修设施中学习时可以获得薪水，并且培训本身是免费向参与者提供的。

paras.en: Additional information about the program is available at NAPA Auto Care Training.
paras.zh: 有关该计划的更多信息，请访问 NAPA 汽车护理培训。

paras.en: Sidebar: Addressing the Cost of a Technician’s First Tools
paras.zh: 侧边栏：解决技术人员第一个工具的成本问题

paras.en: Tools represent one of the largest entry barriers for a new automotive technician. Even a basic professional set can require a substantial investment before the technician earns a full professional wage.
paras.zh: 工具是新汽车技术人员最大的进入障碍之一。即使是基本的专业设置也可能需要大量投资才能使技术人员获得全额专业工资。

paras.en: To help address that barrier, Carlyle Tools developed an Apprentice Set containing professional-quality tools considered essential for a new technician’s career. NAPA Auto Care makes the exclusive set, which has a stated retail value of $6,566, available for participating Auto Care centers to purchase for their apprentices.
paras.zh: 为了帮助解决这一障碍，凯雷工具开发了一套学徒套装，其中包含被认为对新技术人员职业生涯至关重要的专业品质工具。 NAPA Auto Care 生产了这套独家套装，标称零售价为 6,566 美元，可供参与的汽车护理中心为学徒购买。

paras.en: Providing or helping finance an appropriate starter set can make a shop’s apprenticeship opportunity more attractive. It also helps ensure that the apprentice begins with tools capable of withstanding daily professional use.
paras.zh: 提供或帮助资助合适的入门套件可以使商店的学徒机会更具吸引力。它还有助于确保学徒从能够承受日常专业使用的工具开始。

articles.title: Autel Drives a New Era in A/C Diagnostics
articles.author: Autel

paras.en: An A/C complaint used to mean an uncomfortable customer. On a vehicle whose thermal system also helps cool batteries, power electronics and other critical components, it can mean compromised performance—or a vehicle that cannot complete the trip. The responsibility has changed. Gary DeLuca believes the industry’s approach to diagnosing the system is overdue for a change, too.
paras.zh: 空调投诉过去意味着顾客感到不舒服。对于热系统还有助于冷却电池、电力电子设备和其他关键部件的车辆来说，这可能意味着性能受损，或者车辆无法完成行程。责任变了。加里·德卢卡 (Gary DeLuca) 认为，行业诊断系统的方法也早就该改变了。

paras.en: Autel is taking on that challenge with the new MaxiHVAC AC909 Advanced A/C Diagnostic System and a full day of advanced HVAC and thermal-management training on Friday, October 30, in Port Washington, New York. For technicians and educators, the event offers a rare opportunity to learn directly from DeLuca, the Autel U.S. founder who spearheaded the tool’s development, and understand the diagnostic strategy behind it. Join Autel’s advanced HVAC training October 30, 8 a.m.–6 p.m., at the Hilton Garden Inn Roslyn in Port Washington, NY. Tickets are $249, including meals. Seating is limited. Register at autel.cc/hvac-training-ny.
paras.zh: Autel 将于 10 月 30 日星期五在纽约华盛顿港通过全新 MaxiHVAC AC909 高级空调诊断系统以及一整天的高级 HVAC 和热管理培训来迎接这一挑战。对于技术人员和教育工作者来说，此次活动提供了一个难得的机会，可以直接向该工具开发的 Autel 美国创始人 DeLuca 学习，并了解其背后的诊断策略。参加 Autel 于 10 月 30 日上午 8 点至下午 6 点在纽约州华盛顿港罗斯林希尔顿花园酒店举办的高级 HVAC 培训。票价249美元，含餐。座位有限。请在 autel.cc/hvac-training-ny 上注册。

paras.en: “The training and the testing equipment needed to properly diagnose these HVAC, now thermal-management systems have not kept up with the technology over the last 25 years,” DeLuca said.
paras.zh: “正确诊断这些 HVAC 所需的培训和测试设备，现在的热管理系统在过去 25 年里已经跟不上技术的发展了，”DeLuca 说。

paras.en: For a technician facing a difficult cooling complaint, that gap means more time spent trying to reconcile gauge readings, scan data and component behavior. For a shop owner, it can mean an unresolved repair, another comeback or advanced work leaving the shop. Autel’s answer is to bring the precision and diagnostic discipline of commercial HVAC into automotive service—and put the technician’s understanding of the system at the center of the process.
paras.zh: 对于面临棘手的冷却投诉的技术人员来说，这种差距意味着需要花费更多时间来协调仪表读数、扫描数据和组件行为。对于店主来说，这可能意味着未解决的维修、再次卷土重来或高级工作离开店。 Autel 的答案是将商用 HVAC 的精确性和诊断原理引入汽车服务中，并将技术人员对系统的理解置于流程的中心。

paras.en: This is familiar territory for Autel. The company has built a history of industry disruption by challenging established ways of working and putting more capability into technicians’ hands. Its TPMS tools have simplified sensor programming and relearns. Its diagnostic tablets have expanded independent shops’ access to vehicle information and testing. Its camera-based ADAS positioning systems have brought guided optical measurement to the demanding work of calibration setup. Each advancement has helped shops take on increasingly complex service with greater confidence.
paras.zh: 这是 Autel 熟悉的领域。该公司通过挑战既定的工作方式并将更多能力交给技术人员，创造了行业颠覆的历史。其 TPMS 工具简化了传感器编程和重新学习。其诊断平板电脑扩大了独立商店获取车辆信息和测试的范围。其基于摄像头的 ADAS 定位系统将引导光学测量带入了要求严格的校准设置工作中。每一项进步都帮助商店更有信心地承担日益复杂的服务。

paras.en: DeLuca has been part of that work throughout. He led Autel U.S. through its formative years and has contributed his repair and teaching experience to the engineering and development of Autel’s tools and diagnostic tablets. His understanding of what happens in the bay has helped shape what those tools test, how they present information and how they guide the technician toward a repair decision.
paras.zh: 德卢卡自始至终都参与了这项工作。他领导 Autel 美国公司度过了其形成时期，并将他的维修和教学经验贡献给了 Autel 工具和诊断平板电脑的工程和开发。他对海湾中发生的情况的了解有助于确定这些工具的测试内容、它们如何呈现信息以及它们如何指导技术人员做出维修决策。

paras.en: DeLuca first crossed paths with Autel’s future global leadership at industry events and trade shows and began working with them to develop products built around technicians’ real-world needs. The company’s beginnings were modest: Autel U.S. launched in 2011 with a handful of employees. DeLuca helped build that operation into a growing diagnostic-tool company, grounding its development in the needs of working technicians.
paras.zh: DeLuca 首次在行业活动和贸易展览中与 Autel 未来的全球领导层相遇，并开始与他们合作开发围绕技术人员实际需求的产品。该公司成立之初并不起眼：Autel U.S. 于 2011 年成立，当时只有少数员工。德卢卡帮助将该公司打造成一家不断发展的诊断工具公司，将其发展立足于工作技术人员的需求。

paras.en: His own foundation was the repair shop. DeLuca began working in his father’s shop at age 12, earned an Automotive Technology degree from Morrisville College, and spent more than 40 years as a shop owner and trainer. With more than 50 years of automotive repair and education experience, including A/C and commercial HVAC, he brings both technical knowledge and a teacher’s determination to make it useful.
paras.zh: 他自己的基金会是修理厂。 DeLuca 12 岁时开始在父亲的商店工作，在莫里斯维尔学院获得汽车技术学位，并担任商店老板和培训师超过 40 年。他拥有 50 多年的汽车维修和教育经验，包括空调和商用暖通空调，他带来了技术知识和教师使其有用的决心。

paras.en: “At my core, I am a teacher and an educator. My success is based on change, and if we don’t change, we are not going to go forward,” said DeLuca.
paras.zh: “从本质上讲，我是一名教师和教育家。我的成功基于变革，如果我们不变革，我们就不会前进，”德卢卡说。

paras.en: That outlook drove the AC909 from initial concept through the development of a functioning system. Technicians were telling DeLuca they needed help finding the cause of difficult complaints, locating leaks and reducing comebacks. Meanwhile, the systems themselves were becoming more demanding: variable-displacement and electric compressors, electronically controlled expansion valves, chillers, heat exchangers and multiple thermal circuits. Depending on the vehicle, thermal management can serve the cabin, battery, inverter, drive motor and heat-sensitive electronics.
paras.zh: 这种前景推动了 AC909 从最初的概念到功能系统的开发。技术人员告诉德卢卡，他们需要帮助找到棘手投诉的原因、定位泄漏并减少问题再次发生。与此同时，系统本身的要求也变得越来越高：可变排量和电动压缩机、电控膨胀阀、冷水机、热交换器和多个热回路。根据车辆的不同，热管理可以服务于驾驶室、电池、逆变器、驱动电机和热敏电子设备。

paras.en: “A complete professional A/C service goes far beyond refrigerant removal, recycling and recharging,” DeLuca said. Refrigerant-handling equipment performs an essential service function. Finding the cause of a performance problem requires another level of investigation: understanding how pressures, temperatures, airflow and electronic controls affect one another. That is the diagnostic skill Autel set out to strengthen with the AC909.
paras.zh: “完整的专业空调服务远远超出了制冷剂去除、回收和充电的范围，”德卢卡说。制冷剂处理设备执行基本的服务功能。查找性能问题的原因需要进行另一层次的调查：了解压力、温度、气流和电子控制如何相互影响。这就是 Autel 打算通过 AC909 来加强的诊断技能。

paras.en: A compressor may be underperforming because of an internal fault, an electrical problem or the command it is receiving. A cabin cooling complaint may involve airflow or blend-door operation even when the refrigerant circuit is functioning. The technician needs to see both what the vehicle is asking the system to do and what the system is actually doing. The AC909 connects those two sides of the diagnosis.
paras.zh: 压缩机可能由于内部故障、电气问题或其接收的命令而表现不佳。即使制冷剂回路正在运行，机舱冷却投诉也可能涉及气流或混合门操作。技术人员需要了解车辆要求系统做什么以及系统实际在做什么。 AC909 连接了诊断的这两个方面。

paras.en: The AC909 was developed to give technicians the measurements and system insight needed to make those decisions. Refrigerant pressures, temperatures, humidity and other physical measurements appear alongside supported vehicle diagnostic data on a single graphical analysis screen. Illustrated procedures and dedicated component tests help technicians evaluate operation, isolate faults and verify the repair. The approach pairs guided testing with the information technicians need to understand why a result matters and what to investigate next.
paras.zh: AC909 的开发目的是为技术人员提供做出这些决策所需的测量和系统洞察力。制冷剂压力、温度、湿度和其他物理测量值与支持的车辆诊断数据一起显示在单个图形分析屏幕上。图示程序和专用组件测试可帮助技术人员评估操作、隔离故障并验证修复情况。该方法将引导测试与信息技术人员配对，以了解结果为何重要以及接下来要调查的内容。

paras.en: DeLuca’s strategy considers four connected areas: the electrical, refrigerant, air and coolant loops. That means checking vehicle modules for trouble codes and relevant live data, evaluating refrigerant-system efficiency, verifying airflow and blend-door operation, and considering coolant temperatures and operating conditions where applicable.
paras.zh: DeLuca 的战略考虑了四个互联领域：电力、制冷剂、空气和冷却剂回路。这意味着检查车辆模块的故障代码和相关实时数据，评估制冷剂系统效率，验证气流和混合门操作，并在适用的情况下考虑冷却剂温度和操作条件。

paras.en: The AC909D package also brings commercial HVAC testing practices into the automotive workflow. A Bluetooth-enabled NAVAC vacuum pump and digital micron gauge provide live vacuum measurements on the tablet. Micron measurement and decay testing give technicians a measurable basis for evaluating evacuation and system readiness. Nitrogen and forming gas testing accurately support leak diagnosis before charging.
paras.zh: AC909D 套件还将商业 HVAC 测试实践引入汽车工作流程。支持蓝牙的 NAVAC 真空泵和数字微米计可在平板电脑上提供实时真空测量。微米测量和衰减测试为技术人员评估疏散和系统准备情况提供了可测量的基础。氮气和合成气体测试可准确支持充电前的泄漏诊断。

paras.en: The goal is a repair process technicians can follow from the initial complaint through final verification. For shop owners, that means an opportunity to reduce unnecessary parts replacement and repeated labor, use refrigerant more carefully and equip their teams to retain more demanding thermal-management work.
paras.zh: 目标是技术人员可以遵循从最初投诉到最终验证的维修流程。对于店主来说，这意味着有机会减少不必要的零件更换和重复劳动，更谨慎地使用制冷剂，并让他们的团队能够完成要求更高的热管理工作。

paras.en: The response has reinforced the need for training. DeLuca describes interest in the AC909 as “phenomenal,” with technicians and college instructors traveling from across the country to attend. In evaluations at Pittsburg State University, faculty and students benchmarked properly operating systems and tested vehicles with poor A/C performance. Scott Norman, professor and Automotive Technology Program Coordinator, described the AC909 as “like going from DOS to Windows” and “a huge game changer in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: 这一反应强化了培训的必要性。 DeLuca 形容人们对 AC909 的兴趣是“非凡的”，技术人员和大学讲师从全国各地赶来参加。在匹兹堡州立大学的评估中，教师和学生对正确的操作系统进行了基准测试，并测试了空调性能较差的车辆。教授兼汽车技术项目协调员 Scott Norman 将 AC909 描述为“就像从 DOS 到 Windows”和“汽车行业的巨大游戏规则改变者”。

paras.en: On October 30, DeLuca will teach the approach behind that change. The program will cover vehicle data and physical measurements, pressure and temperature relationships, humidity analysis, component testing, new leak-detection techniques, and thermal-management strategies for conventional vehicles, hybrids and EVs, including heat pumps.
paras.zh: 10 月 30 日，DeLuca 将教授这一变革背后的方法。该计划将涵盖传统车辆、混合动力汽车和电动汽车（包括热泵）的车辆数据和物理测量、压力和温度关系、湿度分析、部件测试、新泄漏检测技术以及热管理策略。

paras.en: That same emphasis on understanding will guide the training. Attendees will learn how to connect a test result to system behavior and a repair decision. For DeLuca, restoring the diagnostic discipline of A/C service and preparing technicians for modern thermal management are part of the same job: teaching people to measure, analyze, repair and verify with confidence.
paras.zh: 同样强调理解也将指导培训。与会者将学习如何将测试结果与系统行为和修复决策联系起来。对于德卢卡来说，恢复空调服务的诊断规则和为现代热管理技术人员做好准备是同一项工作的一部分：教人们自信地测量、分析、维修和验证。

paras.en: “This event will start the new era of change,” he said.
paras.zh: “这一事件将开启变革的新时代，”他说。

paras.en: For an industry already experiencing that change in its service bays, Autel is bringing the tool, the strategy and the people behind its development together in one room.
paras.zh: 对于一个已经在服务区经历这种变化的行业来说，Autel 正在将其开发背后的工具、战略和人员聚集在一个房间里。

paras.en: The training runs from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. in the Grand Ballroom at the Hilton Garden Inn Roslyn, 3 Harbor Park Drive, Port Washington, New York. Tickets are $249 and include continental breakfast, snacks and lunch. Seating is limited. A discounted hotel rate is available using group code “Autel.” Register here. For AC909D details, visit autel.us/product/maxihvac-ac909.
paras.zh: 培训时间为上午8点至下午6点。位于纽约州华盛顿港海港公园大道 3 号罗斯林希尔顿花园酒店的大宴会厅。票价为 249 美元，包括欧陆式早餐、小吃和午餐。座位有限。使用团体代码“Autel”可享受酒店折扣价。在这里注册。有关 AC909D 的详细信息，请访问 autel.us/product/maxihvac-ac909。

articles.title: DRiV Adds Wagner Brake Caliper Parts
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: DRiV announced the expansion of its Wagner brake caliper portfolio with the addition of 547 new SKUs, bringing the lineup to approximately 1,100 SKUs.
paras.zh: DRiV 宣布扩大其瓦格纳制动卡钳产品组合，新增 547 个 SKU，使产品阵容达到约 1,100 个 SKU。

paras.en: According to DRiV, the expanded coverage includes these vehicle applications:
paras.zh: 据 DRiV 称，扩大的覆盖范围包括以下车辆应用：

paras.en: Wagner says its calipers are 100% new units, and the program requires no core charge or core return.
paras.zh: 瓦格纳表示，其卡钳是 100% 全新的，并且该计划不需要核心充电或核心返回。

paras.en: “Wagner continues to invest in the categories and coverage areas that matter most to aftermarket customers,” said Joseph Saoud, vice president and general manager for the U.S. and Canada at DRiV. “With 547 new caliper SKUs, we are expanding availability across high-volume vehicle applications while giving customers a 100% new caliper option that helps simplify the repair and replacement process.”
paras.zh: DRiV 美国和加拿大副总裁兼总经理 Joseph Saoud 表示：“瓦格纳继续投资于对售后客户最重要的类别和覆盖领域。” “凭借 547 个新卡钳 SKU，我们正在扩大大批量车辆应用的可用性，同时为客户提供 100% 全新卡钳选项，有助于简化维修和更换流程。”

articles.title: AUMOVIO, Chery Partner to Localize European Auto Production
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Technology company AUMOVIO and Chinese automotive manufacturer Chery are joining forces to support the establishment of Chery’s automotive production in Europe. AUMOVIO will contribute its overall portfolio, R&D capabilities, and European production network to support localized development, industrialization, and manufacturing in selected projects.
paras.zh: 科技公司 AUMOVIO 和中国汽车制造商奇瑞正在联手支持奇瑞在欧洲建立汽车生产基地。 AUMOVIO将贡献其整体产品组合、研发能力和欧洲生产网络，支持选定项目的本地化开发、工业化和制造。

paras.en: This cooperation is part of Chery’s “Joint Initiative to Build a Sustainable Automotive Supply Chain in Europe” with different suppliers, which was launched at the Paris Motor Show. Chery and AUMOVIO have been working together in the Chinese market for more than 25 years, with AUMOVIO supplying brake systems, electronic control units, active and passive safety systems, sensors, and displays for a broad variety of car models. As a first step, Chery has nominated AUMOVIO to supply airbag control units for its European-produced models, which will be locally manufactured in European plants.
paras.zh: 此次合作是奇瑞与不同供应商在巴黎车展上启动的“欧洲可持续汽车供应链联合倡议”的一部分。奇瑞与AUMOVIO在中国市场的合作已超过25年，AUMOVIO为多种车型提供制动系统、电子控制单元、主被动安全系统、传感器和显示器。作为第一步，奇瑞已指定 AUMOVIO 为其欧洲生产的车型提供安全气囊控制单元，该车型将在欧洲工厂本地生产。

paras.en: “Chery is one of the fastest growing automotive companies, not only in China, but also globally. This collaboration opens a new chapter in our long-standing partnership, which we are extending from China to Europe,” said Philipp von Hirschheydt, CEO of AUMOVIO. “For the first time, we are working with a Chinese automotive manufacturer to build up and grow its European operations. Thanks to our global R&D and manufacturing network, we have the expertise to develop and manufacture in virtually all key regions worldwide.”
paras.zh: AUMOVIO 首席执行官 Philipp von Hirschheydt 表示：“奇瑞是中国乃至全球发展最快的汽车公司之一。此次合作开启了我们长期合作伙伴关系的新篇章，我们正在将这种伙伴关系从中国延伸到欧洲。” “我们第一次与中国汽车制造商合作，建立和发展其欧洲业务。得益于我们的全球研发和制造网络，我们拥有在全球几乎所有关键地区进行开发和制造的专业知识。”

paras.en: European Capabilities and Localized Cooperation
paras.zh: 欧洲能力和本地化合作

paras.en: The scope of the cooperation covers potential production at AUMOVIO’s European plants and potential business across the company’s entire automotive portfolio. Localized R&D, manufacturing, close-to-customer supply, and local after-sales support are intended to form the operational basis of the cooperation.
paras.zh: 合作范围涵盖AUMOVIO欧洲工厂的潜在生产以及公司整个汽车产品组合的潜在业务。本地化的研发、制造、贴近客户的供应以及本地化的售后支持将构成此次合作的运营基础。

paras.en: AUMOVIO will use its understanding of the European market, its R&D and manufacturing base, and regulatory know-how to support Chery’s activities in Europe. The cooperation is based on shared principles: deepen joint technology development, establish local operations and development, and build resilient supply chains.
paras.zh: AUMOVIO将利用其对欧洲市场的了解、研发和制造基地以及监管知识来支持奇瑞在欧洲的活动。此次合作基于共同原则：深化联合技术开发、建立本地运营和开发以及建立有弹性的供应链。

paras.en: Longstanding Partnership and Expansion in Europe
paras.zh: 欧洲的长期合作伙伴关系和扩张

paras.en: AUMOVIO and Chery have worked together since 1999, with AUMOVIO serving as one of Chery’s core suppliers in China. At IAA 2025, the companies signed a letter of intent for long-term cooperation and a global strategic partnership to support Chery’s international business.
paras.zh: 奥莫维与奇瑞自1999年开始合作，奥莫维是奇瑞在中国的核心供应商之一。在IAA 2025上，两家公司签署了长期合作意向书和全球战略合作伙伴关系，以支持奇瑞的国际业务。

paras.en: The new initiative marks a further milestone by placing a specific focus on cooperation in Europe and on additional business opportunities for AUMOVIO’s European operations.
paras.zh: 这项新举措标志着一个又一个里程碑，它特别关注欧洲的合作以及 AUMOVIO 欧洲业务的额外商机。

articles.title: Continental Concept Tire Supports VW Mission Efficiency World Record
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Continental made a decisive contribution to the world record set by Volkswagen’s Mission Efficiency concept vehicle with a specially developed concept tire. During the record-breaking drive, the world’s most efficient near-production electric vehicle consumed just 7.51 kilowatt-hours of electricity per 100 kilometers including charging losses, or 6.89 kWh per 100 km excluding charging losses.
paras.zh: 大陆集团凭借专门开发的概念轮胎，为大众汽车 Mission Efficiency 概念车创下的世界纪录做出了决定性贡献。在破纪录的行驶过程中，世界上最高效的接近量产电动汽车每 100 公里仅消耗 7.51 千瓦时的电力（包括充电损失），或每 100 公里消耗 6.89 千瓦时（不包括充电损失）。

paras.en: The record was officially certified by RID – Rekord-Institut für Deutschland on Aug. 24, 2026, following a 1,278.36-kilometer journey from Wolfsburg to Vienna under real-world conditions. The trip required only one charging stop and concluded with 164 kilometers of remaining range. Continental’s concept tire achieves a rolling resistance of 4.9 kilograms per metric ton, about 25 percent below the threshold for the EU tire label’s highest class A rating. Since about 20 percent of an electric vehicle’s propulsion energy is used to overcome tire rolling resistance, this is a key factor in increasing vehicle range.
paras.zh: 该纪录于 2026 年 8 月 24 日获得 RID – Rekord-Institut für Deutschland 的正式认证，该记录是在现实条件下从沃尔夫斯堡到维也纳 1,278.36 公里的旅程之后获得的。此次行程仅需要一站充电，剩余续航里程为 164 公里。马牌概念轮胎的滚动阻力为每吨 4.9 公斤，比欧盟轮胎标签最高 A 级评级的阈值低约 25%。由于电动汽车约 20% 的推进能量用于克服轮胎滚动阻力，因此这是增加车辆续航里程的关键因素。

paras.en: “The record shows that increasing the range of electric cars does not necessarily require larger batteries. Significant opportunities lie in the successful interaction of all vehicle components. Tires make a crucial contribution,” says Dr. Christian Strübel, Continental’s expert in rolling resistance for passenger-car tires. “Together with Volkswagen, we’ve demonstrated what’s possible when vehicle, aerodynamics and tire development are aligned from the very beginning.”
paras.zh: “记录表明，增加电动汽车的续航里程并不一定需要更大的电池。重要的机会在于所有车辆部件的成功相互作用。轮胎做出了至关重要的贡献，”大陆集团乘用车轮胎滚动阻力专家 Christian Strübel 博士说道。 “我们与大众汽车一起，展示了车辆、空气动力学和轮胎开发从一开始就协调一致的可能性。”

paras.en: Tires play a central role in the efficiency of electric vehicles. Their properties have a direct effect on energy consumption and therefore on the range achieved on a single battery charge. This is due to rolling resistance. With every revolution, the tire deforms where it contacts the road surface. This deformation consumes energy that would otherwise be available for propulsion. About 20 percent of an electric vehicle’s battery energy is used just to overcome this resistance. In other words, the lower the rolling resistance, the greater the range from the same battery charge.
paras.zh: 轮胎在电动汽车的效率方面发挥着核心作用。它们的特性对能耗有直接影响，从而对单次电池充电所达到的行驶里程有直接影响。这是由于滚动阻力造成的。每转一圈，轮胎与路面接触的地方都会变形。这种变形会消耗原本可用于推进的能量。电动汽车大约 20% 的电池能量都用于克服这种阻力。换句话说，滚动阻力越低，相同电池电量下的续航里程就越大。

paras.en: This is where Continental focuses its tire development. The concept tire is based on the EcoContact 7, which already offers low rolling resistance as a production tire. For the record-breaking drive, the tire was modified according to Volkswagen’s specifications. The result is a tire that deforms even less as it rolls, further reducing energy consumption and increasing the range per battery charge.
paras.zh: 这是大陆集团轮胎开发的重点领域。该概念轮胎基于 EcoContact 7，该轮胎已作为量产轮胎提供低滚动阻力。为了打破纪录，轮胎根据大众汽车的规格进行了修改。其结果是轮胎在滚动时变形更小，进一步降低了能耗并增加了每次电池充电的行驶里程。

paras.en: What Sets the Record-Breaking Tire Apart
paras.zh: 是什么让破纪录的轮胎与众不同

paras.en: Two components are particularly important for achieving low rolling resistance. First, the sidewall follows the same design principle used in the EcoContact 7 production tire, providing stability without increasing rolling resistance. Second, the tread compound has been tailored to the tire’s other components. Together with the carcass and tread pattern, it helps minimize the energy losses generated as the tire rolls.
paras.zh: 有两个组件对于实现低滚动阻力尤为重要。首先，胎侧遵循与 EcoContact 7 量产轮胎相同的设计原理，在不增加滚动阻力的情况下提供稳定性。其次，胎面胶是根据轮胎的其他部件量身定制的。它与胎体和胎面花纹一起，有助于最大限度地减少轮胎滚动时产生的能量损失。

paras.en: An additional advantage comes from a new manufacturing process. During production, the initially soft green tire is hardened in a mold under heat and pressure — a process known as vulcanization. In this case, however, Continental does not heat the tire uniformly at the same temperature, as is typical in conventional production. Instead, different areas of the tire are exposed to different temperatures. For example, the tread is cured differently from the sidewall. This allows the properties of each area of the tire to be optimized more precisely. For the tread, this results in lower rolling resistance.
paras.zh: 另一个优势来自新的制造工艺。在生产过程中，最初柔软的生胎在模具中在热量和压力下硬化，这一过程称为硫化。然而，在这种情况下，大陆集团并没有像传统生产中那样以相同的温度均匀加热轮胎。相反，轮胎的不同区域暴露在不同的温度下。例如，胎面的固化方式与胎侧不同。这使得轮胎每个区域的性能能够得到更精确的优化。对于胎面来说，这会降低滚动阻力。

paras.en: Rolling noise also played an important role in the development of the record-breaking tire. Its tread pattern was designed by Continental to achieve low noise levels. Continental’s engineers varied the spacing and angles of the tread blocks so that the noises they generate partially overlap and cancel each other out.
paras.zh: 滚动噪音在破纪录轮胎的开发过程中也发挥了重要作用。其胎面花纹由大陆集团设计，以实现低噪音水平。大陆集团的工程师改变了胎面花纹块的间距和角度，使它们产生的噪音部分重叠并相互抵消。

paras.en: For the Mission Efficiency vehicle, this means the record-breaking tire not only improves efficiency but also ensures a particularly quiet driving experience, according to Continental. This aspect is becoming increasingly important in electric vehicles because, without the sound of an internal combustion engine, tire noise becomes far more noticeable.
paras.zh: 大陆集团表示，对于 Mission Efficiency 车辆来说，这意味着破纪录的轮胎不仅可以提高效率，还可以确保特别安静的驾驶体验。这方面在电动汽车中变得越来越重要，因为如果没有内燃机的声音，轮胎噪音就会变得更加明显。

articles.title: NexaMotion Group on ‘Turning Information Into Better Decisions’
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: NexaMotion Group explains that Transend began as a way for customers to identify parts and place orders online. The platform is now being developed around a much broader understanding of how technicians search.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group 解释说，Transend 最初是作为客户识别零件和在线下订单的一种方式。该平台现在的开发围绕着对技术人员如何搜索的更广泛的理解。

paras.en: “It is truly becoming a platform that understands what a technician needs rather than what they type,” said Naresh Kopparapu, NexaMotion Group’s chief information officer.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group 首席信息官 Naresh Kopparapu 表示：“它正在真正成为一个了解技术人员需要什么而不是他们输入什么的平台。”

paras.en: Technicians can approach the same repair in different ways. One may know an exact part number. Another may use an OE interchange number, shop terminology or a familiar description of the component. NexaMotion has replaced older search technology with an engine designed specifically around automotive parts specs and applications. The work is progressing toward semantic search, which is a fancy data/AI-minded way of defining business definitions and operations so that data can be interpreted with meaning and context in mind.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以通过不同的方式进行相同的修复。人们可能知道确切的零件号。另一种可能使用原厂互换编号、车间术语或熟悉的组件描述。 NexaMotion 采用专门针对汽车零部件规格和应用设计的引擎取代了旧的搜索技术。这项工作正在朝着语义搜索的方向发展，这是一种奇特的数据/人工智能方式，用于定义业务定义和操作，以便可以在考虑到含义和上下文的情况下解释数据。

paras.en: Kopparapu described a future workflow in which a technician could enter vehicle information and a symptom, allowing the platform to begin narrowing potential repair components. A conversational interface could ask follow-up questions and help assemble a parts list.
paras.zh: Kopparapu 描述了未来的工作流程，技术人员可以在其中输入车辆信息和症状，从而使平台能够开始缩小潜在维修组件的范围。对话界面可以提出后续问题并帮助整理零件清单。

paras.en: Accuracy starts with the information underneath the search. Kopparapu said ACES and PIES provide much of the industry foundation, while NexaMotion’s transmission catalog contains additional fitment information developed through its own experience. The company is modernizing that catalog into a cloud-based platform feeding Transend, its ERP systems and channel partners.
paras.zh: 准确性从搜索下方的信息开始。 Kopparapu 表示，ACES 和 PIES 提供了大部分行业基础，而 NexaMotion 的变速箱目录包含根据其自身经验开发的额外配件信息。该公司正在将该目录现代化为一个基于云的平台，为 Transend、其 ERP 系统和渠道合作伙伴提供服务。

paras.en: Tim Cox, executive vice president of supply chain, said some of the most useful signals for his team come from searches that fail to produce an order. NexaMotion can examine whether the part is absent from the company’s assortment, unavailable close enough to the customer, positioned at a different price point or offered under a brand the customer did not select.
paras.zh: 供应链执行副总裁蒂姆·考克斯(Tim Cox)表示，对他的团队来说，一些最有用的信号来自未能产生订单的搜索。 NexaMotion 可以检查该零件是否在公司的产品系列中不存在、是否距离客户足够近、定位在不同的价格点或以客户未选择的品牌提供。

paras.en: Those searches create another view of what is happening in the repair market — and uncover additional sales opportunities for the company.
paras.zh: 这些搜索为维修市场正在发生的事情提供了另一种视角，并为公司发现了额外的销售机会。

paras.en: Sales history records what customers have purchased. Vehicle-in-operation data establishes which applications exist within a market. Search activity shows what technicians are actively trying to source as vehicles enter their shops. Cox said the company can use those signals to evaluate new SKUs, adjust branch inventories and move products through the network as applications mature.
paras.zh: 销售历史记录客户购买过的商品。运行中的车辆数据确定了市场中存在哪些应用程序。搜索活动显示了技术人员在车辆进入商店时正在积极尝试寻找的资源。考克斯表示，随着应用的成熟，公司可以利用这些信号来评估新的 SKU、调整分支机构库存并通过网络移动产品。

paras.en: “The search measures intent, but it doesn’t always measure commitment,” Cox said.
paras.zh: “搜索衡量意图，但并不总是衡量承诺，”考克斯说。

paras.en: Category managers add context through product knowledge, market experience and feedback from the sales organization. The combination helps determine when a search pattern represents a stocking opportunity.
paras.zh: 品类经理通过产品知识、市场经验和销售组织的反馈来添加背景信息。该组合有助于确定搜索模式何时代表库存机会。

paras.en: Scott Weinstein, president of NexaMotion Group, described a similar feedback loop through NexaMotion’s CRM. Customer conversations can be captured across markets.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group 总裁 Scott Weinstein 通过 NexaMotion 的 CRM 描述了类似的反馈循环。可以捕获跨市场的客户对话。

paras.en: “An important thing I learned long ago is: inspect what you expect,” Weinstein said. “All companies come up with slogans and missions, visions, value propositions. But you have to execute on what you’re promising to the customer.”
paras.zh: “我很久以前学到的一件重要的事情是：检查你的期望，”韦恩斯坦说。 “所有公司都会提出口号、使命、愿景、价值主张。但你必须执行对客户的承诺。”

paras.en: New tools give NexaMotion greater visibility into that execution, from online activity to customer calls and interactions in the field. Weinstein said that information still has to be tested against what leaders and customers are actually seeing.
paras.zh: 新工具使 NexaMotion 能够更好地了解执行情况，从在线活动到客户呼叫和现场交互。韦恩斯坦表示，信息仍然需要根据领导者和客户实际看到的内容进行测试。

paras.en: “We still have the human element of having good leaders that work in our organization to take the data. Does it make sense? Let’s validate it first,” he said. “If we start to see trend over a certain market, we can act quicker on it.”
paras.zh: “我们仍然存在人为因素，即在我们的组织中拥有优秀的领导者来获取数据。这有意义吗？让我们先验证一下，”他说。 “如果我们开始看到某个市场的趋势，我们就可以更快地采取行动。”

paras.en: Transmission repair has always required specialization. The units beginning to reach independent shops add greater electronic, mechanical and application complexity. NexaMotion Group CEO Neil Sethi pointed to tighter drivetrain tolerances, electronic controls, higher speed counts and the different demands vehicles place on the transmission.
paras.zh: 变速箱维修始终需要专业化。这些单元开始进入独立商店，增加了电子、机械和应用的复杂性。 NexaMotion 集团首席执行官 Neil Sethi 指出，更严格的传动系统公差、电子控制、更高的速度计数以及车辆对变速箱提出的不同要求。

paras.en: Light trucks used for towing, for example, create one set of operating conditions. Other applications create their own. Fuel-economy requirements introduce additional engineering considerations that affect components throughout the drivetrain. The resulting repair challenges vary by platform, engine and vehicle use.
paras.zh: 例如，用于牵引的轻型卡车会创造一组操作条件。其他应用程序创建自己的应用程序。燃油经济性要求引入了额外的工程考虑因素，影响整个传动系统的组件。由此产生的维修挑战因平台、发动机和车辆用途而异。

paras.en: Kevin Rozsa, executive vice president of NMG mergers and acquisitions and Transtar sales, is seeing later-model units enter the independent repair cycle more frequently. Some rebuilders have had limited exposure to nine- and 10-speed transmissions. Recent visits with customers showed 10-speed units beginning to arrive more regularly in shops.
paras.zh: NMG 并购和 Transtar 销售执行副总裁 Kevin Rozsa 发现，较新型号的设备更频繁地进入独立维修周期。一些重建者对 9 速和 10 速变速箱的接触有限。最近对客户的走访显示，10 速装置开始更频繁地到达商店。

paras.en: Those units also arrive at a time when the transmission aftermarket is working through a technician challenge. Experienced rebuilders have left the industry, and newer units require additional technical knowledge. Transtar works with ATSG and ATRA on seminars throughout the United States and Canada to provide rebuilders with information on these applications.
paras.zh: 这些装置的到来也正值变速箱售后市场正在应对技术挑战的时候。经验丰富的重建者已经离开该行业，而新的单位需要额外的技术知识。 Transtar 与 ATSG 和 ATRA 合作在美国和加拿大各地举办研讨会，为重建者提供有关这些应用的信息。

paras.en: The changing transmission mix also shapes NexaMotion’s proprietary product strategy.
paras.zh: 不断变化的传动组合也塑造了 NexaMotion 的专有产品战略。

paras.en: Transtar-branded products include new components. Transmaxx covers remanufactured transmissions, hard parts and transmission electro-hydraulic control modules (TEHCMs). RECON Certified supplies remanufactured torque converters. Together, the brands give NexaMotion additional control over the solutions it can offer as new repair needs develop.
paras.zh: Transtar 品牌的产品包括新组件。 Transmaxx 涵盖再制造变速箱、硬零件和变速箱电液控制模块 (TEHCM)。 RECON Certified 供应再制造的变矩器。随着新的维修需求的发展，这些品牌共同为 NexaMotion 提供了对其提供的解决方案的额外控制。

paras.en: Rozsa said some suppliers have reduced their involvement in transmission component manufacturing. Increasingly complex eight-, nine- and 10-speed units create opportunities for NexaMotion to develop products around gaps it sees emerging in the aftermarket.
paras.zh: 罗兹萨表示，一些供应商已经减少了对变速箱零部件制造的参与。日益复杂的 8 速、9 速和 10 速装置为 NexaMotion 创造了机会，围绕售后市场中出现的空白开发产品。

paras.en: “We want to be able to come to the aftermarket with solutions before anyone else or solutions that no one else has come up with yet,” Rozsa said.
paras.zh: “我们希望能够先于其他人或其他人尚未提出的解决方案进入售后市场，”罗兹萨说。

paras.en: The product team works closely with Cox and the supply-chain organization to evaluate data and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Cox said older applications have remained significant longer than expected, in some cases, while some newer applications are failing earlier. His team is using AI tools to identify local, regional and seasonal patterns, and follow individual parts through their lifecycles.
paras.zh: 产品团队与 Cox 和供应链组织密切合作，评估数据并识别值得追求的机会。考克斯表示，在某些情况下，较旧的应用程序的运行时间比预期要长得多，而一些较新的应用程序则更早出现故障。他的团队正在使用人工智能工具来识别本地、区域和季节性模式，并跟踪各个部件的整个生命周期。

paras.en: Pictured: The NMG team (left to right): Scott Weinstein, Tim Cox, Kevin Rozsa, Neil Sethi, Naresh Kopparapu.
paras.zh: 图为：NMG 团队（从左到右）：Scott Weinstein、Tim Cox、Kevin Rozsa、Neil Sethi、Naresh Kopparapu。

paras.en: PLEASE NOTE: Look for Part 3 of this Cover story, Creating More Room for Greater Expertise, in an upcoming edition of AftermarketNews.
paras.zh: 请注意：请在即将出版的《售后市场新闻》中查找本封面故事的第 3 部分，为更专业的知识创造更多空间。

articles.title: XL Parts | The Parts House Expands VIP Event Series
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: XL Parts | The Parts House recently concluded its highly anticipated 2026 VIP Event Series, marking a major milestone in company history with expanded programming across three key markets: Houston, Dallas, and Orlando.
paras.zh: XL 零件 | Parts House 最近结束了备受期待的 2026 年 VIP 活动系列，在休斯顿、达拉斯和奥兰多三个主要市场扩大了活动范围，标志着公司历史上的一个重要里程碑。

paras.en: This year’s events introduced an upgraded two-day experience in both Houston and Orlando. The new structure provided dedicated time for internal strategy sessions, vendor showcases, formal awards ceremonies for employee-of-the-year honorees and supplier partners, and customer-focused trade shows and appreciation dinners, the company said.
paras.zh: 今年的活动在休斯顿和奥兰多推出了升级的两天体验。该公司表示，新的结构为内部战略会议、供应商展示、年度最佳员工获奖者和供应商合作伙伴的正式颁奖典礼以及以客户为中心的贸易展览和答谢晚宴提供了专门的时间。

paras.en: The series debuted September 17-18 at The Woodlands Resort in Houston, TX, where XL Parts team members, vendor partners, and customers gathered for comprehensive product training, business development, and vendor recognition.
paras.zh: 该系列于 9 月 17 日至 18 日在德克萨斯州休斯顿的 Woodlands Resort 首次亮相，XL Parts 团队成员、供应商合作伙伴和客户齐聚一堂，进行全面的产品培训、业务开发和供应商认可。

paras.en: The momentum continued at The Shop Club in Dallas, TX, on September 24, where XL Parts leaned into a fast-paced, high-energy trade show evening. Local shop owners and industry partners connected with suppliers over interactive exhibition booths, live entertainment, and multiple prizes.
paras.zh: 9 月 24 日，这一势头在德克萨斯州达拉斯市的 The Shop Club 继续延续，XL Parts 在这里度过了一个快节奏、充满活力的贸易展之夜。当地店主和行业合作伙伴通过互动展位、现场娱乐表演和多种奖品与供应商建立联系。

paras.en: The VIP event line-up concluded October 1-2 at the Gaylord Palms Resort in Orlando, FL, marking a momentous return at The Parts House (TPH). TPH honored VIP customers and supplier partners through targeted product training, networking, and evening celebrations.
paras.zh: VIP 活动阵容于 10 月 1 日至 2 日在佛罗里达州奥兰多盖洛德棕榈度假村结束，标志着 The Parts House (TPH) 的重要回归。 TPH 通过有针对性的产品培训、网络和晚间庆祝活动向 VIP 客户和供应商合作伙伴致敬。

paras.en: “This year’s VIP Event Series represents a significant step forward in how we engage with our team, our vendor partners, and our customers,” said president & CEO Vikrant Aggarwal. “We have had the opportunity to create meaningful opportunities to align on strategic growth, strengthen industry relationships, and express our deep appreciation for the partners who drive our business forward.”
paras.zh: 总裁兼首席执行官维克兰特·阿加瓦尔 (Vikrant Aggarwal) 表示：“今年的 VIP 活动系列代表着我们在与团队、供应商合作伙伴和客户互动方面向前迈出了重要一步。” “我们有机会创造有意义的机会，以协调战略增长，加强行业关系，并向推动我们业务发展的合作伙伴表示深深的谢意。”

paras.en: Across all three cities, the 2026 VIP Event Series reinforced the company’s commitment to driving innovation, supporting independent repair facilities, and fostering strong supplier partnerships across its entire regional footprint, according to XL Parts | The Parts House.
paras.zh: XL Parts | 表示，在这三个城市举办的 2026 年 VIP 活动系列强化了该公司推动创新、支持独立维修设施以及在整个区域范围内培养强大的供应商合作伙伴关系的承诺。零件屋。

articles.title: BCA Bearings Releases 9 New Wheel Hub Assemblies
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corporation of America, the parent company of BCA Bearings, announced the addition of nine new wheel hub assembly part numbers to the BCA aftermarket product line. This latest new number announcement delivers expanded OE-quality coverage for more than 6.2 million vehicles in operation across North America.
paras.zh: BCA 轴承的母公司 NTN 轴承公司宣布在 BCA 售后市场产品线中增加九个新的轮毂组件零件号。这一最新的数字公告扩大了北美地区超过 620 万辆运营车辆的原厂质量覆盖范围。

paras.en: “BCA remains committed to delivering coverage for the applications that drive today’s aftermarket demand,” said Matt Gorski, manager of product development, automotive aftermarket. “These latest wheel hub additions strengthen our offering across some of the industry’s most popular trucks, SUVs, and passenger vehicles, helping our customers confidently service a broad range of applications with the OE-quality they expect from BCA.”
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场产品开发经理 Matt Gorski 表示：“BCA 仍然致力于覆盖推动当今售后市场需求的应用。” “这些最新的轮毂增强了我们在一些业内最受欢迎的卡车、SUV 和乘用车上的产品，帮助我们的客户自信地为各种应用提供他们期望 BCA 的原厂质量。”

paras.en: The new additions expand BCA‘s wheel hub assembly coverage across a wide range of domestic and import vehicle platforms from manufacturers including Chevrolet, GMC, Ford, Lincoln, Jeep, Toyota, Kia, and Hyundai. The release includes new applications for popular full-size pickups, heavy-duty trucks, SUVs, crossover utility vehicles, and passenger cars, further strengthening BCA’s ability to provide comprehensive coverage for the growing aftermarket.
paras.zh: 新增加的产品扩大了 BCA 轮毂组件的覆盖范围，涵盖雪佛兰、GMC、福特、林肯、吉普、丰田、起亚和现代等制造商的各种国产和进口汽车平台。此次发布的产品包括流行的全尺寸皮卡、重型卡车、SUV、跨界多功能车和乘用车的新应用程序，进一步增强了 BCA 为不断增长的售后市场提供全面覆盖的能力。

paras.en: Complete product and catalog information for the BCA Bearings product line can be found at BCABearings.com and ShowMeTheParts.com.
paras.zh: BCA 轴承产品线的完整产品和目录信息可在 BCABearings.com 和 ShowMeTheParts.com 上找到。

articles.title: Cartridge or Spin-On? Choosing the Right Oil Filter
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Some vehicles may use either a spin-on or cartridge-style oil filter. Identifying the correct filter requires a visual inspection, often from underneath the vehicle.
paras.zh: 有些车辆可能使用旋装式或筒式机油滤清器。识别正确的过滤器需要进行目视检查，通常是从车辆下方进行。

paras.en: Counter professionals should alert customers to this possibility and recommend checking the existing filter before purchasing a replacement to avoid ordering the wrong part.
paras.zh: 柜台专业人员应提醒顾客这种可能性，并建议在购买替换件之前检查现有的过滤器，以避免订购错误的部件。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: Romans may have set fire to Celtic town during conquest to 'humiliate' the enemy, archaeologists find
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists have unearthed a Roman military camp in Spain, where they found fragments of weapons and metal tacks from soldiers' shoes. The camp was used during the Cantabrian Wars fought by Emperor Augustus as he expanded the Roman Empire in the first century B.C.
paras.zh: 考古学家在西班牙挖掘出一个罗马军营，在那里他们发现了武器碎片和士兵鞋子上的金属钉子。该营地曾在公元前一世纪奥古斯都皇帝扩张罗马帝国的坎塔布连战争期间使用过。

paras.en: The fortified military camp is made up of an earthen platform roughly 39 feet (12 meters) wide, which is surrounded by a stone perimeter wall about 5 feet (1.5 m) thick, according to a translated statement. Uncovered during excavations earlier this year, the camp is situated about one-third of a mile (500 m) from where an Iron Age settlement was once inhabited by the Cantabri people, a group of Celtic tribes that lived among the Cantabrian Mountains in modern-day northern Spain.
paras.zh: 据翻译后的声明称，这个坚固的军营由一个宽约 39 英尺（12 米）的土台组成，四周环绕着约 5 英尺（1.5 m）厚的石墙。该营地在今年早些时候的挖掘工作中被发现，距离坎塔布里亚人曾经居住的铁器时代定居点约三分之一英里（500 m），坎塔布里亚人是一群凯尔特部落，居住在现代西班牙北部的坎塔布里亚山脉中。

paras.en: The Cantabri fiercely resisted Roman rule for a decade, but in 19 B.C., they were conquered by the military commanded by Emperor Augustus. The Cantabrian Wars marked the end of local control over the territory, as the Iberian Peninsula then came under control of the Roman Empire.
paras.zh: 坎塔布里人激烈反抗罗马统治十年，但在公元前 19 年，他们被奥古斯都皇帝指挥的军队征服。坎塔布连战争标志着当地对该地区控制的结束，伊比利亚半岛随后落入罗马帝国的控制之下。

paras.en: "It's not easy to find a camp associated with a hill fort in this condition," Eduardo González Gómez de Agüero, an archaeologist at the University of León who co-directed the excavation project, said in the statement.
paras.zh: 共同负责该发掘项目的莱昂大学考古学家爱德华多·冈萨雷斯·戈麦斯·德·阿圭罗在声明中表示：“在这种情况下，找到与山堡相关的营地并不容易。”

paras.en: Among the well-preserved remains at the camp were metal weapon fragments and small iron tacks known as hobnails, which were hammered into the bottom of Roman soldiers' leather military sandals to help provide traction on rocky and muddy terrain. These objects are evidence that the Roman military was prepared to attack and subdue the Iron Age community, according to the statement.
paras.zh: 营地中保存完好的遗骸包括金属武器碎片和被称为平头钉的小铁钉，这些钉子被锤入罗马士兵皮革军用凉鞋的底部，以帮助在岩石和泥泞的地形上提供牵引力。声明称，这些物品证明罗马军队准备攻击并征服铁器时代社区。

paras.en: The archaeologists also uncovered evidence of a major fire that destroyed most of the pre-Roman settlement, including two temples. González Gómez de Agüero suggested that the Romans may have deliberately set the fire as part of their conquest.
paras.zh: 考古学家还发现了一场大火的证据，这场大火摧毁了大部分前罗马定居点，包括两座寺庙。冈萨雷斯·戈麦斯·德·阿奎罗认为，罗马人可能故意放火作为征服的一部分。

paras.en: "It's not just about defeating the enemy, but about humiliating them, erasing their identity, and breaking their connection to the land," he said in the statement.
paras.zh: 他在声明中说：“这不仅仅是打败敌人，而是羞辱他们，抹去他们的身份，切断他们与土地的联系。”

paras.en: Researchers are still working on establishing the chronology of the Romans' final attack on the Cantabri and want to understand if the settlement was destroyed in a single event or over time. Previously, another research team found 66 Roman camps in northern Spain, showing the immensity of the empire's attacks against the Cantabri.
paras.zh: 研究人员仍在努力确定罗马人对坎塔布里人最后一次进攻的年表，并希望了解该定居点是在一次事件中被摧毁还是随着时间的推移而被摧毁。此前，另一个研究小组在西班牙北部发现了66个罗马营地，显示了帝国对坎塔布里人攻击的规模之大。

paras.en: The latest find is helping researchers understand the scale and location of Rome's fight for control of the Iberian Peninsula.
paras.zh: 最新发现正在帮助研究人员了解罗马争夺伊比利亚半岛控制权的规模和地点。

paras.en: "It is an important step in understanding how the conquest was carried out on the Cantabrian slope of León, an area where it was necessary to link the Roman camps with Iron Age settlements," Carlos Fernández Rodríguez, an archaeologist at the University of León, said in the statement.
paras.zh: 莱昂大学考古学家卡洛斯·费尔南德斯·罗德里格斯在声明中表示：“这是了解莱昂坎塔布连斜坡上的征服过程的重要一步，该地区有必要将罗马营地与铁器时代的定居点连接起来。”

paras.en: Can you identify these historical objects of war? Test your smarts with our weapons of the world quiz!
paras.zh: 你能认出这些战争历史文物吗？用我们的世界武器测验来测试你的智慧！

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: 'Cute demo, but totally impractical': Experts are skeptical that Tesla's 'Rocket' Roadster could actually work in the real world
articles.author: Owen Hughes

paras.en: Tesla has unveiled a new "flying" version of its Roadster electric vehicle (EV) that uses SpaceX tech to pull off seemingly impressive airborne acrobatics.
paras.zh: 特斯拉推出了一款新的“飞行”版本的 Roadster 电动汽车 (EV)，它使用 SpaceX 技术来完成看似令人印象深刻的空中杂技。

paras.en: During a filmed demonstration at the SpaceX rocket testing facility in Texas Thursday (Oct. 15), the second-generation Tesla Roadster was shown accelerating up a curved ramp before launching itself into the air, performing a 180-degree barrel roll and touching back down to Earth.
paras.zh: 周四（10 月 15 日）在德克萨斯州 SpaceX 火箭测试设施进行的一次拍摄演示中，第二代 Tesla Roadster 加速爬上弧形坡道，然后发射到空中，进行 180 度桶滚并返回地球。

paras.en: In another stunt, the vehicle leapt over a row of parked Teslas. For safety reasons, the vehicle was operated remotely in both instances.
paras.zh: 在另一个特技表演中，车辆跳过了一排停放的特斯拉。出于安全原因，在这两种情况下，车辆都是远程操作的。

paras.en: "Turns out, the future does have flying cars," Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk wrote on X following the demonstration.
paras.zh: “事实证明，未来确实有飞行汽车，”特斯拉和 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克在演示结束后在 X 上写道。

paras.en: The Roadster's airborne capabilities are made possible by a system of cold-gas thrusters developed using technology from Musk's aerospace company, SpaceX. These thrusters release bursts of high-pressure gas to generate thrust, allowing the vehicle to accelerate rapidly and, according to Tesla, become airborne for short periods.
paras.zh: Roadster 的机载能力是通过使用马斯克旗下航空航天公司 SpaceX 的技术开发的冷气体推进器系统实现的。这些推进器释放高压气体以产生推力，使车辆能够快速加速，并根据特斯拉的说法，在短时间内进入空中。

paras.en: The new Roadster will come in three variants: Performance, Thrust and Rocket. Only the Rocket is capable of flight. The Performance model is a two-seater equipped with a suction system that's designed to improve traction and handling (or drive up inverted ramps, as in Tesla's demo), while the Thrust model adds rear-mounted thrusters that Tesla claims can propel the vehicle from 0 to 60 mph (97 km/h) in under a second.
paras.zh: 新款 Roadster 将提供三种型号：Performance、Thrust 和 Rocket。只有火箭能够飞行。 Performance车型是一款配备吸力系统的双座车型，旨在提高牵引力和操控性（或驾驶倒置坡道，如特斯拉的演示），而Thrust车型则增加了后置推进器，特斯拉声称可以在一秒内将车辆从0英里/小时（97公里/小时）推进到60英里/小时（97公里/小时）。

paras.en: The highest-end model, Rocket, features SpaceX cold-gas thrusters positioned around the vehicle to enable short bursts of flight and in-air control. This single-seat model will be available by invitation only, according to Tesla.
paras.zh: 最高端的型号 Rocket 在飞行器周围配备了 SpaceX 冷气推进器，可实现短时飞行和空中控制。特斯拉表示，这款单座车型将仅受邀请才能购买。

paras.en: On the company's website, Tesla representatives explicitly stated that the Rocket isn't approved for use on public roads and that availability depends on regional regulations. During the reveal, Musk told the audience that the Rocket "is not necessarily a safety-optimized car."
paras.zh: 在该公司的网站上，特斯拉代表明确表示，Rocket 尚未获准在公共道路上使用，其可用性取决于地区法规。在揭幕仪式上，马斯克告诉观众，火箭“不一定是安全优化的汽车”。

paras.en: Tesla hasn't disclosed how far or for how long its EV can remain airborne, nor is it the first company to develop a hybrid road-air vehicle. There is also skepticism from outside viewers on whether the demonstration could be replicated outside of controlled scenarios.
paras.zh: 特斯拉没有透露其电动汽车可以在空中飞行多远或多长时间，它也不是第一家开发混合动力公路-空中汽车的公司。外部观众也对演示是否可以在受控场景之外复制表示怀疑。

paras.en: Artificial intelligence (AI) scientist Yann LeCun — a professor of data science, computer science, neural science and electrical engineering at New York University — described the demonstration on X as a "marketing stunt" and questioned whether the vehicle would work in practice.
paras.zh: 人工智能 (AI) 科学家 Yann LeCun（纽约大学数据科学、计算机科学、神经科学和电气工程教授）将 X 上的演示描述为“营销噱头”，并质疑该车辆在实际中是否有效。

paras.en: "Even assuming that 50% of the mass of the car is the compressed air, that gives you less than 10s of useful thrust (with thrust-to-weight ratio larger than 1.0). Probably more like 5 seconds, actually," he posted on the social media platform. "So the car must be an empty, lightweight shell containing big compressed air tanks. Cute demo, but totally impractical. But of course, you knew that."
paras.zh: 他在社交媒体平台上发帖称：“即使假设汽车质量的 50% 是压缩空气，也能提供不到 10 秒的有用推力（推重比大于 1.0）。实际上，可能更像 5 秒。” “所以这辆车一定是一个空的、轻质的外壳，里面装有大型压缩空气罐。可爱的演示，但完全不切实际。但当然，你知道这一点。”

paras.en: He likened it to SpaceShipOne, which debuted in 2004 as the first privately funded spacecraft and made three record-setting flights before being retired.
paras.zh: 他将其比作“太空船一号”，后者于 2004 年作为第一艘私人资助的航天器首次亮相，并在退役前完成了三次创纪录的飞行。

paras.en: California-based Alef Aeronautics, which is developing its own flying EVs, marked Tesla's unveiling by releasing footage of its vehicle flying over an earlier Roadster model. Alef representatives said the demonstration marked its 1,000th logged flight.
paras.zh: 总部位于加利福尼亚州的 Alef Aeronautics 正在开发自己的飞行电动汽车，该公司通过发布其车辆飞过早期 Roadster 车型的镜头来标志着特斯拉的揭幕。 Alef 的代表表示，这次演示标志着其第 1000 次有记录的飞行。

paras.en: "Welcome Tesla to the flying car race, we've been here alone for eleven years," Alef CEO Jim Dukhovny said in a statement emailed to Live Science. "Having competition is a good thing, especially from such a major company as Tesla."
paras.zh: Alef 首席执行官吉姆·杜霍夫尼 (Jim Dukhovny) 在通过电子邮件发送给 Live Science 的一份声明中表示：“欢迎特斯拉加入飞行汽车竞赛，我们已经独自在这里度过了 11 年。” “有竞争是一件好事，尤其是来自特斯拉这样的大公司。”

paras.en: Unlike Tesla's compressed-gas tech, Alef's vehicle uses electric propellers for vertical takeoff and landing, with a rotating cabin and body designed to support forward flight.
paras.zh: 与特斯拉的压缩气体技术不同，阿勒夫的车辆使用电动螺旋桨进行垂直起飞和着陆，并配有旋转舱和车身以支持向前飞行。

paras.en: Production of the new Roadster is scheduled for 2028, but Tesla doesn't have the best track record of meeting its deadlines. The company has delayed production of its Optimus humanoid robot a few times since first unveiling the machine in 2021, for example, with an initial start in 2023, before being pushed back. Only in recent months has production begun to scale to a few hundred units per week.
paras.zh: 新款 Roadster 的生产计划于 2028 年进行，但特斯拉并没有按时完成生产的最佳记录。例如，自 2021 年首次推出 Optimus 人形机器人以来，该公司已多次推迟生产该机器，最初于 2023 年开始生产，然后又被推迟。直到最近几个月，产量才开始扩大到每周几百台。

Previously a senior editor at ZDNET, Owen has been writing about tech for more than a decade, during which time he has covered everything from AI, cybersecurity and supercomputers to programming languages and public sector IT. Owen is particularly interested in the intersection of technology, life and work – in his previous roles at ZDNET and TechRepublic, he wrote extensively about business leadership, digital transformation and the evolving dynamics of remote work.
paras.zh: 欧文·休斯 (Owen Hughes) 是一位自由撰稿人和编辑，专门从事数据和数字技术。 Owen 曾担任 ZDNET 的高级编辑，十多年来一直在撰写有关技术的文章，在此期间，他涵盖了从人工智能、网络安全和超级计算机到编程语言和公共部门 IT 的所有内容。 Owen 对技术、生活和工作的交叉点特别感兴趣 - 在他之前在 ZDNET 和 TechRepublic 任职期间，他撰写了大量有关商业领导力、数字化转型和远程工作不断发展的动态的文章。
