paras.zh: 不止一滴泪珠从她的眼角滑落。爱莉安娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 周一（10 月 19 日）透露，她心爱超过 17 年的狗可可（Coco）去世了。

paras.en: “sweetest, most amazing and most beautiful coco … i am so proud of you. thank you for your love, and for blessing this planet with your physical presence for over seventeen wonderful years,” she began her Instagram post, in which she shared numerous photos of herself and her beloved pup from over the years. “you make everywhere you go a more beautiful place.”
paras.zh: “最可爱、最神奇、最美丽的可可……我为你感到骄傲。感谢你的爱，感谢你在十七年的美好岁月里用你的存在来祝福这个星球，”她在 Instagram 上发帖，分享了多年来她和她心爱的小狗的许多照片。 “你让你所到之处都变得更加美丽。”

paras.en: She concluded her emotional tribute: “i will miss you every day and hold you in my heart always. i love you so, sweet girl.”
paras.zh: 她总结道：“我会每天想念你，永远把你放在心里。我非常爱你，可爱的女孩。”

paras.en: Among the snaps of Coco were several of Ari snuggling with her furry pal, one of the pup celebrating her 17th birthday with a bone-shaped cake, the pooch as a little baby, a video of her contemplating a “morning leap” from one step to the patio, and finally ending with a black-and-white image of Coco’s paws with a white rose.
paras.zh: 在《可可》的几张照片中，有几张阿里和她毛茸茸的朋友依偎在一起的照片、其中一只小狗用骨头形状的蛋糕庆祝她 17 岁生日的照片、这只小狗还是个小婴儿的照片、一段她考虑从一个台阶“晨跃”到露台的视频，最后以一张可可的爪子拿着一朵白玫瑰的黑白照片结束。

paras.en: Some of the three-time Grammy-winning artist’s friends shared their heartfelt condolences in the comments section of the post.
paras.zh: 这位三届格莱美奖得主的一些朋友在帖子的评论部分表达了他们衷心的哀悼。

paras.en: “Oh my love. What a gift you were to one another. 17 years. And I love that you said how proud you were of her,” TV host Ross Matthews wrote. “I so get it. I’m sending you every ounce of my love.”
paras.zh: “哦，我的爱人。你是彼此的一份礼物。17 年。我喜欢你说你为她感到骄傲，”电视主持人罗斯·马修斯写道。 “我明白了。我正在向你表达我每一分的爱。”

paras.en: “I’m sorry for your loss,” singer Leon Thomas penned. “Coco was the best.”
paras.zh: “我对你的损失感到抱歉，”歌手莱昂·托马斯写道。 “可可是最棒的。”

paras.en: “sweet sweet coco,” wrote Ilya Salmanzadeh, a producer and songwriter who has worked with Grande on multiple songs over the years, including “Petal,” which reached No. 4 on the Billboard Hot 100 in August.
paras.zh: “sweet sweet coco，”制作人兼作曲家 Ilya Salmanzadeh 写道，多年来，他与 Grande 合作创作了多首歌曲，其中包括 8 月份在 Billboard Hot 100 上排名第四的《Petal》。

paras.en: The singer, who boasts 10 Hot 100 No. 1 hits to date, has been open about her love for pups for a long time. “Dogs are the most harmless, sweetest babes in the world,” the pop star told Billboard in 2015. “They show nothing but unconditional love, so they deserve that in return.”
paras.zh: 这位歌手迄今为止拥有 10 首热门 100 首热门歌曲，长期以来一直公开表达她对小狗的热爱。 “狗是世界上最无害、最可爱的宝贝，”这位流行歌星在 2015 年告诉《告示牌》。“它们只表现出无条件的爱，所以它们值得得到回报。”

paras.en: Grande is currently taking a break from her public-facing work after wrapping her Eternal Sunshine Tour in early September. However, Billboard confirmed in September that she would still be doing press for her upcoming movie, Focker-in-Law, in which she stars alongside Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. The film arrives in theaters Nov. 25.
paras.zh: 格兰德在九月初结束了她的“永恒阳光”巡演后，目前正在暂停她面向公众的工作。然而，《告示牌》在 9 月份证实，她仍将为即将上映的电影《福克》做新闻报道，在这部电影中，她与本·斯蒂勒和罗伯特·德尼罗一起主演。该片将于 11 月 25 日上映。

articles.title: ‘Elsbeth’ Production Assistants File For Union Election (Exclusive)
articles.author: Caitlin Huston

paras.en: Production assistants on Elsbeth are embarking on a union push.
paras.zh: 埃尔斯贝斯的制作助理正在发起工会推动活动。

paras.en: On Oct. 15, the production assistants filed for a union election with the National Labor Relations Board. The petition covers 28 workers on the CBS series. The goal is to join LiUNA Local 724, which has partnered with grassroots organization Production Assistants United as part of a broader push to unionize film and television production assistants.
paras.zh: 10月15日，生产助理向国家劳工关系委员会申请工会选举。请愿书涵盖了 CBS 系列节目的 28 名工作人员。我们的目标是加入 LiUNA Local 724，该组织与草根组织 Production Assistants United 合作，作为更广泛推动电影和电视制作助理成立工会的一部分。

paras.en: The New York-based show stars Carrie Preston as the titular star in the police procedural, which is now entering into its fourth season. The series was created by Robert and Michelle King as a spinoff of The Good Wife and The Good Fight.
paras.zh: 这部以纽约为背景的剧集由凯莉·普雷斯顿 (Carrie Preston) 饰演警察程序剧中的主角，该剧现已进入第四季。该剧由罗伯特·金和米歇尔·金创作，是《傲骨贤妻》和《傲骨之战》的衍生剧。

paras.en: “The production assistants on ‘Elsbeth’ are so excited about taking this important step into unionizing,” the PAs said in a statement. “For too long in this industry nonunion labor has been seen as simply an entry level position when in reality these workers are people with years of experience who work some of the longest hours on set while being in precarious positions with their finances, healthcare, and their children’s wellbeing.”
paras.zh: 制片人在一份声明中表示：“《埃尔斯贝斯》的制作助理对于加入工会这一重要步骤感到非常兴奋。” “长期以来，在这个行业中，非工会劳工被视为只是初级职位，而实际上，这些工人都是拥有多年经验的人，他们在片场工作的时间最长，但他们的财务、医疗保健和孩子的福祉却处于不稳定的境地。”

paras.en: “We are artists who love what we do and want to continue working with the amazing cast and crew of our show. We hope to inspire other PA teams to follow our lead in an effort to protect ourselves as a community against the consolidation of media companies and the inevitable effects that will have on our industry,” the statement continued.
paras.zh: “我们是热爱我们所做的事情的艺术家，并希望继续与我们节目中出色的演员和工作人员合作。我们希望激励其他 PA 团队效仿我们的领导，努力保护我们自己作为一个社区免受媒体公司的整合以及这对我们行业造成的不可避免的影响，”声明继续说道。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Elsbeth did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 埃尔斯贝斯的发言人没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: As part of the organizing push, production assistants have voted to unionize on The Pitt, Abbott Elementary, All American, Georgie & Mandy’s First Marriage, Chicago Fire, Chicago Med, The Four Seasons, Cupertino and Dexter’s Resurrection.
paras.zh: 作为组织推动的一部分，制作助理们投票决定在《皮特》、《雅培小学》、《全美美国人》、《乔吉和曼迪的第一次婚姻》、《芝加哥火焰》、《芝加哥医学》、《四个季节》、《库比蒂诺》和《德克斯特的复活》等节目中加入工会。

paras.en: “Production in New York is booming right now, and so is this movement. PAs across the city are deciding that the people who keep these sets running deserve a union too,” said Ethan Ravens, director of organizing for Production Assistants United and LiUNA 724.
paras.zh: “纽约的制作现在正在蓬勃发展，这场运动也在蓬勃发展。全市的 PA 都决定让这些设备保持运转的人也应该成立工会，”制作助理联合组织和 LiUNA 724 的组织总监伊森·雷文斯 (Ethan Ravens) 说。

articles.title: Jon Stewart Extends His ‘Daily Show’ Run Through 2028
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: The Daily Show and Jon Stewart are staying together for a couple more years.
paras.zh: 《每日秀》和乔恩·斯图尔特还要再在一起几年。

paras.en: Stewart has signed a two-year deal to continue as the once-a-week host of Comedy Central‘s late night show through 2028. He also remains an executive producer of the show every day of the week.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特已签署了一份为期两年的协议，将继续担任喜剧中心深夜节目每周一次的主持人，直至 2028 年。他还仍然担任该节目每周每一天的执行制片人。

paras.en: “Jon Stewart is a generational talent, and The Daily Show continues to be one of the most influential franchises on television and a cornerstone of Comedy Central,” said George Cheeks, co-chair and chief content officer of Skydance TV. “We are excited to continue our partnership with Jon and his award-winning news team.”
paras.zh: Skydance TV 联合主席兼首席内容官乔治·奇克斯 (George Cheeks) 表示：“乔恩·斯图尔特是一代天才，《每日秀》仍然是电视界最具影响力的系列剧之一，也是喜剧中心的基石。” “我们很高兴继续与乔恩及其屡获殊荣的新闻团队合作。”

paras.en: Stewart most recently signed a one-year deal to continue his duties on The Daily Show through 2026. With the end of that agreement approaching, he re-upped. The two-year deal, notably, extends Stewart’s run on the show through the 2028 presidential election cycle.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特最近签署了一份为期一年的协议，将在《每日秀》中继续履行职责直至 2026 年。随着协议到期的临近，他重新崛起。值得注意的是，这份为期两年的协议将斯图尔特在节目中的竞选时间延长到 2028 年总统选举周期。

paras.en: Stewart rejoined The Daily Show in 2024, anchoring the show once a week (usually on Mondays) and serving as an executive producer. He also hosts the related Weekly Show podcast. Daily Show correspondents Ronny Chieng, Josh Johnson, Jordan Klepper, Michael Kosta and Desi Lydic rotate hosting the Tuesday-Thursday shows; Troy Iwata and Grace Kuhlenschmidt are also correspondents.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特于 2024 年重新加入《每日秀》，每周主持一次节目（通常在周一）并担任执行制片人。他还主持相关的每周秀播客。 《每日秀》记者 Ronny Chieng、Josh Johnson、Jordan Klepper、Michael Kosta 和 Desi Lydic 轮流主持周二至周四的节目； Troy Iwata 和 Grace Kuhlenschmidt 也是记者。

paras.en: The long-time host’s return has helped The Daily Show’s ratings improve. The show’s third quarter audience of a little more than 1 million viewers was its largest for that quarter since 2018.
paras.zh: 这位长期主持人的回归帮助《每日秀》的收视率有所提高。该剧第三季度的观众人数略高于 100 万，这是自 2018 年以来该季度观众人数最多的一次。

paras.en: Jen Flanz is the showrunner for The Daily Show. She executive produces with Stewart and his long-time manager, James “Baby Doll” Dixon.
paras.zh: 珍·弗兰茨 (Jen Flanz) 是《每日秀》的节目主持人。她与斯图尔特和他的长期经理詹姆斯“娃娃”迪克森一起担任执行制片人。

articles.title: New RingConn Gen 3 Smart Ring Makes Awards Show Debut at Emmys Gifting Suite
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Following its Sept. 4 unveiling at IFA Berlin, RingConn Gen 3 was featured in the Official Emmys Giving Suite at the 78th annual awards show, bringing the new piece of wellness tech into the hands of TV’s most familiar faces. Jaclyn Smith, Angela Bassett, Dale Dickey, Jeff Hiller and Joy Sunday were among the stars who stopped by the backstage gifting station to test it out.
paras.zh: 继 9 月 4 日在柏林 IFA 展会上亮相后，RingConn Gen 3 出现在第 78 届年度颁奖典礼的官方艾美奖颁奖套件中，将这项全新的健康技术带到了电视界最熟悉的面孔的手中。 Jaclyn Smith、Angela Bassett、Dale Dickey、Jeff Hiller 和 Joy Sunday 等明星都来到后台礼品站进行了测试。

paras.en: The Emmys represent some of the brightest spotlight moments in television, celebrating the outstanding work and performances that take center stage. But behind every spotlight is countless hours of creating, preparing and recovering that make those moments possible. That is the idea RingConn hopes to bring to life through its presence in the Official Emmys Giving Suite. The brand believes that every meaningful moment is shaped by the days that come before it.
paras.zh: 艾美奖代表了电视界一些最耀眼的焦点时刻，庆祝占据舞台中心的杰出作品和表演。但每一次聚光灯的背后，都是无数个小时的创作、准备和恢复，才使得这些时刻成为可能。这就是 RingConn 希望通过其在艾美奖官方捐赠套件中实现的想法。该品牌相信每一个有意义的时刻都是由之前的日子塑造的。

paras.en: With RingConn’s around-the-clock companionship, users can gain a better understanding of their everyday patterns, from sleep and activity to stress and recovery, and develop a deeper awareness of their well-being along the way.
paras.zh: 借助 RingConn 的全天候陪伴，用户可以更好地了解自己的日常模式，从睡眠和活动到压力和恢复，并在此过程中更深入地了解自己的健康状况。

paras.en: Established in 2021, RingConn’s aim is equal parts physical and mental wellbeing. In such a competitive category, RingConn Gen 3 provides Vascular Trends insights for everyday wellness, up to 14 days of battery life with vibration off, plus Vibration Alerts for subtle, timely notifications when attention is needed.
paras.zh: RingConn 成立于 2021 年，其目标是身心健康。在竞争如此激烈的类别中，RingConn Gen 3 提供了日常健康的血管趋势洞察、振动关闭时长达 14 天的电池续航时间以及振动警报，可在需要注意时提供微妙、及时的通知。

paras.en: Notifications go beyond raw data, providing context around everyday wellness trends. Instead of presenting isolated numbers, RingConn Gen 3 combines individual data points to offer a broader view of wellness, with insights into patterns such as stress and recovery.
paras.zh: 通知超越原始数据，提供有关日常健康趋势的背景信息。 RingConn Gen 3 不是提供孤立的数字，而是结合各个数据点，提供更广泛的健康视角，并深入了解压力和恢复等模式。

paras.en: Simplicity translates into the product’s physical design too. RingConn’s signature round-inside, square-outside structure follows the natural curve of the finger. And its ultra-light design is built to stay comfortable day and night.
paras.zh: 简单性也体现在产品的物理设计中。 RingConn 标志性的内圆外方结构遵循手指的自然曲线。其超轻设计旨在让您日夜保持舒适。

paras.en: *RingConn Gen 3 is designed for general wellness and everyday health management purposes only and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition.
paras.zh: *RingConn Gen 3 专为一般健康和日常健康管理目的而设计，并非旨在诊断、治疗、治愈或预防任何疾病或医疗状况。

articles.title: Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop

paras.en: Apple announced a product launch event on Oct. 28, sending invitations on Monday to media and analysts for an "Apple Experience in Los Angeles".
paras.zh: 苹果公司宣布将于 10 月 28 日举行产品发布会，并于周一向媒体和分析师发出“洛杉矶苹果体验”邀请。

paras.en: The email says "Pro and tell," suggesting the launch will focus on high-end "Pro" devices with powerful homegrown chips.
paras.zh: 该电子邮件称“Pro and Tell”，暗示此次发布将专注于配备强大国产芯片的高端“Pro”设备。

paras.en: Ben Reitzes, an analyst at Melius Research, wrote in a note on Monday that he expects new Macs to be introduced, "including a touchscreen notebook," this fall. He said that for CEO John Ternus, who succeeded Tim Cook last month, the launch cadence marks a "meaningful shift" from what has been two events a year.
paras.zh: Melius Research 分析师 Ben Reitzes 在周一的一份报告中写道，他预计今年秋季将推出新款 Mac，“包括触摸屏笔记本电脑”。他表示，对于上个月接替蒂姆·库克的首席执行官约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）来说，此次发布节奏标志着一年两次活动的“有意义的转变”。

paras.en: It will be Apple's third launch in Ternus' brief tenure, following an event at company headquarters for new iPhones, including the foldable Duo, and a gathering in New York centered around smart home hubs and a new speaker with a screen called HomeView.
paras.zh: 这将是苹果在 Ternus 短暂任期内的第三次发布会，此前在公司总部举行了包括可折叠 Duo 在内的新款 iPhone 的活动，并在纽约举行了一场以智能家居中心和名为 HomeView 的屏幕的新型扬声器为中心的聚会。

paras.en: Apple updated its Mac Mini and Mac Studio desktops with new chips in August, and refreshed its MacBook Pro in the spring, along with a new low-cost MacBook Neo. But Apple's iMac desktop hasn't been updated since October 2024.
paras.zh: 苹果在 8 月份更新了 Mac Mini 和 Mac Studio 台式机，配备了新芯片，并在春季更新了 MacBook Pro，以及新款低成本 MacBook Neo。但苹果的 iMac 桌面自 2024 年 10 月以来就没有更新过。

paras.en: In the most recent quarter, Apple's Mac sales accounted for about 10% of overall revenue, as the company remains heavily reliant on iPhones.
paras.zh: 最近一个季度，苹果的 Mac 销量约占总收入的 10%，因为该公司仍然严重依赖 iPhone。

paras.en: Still, Macs have become one of the strongest parts of Apple's artificial intelligence story, thanks to its chips that can access more memory at higher speeds than other consumer processors. Apple shares are up 26% so far this year, outperforming the S&P 500.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，Mac 仍成为苹果人工智能故事中最强大的部分之一，这要归功于其芯片能够以比其他消费处理器更高的速度访问更多内存。今年迄今为止，苹果股价已上涨 26%，跑赢标准普尔 500 指数。

paras.en: Last week, Apple and Meta teamed up to bring a large open-weight model, developed by Meta, to multiple high-end Mac Studios.
paras.zh: 上周，Apple 和 Meta 联手将 Meta 开发的大型开放重量模型引入多个高端 Mac 工作室。

paras.en: Apple has historically been dismissive of touchscreen laptops, with software chief Craig Federighi explaining in 2018 that the ergonomics would fatigue users.
paras.zh: 苹果历来对触摸屏笔记本电脑不屑一顾，软件主管克雷格·费德里吉 (Craig Federighi) 在 2018 年解释说，人体工学会让用户感到疲劳。

articles.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why

paras.en: Decades before Siri or Alexa or ChatGPT, there was a real person, almost always a woman, at the center of the information world. She was so vital, most long-distance communication could not happen without her.
paras.zh: 在 Siri、Alexa 或 ChatGPT 之前几十年，信息世界的中心有一个真实的人，几乎总是女性。她是如此重要，没有她，大多数长途通信都无法进行。

paras.en: She was the telephone switch operator, and at one time she was part of the single largest occupation for white, U.S.-born women under age 20.
paras.zh: 她是电话接线员，一度是美国出生的 20 岁以下白人女性最大的单一职业之一。

paras.en: The world is struggling to figure out what the dawn of artificial intelligence means for society, culture and the economy. A lot of ordinary Americans are just wondering what it means for their jobs.
paras.zh: 世界正在努力弄清楚人工智能的曙光对社会、文化和经济意味着什么。许多普通美国人只是想知道这对他们的工作意味着什么。

paras.en: The history of technological progress — from automated telephone switches to the introduction of the washing machine and the personal computer — can offer some guidance. And that guidance suggests women are likely to be among the most affected by AI.
paras.zh: 技术进步的历史——从自动电话交换机到洗衣机和个人电脑的引入——可以提供一些指导。该指南表明，女性可能是受人工智能影响最严重的群体之一。

paras.en: "AI is focused on routine tasks and numbers and finding patterns, and those types of jobs are the clerical, administrative jobs that a lot of women hold,'' said Ariane Hegewisch, a senior research fellow at the Institute for Women's Policy Research. "It's still 90% of secretaries and clerical workers who are women."
paras.zh: 妇女政策研究所高级研究员 Ariane Hegewisch 表示：“人工智能专注于日常任务、数字和发现模式，而这些类型的工作是许多女性担任的文书、行政工作。”“90% 的秘书和文书工作人员仍然是女性。”

paras.en: New research backs this up. The International Labour Organization in March concluded that nearly 1 in 10 women in high-income countries work in occupations at the highest risk from AI.
paras.zh: 新的研究支持了这一点。国际劳工组织三月份的结论是，高收入国家中有近十分之一的女性从事人工智能风险最高的职业。

paras.en: In the 1940s, nearly 95% of America's telephone operators were female. It was a relatively well-paying job for women at the time, and a complicated one: It took months of training to be able to handle the several hundred calls an hour that could come in at peak times. Operators were expected to be speedy, precise — and polite.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 40 年代，美国近 95% 的电话接线员都是女性。对于当时的女性来说，这是一份薪酬相对较高的工作，但也是一项复杂的工作：需要经过数月的培训才能处理高峰时段每小时可能打来的数百个电话。操作员被要求快速、精确且有礼貌。

paras.en: These women were hit hard when AT&T introduced the automated telephone switch. It was one of the largest automation investments in history — a close analog to the massive AI investment now underway — and created one of the biggest technological shocks the nation had ever seen.
paras.zh: 当 AT&T 推出自动电话交换机时，这些女性受到了沉重打击。这是历史上最大的自动化投资之一——与目前正在进行的大规模人工智能投资非常相似——并造成了美国有史以来最大的技术冲击之一。

paras.en: In the decades after the automated switch was popularized, an estimated 75,000 operator jobs vanished.
paras.zh: 在自动开关普及后的几十年里，估计有 75,000 个操作员工作岗位消失。

paras.en: Economists James Feigenbaum at Boston University and Daniel P. Gross at Duke University's Fuqua School of Business studied census and paycheck data from the time and followed local employment trends along the path of AT&T's rolling investment in switches across the nation.
paras.zh: 波士顿大学的经济学家 James Feigenbaum 和杜克大学 Fuqua 商学院的 Daniel P. Gross 研究了当时的人口普查和薪资数据，并沿着 AT&T 在全国范围内滚动投资交换机的路径跟踪了当地的就业趋势。

paras.en: "The effect of this shock on incumbent operators was to dispossess many of their jobs and careers," they wrote in 2020. Many switchboard operators wound up in lower-paying jobs — or dropped out of the workforce entirely, they found.
paras.zh: 他们在 2020 年写道：“这种冲击对现有运营商的影响是剥夺了他们的许多工作和职业生涯。”他们发现，许多总机运营商最终只能从事低薪工作，或者完全退出劳动力市场。

paras.en: Economist David Autor said this outcome reflects the reality that many workers are already in their highest and best-paying occupation. When the job goes away, the next step is often down.
paras.zh: 经济学家戴维·奥托尔表示，这一结果反映了一个现实，即许多工人已经处于最高、收入最高的职业。当工作消失时，下一步往往会被取消。

paras.en: "Most people are not changing careers very often. They make their career decisions early, and they stick with those careers," he said. "If those careers, if the value of that work ... suddenly goes out of fashion, becomes technologically obsolete, they're going to, in general, do something not as good."
paras.zh: “大多数人不会经常改变职业。他们很早就做出了职业决定，并且坚持这些职业，”他说。 “如果这些职业，如果这项工作的价值……突然过时，在技术上变得过时，那么总的来说，他们会做一些不太好的事情。”

paras.en: But Feigenbaum and Gross also discovered that the next generation of women fared better.
paras.zh: 但费根鲍姆和格罗斯还发现，下一代女性的表现更好。

paras.en: "Future workers found work in other fields, often taking up similar-quality jobs," they wrote, as the younger workers were "more adaptive to an evolving labor market ... Anxiety over the opportunities available to future generations proved to be somewhat misplaced."
paras.zh: 他们写道：“未来的工人在其他领域找到了工作，通常从事类似质量的工作。”因为年轻的工人“更能适应不断变化的劳动力市场……事实证明，对子孙后代可获得的机会的焦虑有些错误。”

paras.en: In other words: One type of job went away, but other work emerged over time that was just as good.
paras.zh: 换句话说：一种工作消失了，但随着时间的推移，其他同样好的工作出现了。

paras.en: By the 1950s, another technological innovation would come along and have a profound effect on women: the washing machine.
paras.zh: 到了 20 世纪 50 年代，另一项技术创新出现，并对女性产生了深远的影响：洗衣机。

paras.en: Dubbed "engines of liberation" in a seminal paper on the topic by University of Pennsylvania economist Jeremy Greenwood and others, washing machines and other appliances dramatically reduced the time women spent on unpaid housework. That meant time could be reallocated to a paycheck outside the home, even as women's responsibility for the home remained.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学经济学家杰里米·格林伍德等人在一篇关于该主题的开创性论文中将洗衣机和其他电器称为“解放引擎”，洗衣机和其他电器大大减少了女性花在无酬家务上的时间。这意味着即使女性仍然承担家庭责任，时间也可以重新分配到家庭之外的薪水上。

paras.en: From 1950 to 1980, as gender norms changed, the number of employed women in the U.S. grew by more than 25 million. Their participation rate, or share of the female population in the labor force, grew to 52% from 34%. At the same time, 16 million more men found work, though the male participation rate dropped by 5 percentage points.
paras.zh: 从 1950 年到 1980 年，随着性别规范的变化，美国就业女性人数增加了超过 2500 万。她们的参与率，即女性劳动力中的比例，从 34% 增长到 52%。与此同时，新增 1600 万男性找到工作，但男性参与率下降了 5 个百分点。

paras.en: The relevant question for the AI boom today: How did the economy suddenly find jobs for these women? If AI creates a vast new pool of available workers, can the economy put them to work?
paras.zh: 当今人工智能热潮的相关问题是：经济是如何突然为这些女性找到工作的？如果人工智能创造了大量新的可用工人，经济能否让他们工作？

paras.en: First, the very entry of women into the workforce meant demand for tasks once done at home moved into the paid economy, services such as childcare and food preparation. Second, as the nation grew wealthier, other employment opportunities for women emerged in the service economy — in retail, restaurants, leisure and hospitality, and even some professional services. And third, as American businesses grew, they needed more people to handle the paperwork — everything from payroll to customer accounts.
paras.zh: 首先，女性进入劳动力市场意味着对曾经在家完成的任务的需求转移到付费经济、儿童保育和食品准备等服务中。其次，随着国家变得更加富裕，服务经济中出现了女性的其他就业机会——零售、餐饮、休闲和酒店业，甚至一些专业服务业。第三，随着美国企业的发展，他们需要更多的人来处理文书工作——从工资单到客户账户的一切事务。

paras.en: Changes to the economy and businesses were partly related to the entry of women into the workforce, but it was also partly random luck that the U.S. was booming and businesses were changing to need more office workers.
paras.zh: 经济和企业的变化部分与女性进入劳动力市场有关，但也有部分是随机的运气，因为美国正在蓬勃发展，企业正在发生变化，需要更多的办公室职员。

paras.en: "Between 1940 and 1980, there was a ton of new work created in the U.S. economy, and it was in office and clerical work that was accessible to people with a high school education,'' Autor said.
paras.zh: 奥托尔说：“1940 年至 1980 年间，美国经济创造了大量新工作，其中办公室和文书工作是受过高中教育的人可以从事的。”

paras.en: The next big revolution affecting women in the workplace was the personal computer.
paras.zh: 影响职场女性的下一场重大革命是个人电脑。

paras.en: Before PCs arrived on the scene, women were the backbone of office infrastructure. According to the 1980 U.S. census, nearly 4.7 million Americans worked as secretaries, stenographers and typists. More than 98% were women.
paras.zh: 在个人电脑出现之前，女性是办公室基础设施的支柱。根据 1980 年美国人口普查，近 470 万美国人担任秘书、速记员和打字员。 98%以上是女性。

paras.en: When IBM introduced the personal computer in 1981, followed by the advent of Microsoft Word just two years later, some of the middlemen, or in this case, middlewomen, became obsolete. It didn't eliminate writing, filing or editing. It simply shifted a big chunk of those tasks from dedicated clerical workers to others in the office — executives could type their own reports, book their own travel and print their own papers.
paras.zh: 当 IBM 于 1981 年推出个人计算机时，两年后 Microsoft Word 又出现了，一些中间商（或者在本例中为中间女）已经过时了。它并没有消除写作、归档或编辑。它只是将大部分任务从专门的文员转移到了办公室的其他人身上——高管们可以自己打印报告、预订旅行并打印自己的文件。

paras.en: But the PC wasn't entirely bad news for women in the workforce. Studies show women were already more likely than men to be using a computer at work at the dawn of the PC era. The PC put new tools at their fingertips: spreadsheets and databases and general computing power. While many roles were eliminated, many women adapted and found new ways to use the emerging technology to make themselves indispensable to their employers.
paras.zh: 但个人电脑对于职场女性来说并不完全是坏消息。研究表明，在个人电脑时代初期，女性在工作中使用电脑的可能性已经高于男性。个人电脑让新工具触手可及：电子表格、数据库以及通用计算能力。虽然许多角色被取消，但许多女性适应并找到了使用新兴技术的新方法，使自己成为雇主不可或缺的一部分。

paras.en: That's a potential outcome for AI. In some cases, it will eliminate tasks but not entire jobs, enhancing the time and ability of a worker to do the remaining value-added jobs that only humans can do.
paras.zh: 这是人工智能的潜在结果。在某些情况下，它将消除一些任务，但不会消除整个工作，从而提高工人完成只有人类才能完成的剩余增值工作的时间和能力。

paras.en: A 2022 paper by Marcus Dillender and Eliza Forsythe found that when companies adopted software to do office and administrative work, it resulted in a 1% decline in employment in the sector but a 3% increase in wages for college graduates.
paras.zh: Marcus Dillender 和 Eliza Forsythe 在 2022 年发表的一篇论文发现，当公司采用软件进行办公室和行政工作时，导致该行业的就业人数下降 1%，但大学毕业生的工资却增加了 3%。

paras.en: Many more women have earned college and advanced degrees, and hold managerial jobs, than when other technologies ripped through the economy, offering some potential protection from automation. But maybe not for long: One of the promises of AI is that it will move up the value chain of the jobs performed by humans.
paras.zh: 与其他技术席卷经济时相比，获得大学和高级学位并担任管理职位的女性数量更多，为自动化提供了一些潜在的保护。但也许不会太久：人工智能的承诺之一是它将提升人类工作的价值链。

paras.en: Whatever capabilities the new technology may have now, the outlook is unclear because, Hegewisch says, somewhat ominously, "AI can learn."
paras.zh: 无论新技术现在可能具有什么能力，前景尚不明朗，因为赫格维施有点不祥地表示，“人工智能可以学习”。

articles.title: OpenAI bugging case: Saudi consulate offers to pay bail for suspect

paras.en: Federal prosecutors in a new court filing warned that the alleged bugging of an OpenAI executive conference room by a Saudi national working as an engineer at that artificial intelligence giant "could pose a danger to the national security of the United States."
paras.zh: 联邦检察官在一份新的法庭文件中警告称，一名在人工智能巨头担任工程师的沙特国民涉嫌窃听 OpenAI 的执行会议室，“可能对美国的国家安全构成威胁”。

paras.en: Prosecutors said that in the days around the time that Abdulrahman Alfozan allegedly planted a recording device in a television in that room in OpenAI's San Francisco headquarters on Sept. 28, "OpenAI executives met with government officials in that very room."
paras.zh: 检察官表示，9 月 28 日，Abdulrahman Alfozan 据称在 OpenAI 旧金山总部那个房间的电视机里安装了录音设备，“OpenAI 高管就在那个房间会见了政府官员”。

paras.en: The filing came as Alfozan, 35, faces a detention hearing in U.S. District Court in San Francisco on Monday. The U.S. Attorney's Office for the Northern District of California is asking a judge to keep Alfozan held without bail.
paras.zh: 该文件提交之际，35 岁的阿尔福赞周一在旧金山美国地方法院面临拘留听证会。美国加州北区检察官办公室要求法官继续关押阿尔福赞，不得保释。

paras.en: "This is an ongoing investigation that may yet result in more serious charges," the filing says.
paras.zh: 文件称：“这是一项正在进行的调查，可能会导致更严重的指控。”

paras.en: The filing cites his ties to Saudi Arabia, his financial resources, and the fact that his wife and their 3-month-old baby flew there on the heels of his Oct. 9 arrest.
paras.zh: 该文件列举了他与沙特阿拉伯的关系、他的财务资源，以及他的妻子和他们 3 个月大的孩子在他 10 月 9 日被捕后飞往沙特阿拉伯的事实。

paras.en: Alfozan's lawyer, in a court filing, revealed that the Saudi Consulate in Los Angeles offered to bail the full bail for the defendant if a judge agrees to release him on bond. A letter from the consulate was included in a motion for pretrial release by the lawyer.
paras.zh: 阿尔福赞的律师在一份法庭文件中透露，如果法官同意保释他，沙特驻洛杉矶领事馆愿意为被告提供全额保释。律师提出的审前释放动议中包含了领事馆的一封信。

paras.en: Prosecutors said Alfozan had been "in frequent communications via WhatsApp with a member of the Saudi Royal Family" throughout 2025 and 2026.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，阿尔福赞在 2025 年和 2026 年期间“通过 WhatsApp 与沙特王室成员频繁沟通”。

paras.en: Alfozan communicated with the Saudi royal as recently as Oct. 5 — four days before he was arrested, prosecutors said.
paras.zh: 检察官称，阿尔福赞最近于 10 月 5 日与沙特王室进行了沟通，即他被捕的四天前。

paras.en: Prosecutors did not identify the Saudi royal or say how Alfozan knew that person.
paras.zh: 检察官没有透露这位沙特王室成员的身份，也没有透露阿尔福赞是如何认识这个人的。

paras.en: "Among other things, the individual [the royal family member] told the defendant [Alfozan] that an artificial intelligence initiative was being launched in Saudi Arabia and wanted the defendant to join it," the filing says.
paras.zh: 文件称：“除其他外，该人（王室成员）告诉被告（阿尔福赞）沙特阿拉伯正在启动一项人工智能计划，并希望被告加入。”

paras.en: "In May 2026, the individual told the defendant, 'Saudi needs you more then [sic] the US!' to which the defendant responded '100,' indicating he agreed," prosecutors wrote.
paras.zh: “2026 年 5 月，此人告诉被告，‘沙特比美国更需要你！’被告回答‘100’，表明他同意，”检察官写道。

paras.en: "The individual repeatedly tried to recruit the defendant and asked when he planned to leave OpenAI," prosecutors wrote. "At the time, the defendant said he wouldn't leave until his stock vested."
paras.zh: 检察官写道：“此人多次试图招募被告，并询问他计划何时离开 OpenAI。” “当时，被告表示，在股票归属之前他不会离开。”

paras.en: The filing does not say the Saudi royal directed Alfozan to install a recording device at OpenAI or steal information from the AI giant.
paras.zh: 该文件并未表示沙特王室指示阿尔福赞在 OpenAI 上安装录音设备或窃取这家人工智能巨头的信息。

paras.en: Alfozan, who lives near the San Francisco airport, is a venture partner at Raed Ventures, a Saudi venture capital firm. Prince Khalid bin Bader Al Saud, a member of the Saudi royal family, joined the firm as a venture partner in 2025. In their filing, prosecutors did not mention that prince by name, or say that the unidentified royal who communicated with Alfozan had ties to Raed.
paras.zh: Alfozan 住在旧金山机场附近，是沙特风险投资公司 Raed Ventures 的风险合伙人。沙特王室成员哈立德·本·巴德尔·阿尔·沙特王子于 2025 年作为风险合伙人加入该公司。检察官在文件中没有提及这位王子的名字，也没有说与阿尔福赞沟通的身份不明的王室成员与 Raed 有联系。

paras.en: Prosecutors in the same filing said the Saudi government and then, shortly afterward, a member of the Saudi military booked separate flights for Alfozan's wife, Lujain Alassaf, and their three-month-old son to fly out of the United States after his Oct. 9 arrest upended plans for the three of them to fly as a family to Saudi Arabia on Oct. 12.
paras.zh: 检察官在同一份文件中表示，沙特政府以及不久之后的一名沙特军方成员为阿尔福赞的妻子卢贾因·阿拉萨夫 (Lujain Alassaf) 和他们三个月大的儿子预订了单独的航班，以便在阿尔福赞 10 月 9 日被捕后，他们三人一家人于 10 月 12 日飞往沙特阿拉伯的计划离开美国。

paras.en: The wife and son flew from San Francisco to Doha, Qatar, on Oct. 10 on a business-class flight paid for by the unidentified member of the Saudi military, the filing said.
paras.zh: 文件称，妻子和儿子于 10 月 10 日乘坐商务舱航班从旧金山飞往卡塔尔多哈，费用由一名身份不明的沙特军方人员支付。

paras.en: Alfozan has been in jail since his arrest on a charge of using or endeavoring to use an electronic, mechanical, or other device to intercept oral communications. He faces a maximum possible sentence of five years in prison if convicted. OpenAI fired him after his arrest.
paras.zh: 阿尔福赞因被指控使用或试图使用电子、机械或其他设备拦截口头通讯而被捕，目前已入狱。如果罪名成立，他最高可能面临五年监禁。 OpenAI 在他被捕后解雇了他。

paras.en: Alfozan's lawyer, William Pernik, in a separate filing asked that the defendant be released with home detention and GPS monitoring, and a bond co-signed by others, and "supported by the written undertaking of the Consulate General of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia."
paras.zh: 阿尔福赞的律师威廉·佩尔尼克(William Pernik)在另一份文件中要求释放被告，并予以家庭拘留和GPS监控，并由其他人共同签署保证金，并“得到沙特阿拉伯王国总领事馆的书面承诺支持”。

paras.en: The Saudi embassy in Washington, D.C., has not responded to CNBC's requests for comment on Alfozan since his arrest was announced on Oct. 13.
paras.zh: 自 10 月 13 日宣布阿尔福赞被捕以来，沙特驻华盛顿大使馆尚未回应 CNBC 就阿尔福赞发表评论的请求。

paras.en: FBI Director Kash Patel, when Alfozan's arrest was announced, said he allegedly concealed the recording device to secretly capture sensitive communications about the company's artificial intelligence technology.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔在阿尔福赞被捕的消息宣布后表示，据称他隐藏了录音设备，以秘密捕获有关该公司人工智能技术的敏感通信。

paras.en: Prosecutors in their new filing also argued that Alfozan is a flight risk because of his access to "ample resources ... and what appears to be considerable support from a foreign government that has (i) no extradition treaty with the United States; (ii) limitless resources; and (iii) the ability to provide extraordinary travel assistance, including based on similar circumstances in this District," the filing said.
paras.zh: 检察官在新提交的文件中还辩称，阿尔福赞有潜逃风险，因为他获得了“充足的资源......并且似乎得到了外国政府的大力支持，该外国政府（i）与美国没有引渡条约；（ii）无限的资源；（iii）有能力提供特别的旅行援助，包括基于该地区的类似情况，”该文件称。

paras.en: "He has the connections needed not only to flee, but to build a new life in Saudi Arabia. The Court should order the defendant detained pending trial," prosecutors wrote.
paras.zh: 检察官写道：“他不仅拥有逃离所需的联系，而且还拥有在沙特阿拉伯建立新生活所需的联系。法院应下令拘留被告候审。”

paras.en: Alfozan has spent about 15 years in the United States, working at various tech companies, including Meta, and obtaining a master's degree from the University of California, Berkeley in 2025. He is a legal permanent resident of the United States and has applied to become a naturalized citizen.
paras.zh: Alfozan在美国生活了大约15年，曾在包括Meta在内的多家科技公司工作，并于2025年获得加州大学伯克利分校硕士学位。他是美国合法永久居民，并已申请成为入籍公民。

paras.en: For his most recent job, as an OpenAI engineer, Alfozan was hired in July 2025 with an annual base salary of $325,000, which was later increased to $385,000, prosecutors said in their filing. He also received a new hire equity grant of $2.2 million in profit participating units, the filing said.
paras.zh: 检察官在文件中称，Alfozan 最近的工作是 OpenAI 工程师，他于 2025 年 7 月受聘，基本年薪为 325,000 美元，后来增加到 385,000 美元。文件称，他还获得了 220 万美元的利润参与单位新聘员工股权补助。

paras.en: Alfozan planned to take two months of parental leave after the birth of his son, according to the filing. He and his family were scheduled to fly one-way to Saudi Arabia on Oct. 12.
paras.zh: 文件显示，阿尔福赞计划在儿子出生后休两个月的育儿假。他和家人原定于 10 月 12 日乘单程航班飞往沙特阿拉伯。

paras.en: "On or about September 28, 2026 — about two weeks before their scheduled flight—the defendant inserted a surreptitious audio recording device into a USB port on the back of a television in an executive OpenAI conference room, where the device remained for at least multiple days," the filing said.
paras.zh: 文件称：“2026 年 9 月 28 日左右，即预定航班起飞前大约两周，被告将一个秘密录音设备插入 OpenAI 行政会议室电视机背面的 USB 端口，该设备在那里至少保留了多天。”

paras.en: The conference room is frequently used for "discussions of highly confidential technical, commercial, and strategic information, including proprietary research, as well as nonpublic information about OpenAI's technical progress and strategic decisions, capabilities, priorities, government engagements, and commercial relationships," the filing said.
paras.zh: 文件称，该会议室经常用于“讨论高度机密的技术、商业和战略信息，包括专有研究，以及有关 OpenAI 技术进展和战略决策、能力、优先事项、政府参与和商业关系的非公开信息”。

paras.en: The filing also says that after Alfozan's arrest, his iPhone was found to contain photographs dated Sept. 22 to 28 depicting "at least one additional concealed device as well as what appear to be the input/output panels on televisions and other electronic devices in various locations in OpenAI buildings, including another conference room where sensitive meetings frequently occurred."
paras.zh: 文件还称，Alfozan 被捕后，他的 iPhone 被发现包含日期为 9 月 22 日至 28 日的照片，这些照片描绘了“至少一个额外的隐藏设备，以及 OpenAI 大楼各个地点的电视和其他电子设备的输入/输出面板，其中包括另一间经常举行敏感会议的会议室。”

paras.en: "The defendant's residence contained several electronic components similar to those in the
paras.zh: “被告的住所内藏有一些与被告住所类似的电子元件。

paras.en: customized devices the defendant installed in the OpenAI conference room," the filing said.
paras.zh: 被告在 OpenAI 会议室安装了定制设备，”文件称。

paras.en: OpenAI also found another recording device in a bag Alfozan inadvertently left behind in a printer room on Oct. 5, the same day he was seen on camera checking behind the TV where the first recording device had been left in the conference room, prosecutors have said. The camera was installed after OpenAI discovered the recording device on Sept. 30, prosecutors said.
paras.zh: 检察官称，10 月 5 日，OpenAI 还在 Alfozan 无意中留在打印机室的一个包里发现了另一个录音设备，同一天，有人拍到他在电视后面检查第一个录音设备留在会议室的情况。检察官称，OpenAI 在 9 月 30 日发现录音设备后安装了该摄像头。

paras.en: His cellphone also contained a deleted note from September "with links to various recording devices, including devices made by Seeed Studio, the manufacturer of the devices OpenAI found in its offices and the devices FBI agents found in the defendant's residence," the filing said.
paras.zh: 文件称，他的手机还包含一张 9 月份被删除的便条，“其中包含各种录音设备的链接，包括 Seeed Studio 制造的设备，该设备是 OpenAI 在其办公室发现的设备的制造商，以及 FBI 特工在被告住所发现的设备”。

paras.en: Another note, entitled "OpenAI leave," suggests that Alfozan planned early pickup "of the devices he had installed or intended to install and then extending his planned parental 'leave to full,'" the filing said.
paras.zh: 文件称，另一份题为“OpenAI 休假”的说明表明，阿尔福赞计划提前领取“他已安装或打算安装的设备，然后延长他计划的育儿假”。

paras.en: In addition to being in contact with a Saudi royal, Alfozan "was pursuing other opportunities in Saudi Arabia, including participating in the Misk Foundation's '2030 Leaders' program, which would have required his in- person participation in Riyadh," prosecutors said.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，除了与沙特王室保持联系外，阿尔福赞“还在沙特阿拉伯寻求其他机会，包括参加米斯克基金会的‘2030领袖’计划，该计划需要他亲自前往利雅得参与”。

paras.en: A day before she left the U.S. with their baby, Alfozan's wife told FBI agents who interviewed her that "her U.S. visa was expiring and that she and her son were permanently moving back to Saudi Arabia — and that her husband, the defendant, eventually intended to do the same," the filing said.
paras.zh: 文件称，在她带着孩子离开美国的前一天，阿尔福赞的妻子告诉采访她的联邦调查局特工，“她的美国签证即将到期，她和她的儿子将永久搬回沙特阿拉伯，而她的丈夫，即被告，最终也打算这样做”。

paras.en: Alfozan's lawyer, Pernik, in his request that Alfozan be released into home detention, said, "nationality is not evidence of flight," and that his planned travel to Saudi Arabia was for "family and immigration reasons."
paras.zh: 阿尔福赞的律师佩尔尼克在要求将阿尔福赞释放至家庭拘留时表示，“国籍并不是逃跑的证据”，他计划前往沙特阿拉伯是出于“家庭和移民原因”。

paras.en: Alfozan's wife's 60-day post-employment grace period for her own visa was expiring on Oct. 12, the originally scheduled date of their flight, the lawyer said.
paras.zh: 律师称，阿尔福赞妻子的签证 60 天离职后宽限期将于 10 月 12 日到期，也就是他们原定的航班日期。

paras.en: "Mr. Alfozan was made aware of OpenAI finding the device per its own filings and OpenAI's
paras.zh: “Alfozan 先生获悉 OpenAI 根据其自己的文件和 OpenAI 的文件发现了该设备

paras.en: public statements, approximately eight to ten days before he was arrested," Pernik wrote. "If his intention was to flee, he would have done so at that time."
paras.zh: 佩尔尼克写道：“他在被捕前大约八到十天发表了公开声明。如果他打算逃跑，他当时就会这么做。”

paras.en: The lawyer also said that Alfozan, who had booked a one-way ticket to Saudi Arabia for himself and his family, regularly bought one-way tickets because he has learned they are more cost-effective than changing his flights at the last minute.
paras.zh: 该律师还表示，阿尔福赞为自己和家人订了一张飞往沙特阿拉伯的单程机票，他经常购买单程机票，因为他发现单程机票比在最后一刻更改航班更划算。

paras.en: Pernik also wrote that the Saudi Consulate General confirmed in writing to the U.S. Pretrial Services Office on Thursday that it "'will not issue any travel documents' to Mr. Alfozan during his release and that, if he requests one, it 'undertakes to promptly notify U.S. Pretrial Services.'"
paras.zh: 佩尔尼克还写道，沙特总领事馆周四向美国预审服务办公室书面确认，“在阿尔福赞先生获释期间，‘不会向他发放任何旅行证件’，如果他要求提供旅行证件，‘沙特总领事馆承诺立即通知美国预审服务办公室’”。

paras.en: The attorney argued that prosecutors have not shown that Alfozan is a serious flight risk.
paras.zh: 律师辩称，检察官没有证明阿福赞有严重的潜逃风险。

paras.en: "Mr. Alfozan has lived in the United States for fifteen years and in the Bay Area for roughly ten," Pernik wrote. "Fifty-four people, at least twenty-seven of them in the Bay Area, have written to the Court, and they describe someone who organizes dinners, welcomes newcomers, mentors students, and shows up for friends' weddings, birthdays, and moves."
paras.zh: “阿尔福赞先生在美国生活了十五年，在湾区生活了大约十年，”佩尼克写道。 “有 54 人，其中至少有 27 人在湾区，写信给法院，他们描述了一个组织晚宴、欢迎新人、指导学生、出席朋友婚礼、生日和搬家的人。”

paras.en: "That is not the profile of a person with one foot out the door," Pernik said.
paras.zh: “这不是一个人一只脚走出门的样子，”佩尼克说。

paras.en: — Jordan Novet reported from San Francisco.
paras.zh: ——乔丹·诺维特从旧金山报道。

articles.title: The mechanics of honeybee stingers, microplastic health risks and new findings on postmenopausal ovaries

paras.en: Rachel Feltman: Happy Monday, listeners! For Scientific American’s Science Quickly, I’m Rachel Feltman. Let’s get this week off to a great start by catching up on some recent science and tech news you may have missed.
paras.zh: 雷切尔·费尔特曼：听众们，星期一快乐！我是《科学美国人》的《科学快报》的雷切尔·费尔特曼。让我们通过了解一些您可能错过的最新科技新闻来为本周有个良好的开始。

paras.en: We’ll start with some potentially paradigm-shifting research on the human ovary. According to a new study published in Aging Cell, these aren’t just reproductive organs. Long after ovaries stop producing eggs, the researchers say, the organs continue to evolve.
paras.zh: 我们将从一些关于人类卵巢的潜在范式转变的研究开始。根据《衰老细胞》发表的一项新研究，这些不仅仅是生殖器官。研究人员说，在卵巢停止产生卵子很久之后，器官仍在继续进化。

paras.en: Building off of previous work in mice, the study examined normal ovarian tissue from 28 postmenopausal women between the ages of 50 and 75. The researchers analyzed nearly 6,000 different protein groups to track not just how postmenopausal ovaries differed from reproductively active ones but to see how they changed over decades of postreproductive life. And they did find changes. While the younger ovarian samples had more proteins associated with maintaining tissue structure, samples from older subjects had more proteins tied to inflammation and immune activity.
paras.zh: 在之前的小鼠研究基础上，这项研究检查了 28 名年龄在 50 岁到 75 岁之间的绝经后女性的正常卵巢组织。研究人员分析了近 6000 种不同的蛋白质组，不仅追踪绝经后卵巢与生殖活跃卵巢的差异，而且了解它们在数十年的生殖后生活中如何变化。他们确实发现了变化。虽然年轻的卵巢样本含有更多与维持组织结构相关的蛋白质，但年长受试者的样本含有更多与炎症和免疫活性相关的蛋白质。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: What remains to be seen is whether postmenopausal ovaries are doing something beneficial or something harmful—or whether that’s a scale that can tip one way or the other depending on unknown factors. Given how long the ovaries have broadly been treated as useless bystanders once fertile years are past, we’ll probably be working to uncover their mysteries for quite some time.
paras.zh: 还有待观察的是绝经后卵巢是否正在做有益的事情或有害的事情，或者是否是一个可以根据未知因素向一侧或另一侧倾斜的天平。考虑到一旦生育年龄过去，卵巢长期以来一直被视为无用的旁观者，我们可能需要在相当长的一段时间内努力揭开它们的神秘面纱。

paras.en: Staying on the health beat, let’s talk about microplastics. One of the reasons that plastic has become such a ubiquitous material for things like food packaging and toys is that it’s meant to be really stable, in the chemical sense of the word—it’s a polymer, which is a long chain of molecules that doesn’t really easily react with other molecules it comes into contact with. But the stability of a polymer doesn’t mean the plastic object it ends up in is totally inert. Lots of additives commonly used in plastics, like flame retardants and colorants, are prone to leach out into surrounding materials. Bisphenol A, or BPA, which helps make plastic clear and durable, is just one particularly infamous example of an additive that seeps into food and can interfere with human hormone signalling. We also now know that microplastics—tiny particles that flake away into the environment as factors like heat and UV exposure cause plastic to degrade—have made their way into locations as remote as Antarctica and as intimate as human placentas and brains. While research on the exact impacts of microplastic on human health is very much in its early stages, they’ve been linked to inflammation, cellular damage, altered metabolic function and other serious issues in animal studies.
paras.zh: 保持健康节拍，让我们来谈谈微塑料。塑料成为食品包装和玩具等产品中如此普遍的材料的原因之一是，从化学意义上来说，它是一种非常稳定的聚合物，是一种长链分子，不容易与它接触到的其他分子发生反应。但聚合物的稳定性并不意味着它最终形成的塑料物体是完全惰性的。塑料中常用的许多添加剂，如阻燃剂和着色剂，很容易渗出到周围的材料中。双酚 A（BPA）有助于使塑料变得透明且耐用，它只是渗入食物并干扰人体激素信号传导的添加剂的一个特别臭名昭著的例子。我们现在还知道，微塑料——由于高温和紫外线等因素导致塑料降解而脱落到环境中的微小颗粒——已经进入了远至南极洲、近至人类胎盘和大脑的地方。虽然关于微塑料对人类健康的确切影响的研究还处于早期阶段，但在动物研究中，它们与炎症、细胞损伤、代谢功能改变和其他严重问题有关。

paras.en: In a study published last Wednesday in the journal Nature, researchers report that even plastics that aren’t leaching out additives could cause problems. In fact, the very geometry of microplastics could make them more hazardous to human health.
paras.zh: 在上周三《自然》杂志上发表的一项研究中，研究人员报告说，即使是不滤出添加剂的塑料也可能会引起问题。事实上，微塑料的几何形状可能会使它们对人类健康造成更大的危害。

paras.en: The new study found that when exposed to water, microplastics spontaneously generated the kinds of highly reactive molecules that can damage cells. And more and more of that dangerous chemistry took place as the pieces got smaller. The researchers believe that’s because, as plastic breaks down into smaller pieces, it has more and more surface area. Imagine setting up a banquet hall with nine identical folding tables pushed together to make one big ole square that could fit, say 24 people comfortably. If you split the tables into three rectangles instead, you’d have more potential seats exposed—more surface area—and you’d double your comfortable seating to 48. Set up all nine tables individually, and you’ve got room for 72 place settings. It’s the same amount of table as you started with, but with way more edge exposed.
paras.zh: 这项新研究发现，当接触到水时，微塑料会自发产生高反应性分子，从而损害细胞。随着碎片变得越来越小，越来越多的危险化学反应发生。研究人员认为，这是因为，随着塑料分解成更小的碎片，它的表面积越来越大。想象一下，设立一个宴会厅，将九张相同的折叠桌拼在一起，形成一个可以舒适地容纳 24 人的大方形桌子。如果你把桌子分成三个矩形，你就会有更多的潜在座位暴露在外——更多的表面积——而且你的舒适座位数会增加一倍，达到 48 个。单独设置所有九张桌子，你就有足够的空间容纳 72 个座位。桌子的数量与开始时相同，但暴露的边缘更多。

paras.en: The same thing happens when plastics break down into micro and nano particles: the total volume of plastic remains the same, but more of it is exposed to whatever surrounds it—including human tissue, which happens to be full of water. While more research is needed to confirm this process and understand its potential impacts, we do know enough to say that you should try to limit your exposure to microplastics. Try to avoid microwaving food in plastic, and keep bottled water away from sunlight exposure which can cause the bottles to degrade.
paras.zh: 当塑料分解成微米和纳米颗粒时，也会发生同样的情况：塑料的总体积保持不变，但更多的塑料暴露在周围的物质中，包括人体组织，而人体组织恰好充满了水。虽然需要更多的研究来证实这一过程并了解其潜在影响，但我们确实知道足够的信息可以说您应该尝试限制接触微塑料。尽量避免用微波炉加热塑料食品，并使瓶装水远离阳光照射，否则会导致瓶子降解。

paras.en: And while we’re on the subject of avoiding microplastics, let’s shoutout one exposure you might not be aware of, teabags. Research published last week in npj Science of Food quantified microplastics in tea brewed from loose leaves compared to tea bags. Because FYI, those silky looking pyramid-shaped bags are made from plastic, and even many paper tea bags are sealed shut with plastic glue. The new study found that bagged tea could contain more than 1/5th of the European Food Safety Authority’s tolerable daily intake of BPA. So it might be a good time to invest in a tea strainer, preferably one made out of ceramic or stainless steel.
paras.zh: 虽然我们讨论的是避免使用微塑料，但让我们大声说出您可能不知道的一种接触，即茶袋。上周发表在《npj Science of Food》上的研究量化了散叶泡茶和袋泡茶中的微塑料含量。因为仅供参考，那些看起来丝滑的金字塔形袋子是由塑料制成的，甚至许多纸茶袋都是用塑料胶密封的。新研究发现，袋装茶中的 BPA 含量可能超过欧洲食品安全局每日容许摄入量的 1/5。因此，现在可能是投资滤茶器的好时机，最好是陶瓷或不锈钢制成的滤茶器。

paras.en: Speaking of hot and dangerous food, hackers have found a new way to wreak havoc on the meatspace. Last week, freezers and fridges in hundreds of French supermarkets were reportedly targeted by a cyberattack aimed at spoiling their wares. The hackers took over software from the Danish firm Danfoss that many major retailers use to regulate their refrigerators remotely. The attack raised temperatures to as high as 122 degrees Fahrenheit and kept them elevated overnight, causing food to spoil.
paras.zh: 说到热而危险的食物，黑客找到了一种对肉食空间造成严重破坏的新方法。据报道，上周，数百家法国超市的冰柜和冰箱遭到了旨在破坏其商品的网络攻击。黑客接管了丹麦丹佛斯公司的软件，许多大型零售商使用该软件远程控制冰箱。这次袭击使气温高达 122 华氏度，并在夜间持续升高，导致食物变质。

paras.en: If you want to learn more on how cyberattacks can target physical infrastructure and how benevolent hackers are working to help protect us from threats like these—check out our September 2 episode.
paras.zh: 如果您想了解更多关于网络攻击如何针对物理基础设施以及仁慈的黑客如何帮助保护我们免受此类威胁的信息，请观看我们 9 月 2 日的节目。

paras.en: I know this is shocking but I think I’m gonna wrap us up with a fun animal story. Though this particular study is only fun to think about theoretically and gets pretty unpleasant if it gets too close to home. It has to do with how honeybees do their stinging.
paras.zh: 我知道这很令人震惊，但我想我会用一个有趣的动物故事来结束我们。尽管这项特殊的研究只是在理论上思考起来很有趣，但如果它太接近实际，就会变得非常不愉快。这与蜜蜂如何蜇人有关。

paras.en: When worker bees sting a target and then fly away, they leave their stingers behind—and those stingers keep, well, stinging. In a study published last week in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, researchers analyzed high-speed videos of honeybee stingers to reveal how they keep pumping venom sans bee.
paras.zh: 当工蜂叮咬目标然后飞走时，它们会留下毒刺，而这些毒刺会继续叮人。在上周《美国国家科学院院刊》上发表的一项研究中，研究人员分析了蜜蜂毒刺的高速视频，以揭示它们如何在没有蜜蜂的情况下持续泵出毒液。

paras.en: Now, to the naked human eye a stinger looks like a pretty simple stabbing weapon, but it’s actually a sophisticated instrument. In addition to a venom sac and a pumping chamber, along with muscles and nerves, each stinger contains two sharp lancets that slide on a rail system, kind of like a reciprocating saw. Each lancet has its own attached valve that sits in the pumping chamber. And according to the new study, where scientists had bees sting a clear gel made to mimic human skin, those valves are the key to a stinger’s pumping power. On each downstroke of the lancet the attached valve inflates like parachutes, which creates a pressure seal and pushes venom out. Then as the lancet shoots back up, the valve deflates. The valves are also able to squeeze past one another, so they pump in opposite directions and maintain a continuous flow. Pretty cool, as long as you’re not the person on the receiving end.
paras.zh: 现在，对于人的肉眼来说，毒刺看起来像是一种非常简单的刺伤武器，但它实际上是一种复杂的仪器。 In addition to a venom sac and a pumping chamber, along with muscles and nerves, each stinger contains two sharp lancets that slide on a rail system, kind of like a reciprocating saw.每个刺血针都有自己的附加阀门，位于泵室中。 And according to the new study, where scientists had bees sting a clear gel made to mimic human skin, those valves are the key to a stinger’s pumping power.每次刺血针向下冲程时，所附的阀门都会像降落伞一样膨胀，从而形成压力密封并将毒液推出。然后，当刺血针弹回时，阀门就会放气。这些阀门还能够相互挤压，因此它们可以沿相反方向泵送并保持连续流动。很酷，只要你不是接收端的人。

paras.en: That’s all for this week’s science news roundup. We’ll be back on Wednesday to talk to one of my favorite authors of science fact and fiction about their latest book.
paras.zh: 这就是本周科学新闻综述的全部内容。我们将于周三回来，与我最喜欢的科学事实和小说作家之一谈论他们的最新书。

paras.en: For Scientific American, this is Rachel Feltman. Have a great week!
paras.zh: For Scientific American, this is Rachel Feltman.祝你度过愉快的一周！

articles.title: Biohackers say this supplement lets you drink coffee at night. No one knows if it’s safe

paras.en: Few substances are more beloved than caffeine. Every day, as many as nine in 10 Americans drink a caffeinated beverage, increasingly in a stronger form such as an energy drink. But the stimulant has a massive drawback: consume too much after a certain hour, and you can kiss your sleep schedule goodbye. To get around this, biohackers are turning to an unproven supplement to try flush caffeine out their bodies fast. It promises the best of both worlds: a quick, anytime energy boost and a good night’s sleep. But does it work?
paras.zh: 很少有物质比咖啡因更受喜爱。每天，多达十分之九的美国人饮用含咖啡因的饮料，并且越来越多地饮用能量饮料等浓度较高的饮料。但这种兴奋剂有一个巨大的缺点：在一小时后摄入过多，你就会和你的睡眠时间表说再见。为了解决这个问题，生物黑客正在转向一种未经证实的补充剂，试图快速将咖啡因排出体外。它承诺两全其美：快速、随时的能量补充和良好的睡眠。但这有效吗？

paras.en: Caffeine has a half-life of roughly five hours, meaning it takes about that time, on average, for the initial dosage to reduce by 50 percent in your bloodstream. Depending on the person, caffeine’s stimulant effects can take up to 12 hours to fully wear off. That’s why some people find themselves unable to wind down at night after a 3 P.M. coffee.
paras.zh: 咖啡因的半衰期约为 5 小时，这意味着平均需要大约这个时间，血液中的初始剂量才会减少 50%。根据个人情况，咖啡因的兴奋作用可能需要长达 12 小时才能完全消失。这就是为什么有些人发现自己在下午 3 点之后无法放松下来。咖啡。

paras.en: That’s where rutaecarpine comes in. Among biohacking enthusiasts and one of Silicon Valley’s most influential blogs, the substance has been touted as a way to process caffeine much faster than the body does naturally. Rutaecarpine by itself hasn’t been tested in humans, but it has been shown to help metabolize caffeine more rapidly in rats.
paras.zh: 这就是芸香碱的用武之地。在生物黑客爱好者和硅谷最有影响力的博客之一中，这种物质被吹捧为一种比身体自然更快地处理咖啡因的方法。芸香碱本身尚未在人体中进行测试，但已被证明可以帮助大鼠更快地代谢咖啡因。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: We dug into what the science behind rutaecarpine is and whether the claims about its caffeine-canceling effects hold up. Here’s what you need to know.
paras.zh: 我们深入研究了吴茱萸碱背后的科学原理，以及有关其消除咖啡因作用的说法是否成立。这是您需要了解的内容。

paras.en: Rutaecarpine is derived from the fruit of a plant called Tetradium ruticarpum; it has also been known as Evodia rutaecarpa, among other names. This fruit has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat ailments such as headaches, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain and period pain for more than 2,000 years. Rutaecarpine hasn’t been studied, however, in clinical trials in humans.
paras.zh: 芸香碱源自一种名为 Tetradium ruticarpum 的植物的果实。它也被称为吴茱萸等。这种水果在中药中用于治疗头痛、呕吐、腹泻、腹痛和经痛等疾病已有 2000 多年的历史。然而，芸香碱尚未在人体临床试验中进行过研究。

paras.en: In rats, rutaecarpine works by provoking the liver into producing more CYP1A2, an enzyme that breaks down caffeine in the body and first converts it into a compound called paraxanthine. Rats with higher-than-normal concentrations of CYP1A2 break down caffeine much faster than untreated rats.
paras.zh: 在大鼠中，吴茱萸碱的作用是刺激肝脏产生更多的 CYP1A2，这种酶可以分解体内的咖啡因，并首先将其转化为一种称为副黄嘌呤的化合物。 CYP1A2 浓度高于正常浓度的大鼠比未治疗的大鼠分解咖啡因的速度要快得多。

paras.en: People who promote rutaecarpine say it increases the level of CYP1A2 in your body, allowing you to enjoy the benefits of coffee without delaying sleep. Humans vary naturally in how quickly their bodies clear caffeine, which is in part because of individual differences in CYP1A2 and caffeine sensitivity, which is linked primarily to ADORA2A, the gene for the adenosine receptor that caffeine blocks.
paras.zh: 推广吴茱萸碱的人表示，它可以提高体内 CYP1A2 的水平，让您享受咖啡的好处，同时又不会耽误睡眠。人类身体清除咖啡因的速度存在自然差异，部分原因是 CYP1A2 和咖啡因敏感性的个体差异，这主要与 ADORA2A（咖啡因阻断的腺苷受体基因）有关。

paras.en: Despite the lack of clinical evidence, rutaecarpine is readily available at mainstream online retailers such as Amazon and iHerb, both in its concentrated form and in its traditional herbal form. When sold as a supplement, it doesn’t require the same approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration as a medication does, meaning it is not tested for safety or effectiveness.
paras.zh: 尽管缺乏临床证据，但吴茱萸碱在亚马逊和 iHerb 等主流在线零售商处很容易买到，无论是浓缩形式还是传统草药形式。当作为补充剂出售时，它不需要像药物一样获得美国食品和药物管理局的批准，这意味着它没有经过安全性或有效性测试。

paras.en: A 2024 paper in Toxics that looked at mice and human cell cultures suggests that rutaecarpine could present a serious danger when it is mixed with one of the most common drugs on the planet: acetaminophen, or Tylenol. Bill Baldwin, a professor of biological sciences at Clemson University, who edited the study, says the evidence we have so far “suggests that you have to be careful with this co-treatment. You have to be very careful.”
paras.zh: 2024 年《Toxics》杂志上发表的一篇研究小鼠和人类细胞培养物的论文表明，当芦荟品与地球上最常见的药物之一（对乙酰氨基酚或泰诺）混合时，可能会带来严重危险。克莱姆森大学生物科学教授比尔·鲍德温 (Bill Baldwin) 是这项研究的编辑者，他表示，我们迄今为止掌握的证据“表明你必须谨慎对待这种联合治疗。你必须非常小心。”

paras.en: The reason why has to do with how rutaecarpine works.
paras.zh: 原因与芸香碱的作用原理有关。

paras.en: “CYP1A2, along with a couple of other enzymes, is known to take acetaminophen and produce NAPQI, which is a powerful oxidant,” Baldwin explains. “This leads to damage within the liver, and this damage would typically not happen due to acetaminophen unless you would overdose or you would take [acetaminophen] with alcohol.”
paras.zh: “众所周知，CYP1A2 与其他几种酶会吸收对乙酰氨基酚并产生 NAPQI，这是一种强大的氧化剂，”Baldwin 解释道。 “这会导致肝脏受损，这种损害通常不会因对乙酰氨基酚而发生，除非您服用过量或将[对乙酰氨基酚]与酒精一起服用。”

paras.en: The broader research into rutaecarpine’s safety profile is more mixed, however. A 2021 mouse study, for example, found that mice that were given rutaecarpine every day for a week actually appeared protected against acetaminophen-related liver damage. Meanwhile the fruit that rutaecarpine comes from has repeatedly been linked to liver toxicity in animal studies. Again, rutaecarpine has never been through a clinical trial, so it’s hard to say what it does in humans.
paras.zh: 然而，对芸香碱安全性的更广泛研究则更加复杂。例如，2021 年的一项小鼠研究发现，连续一周每天服用吴茱萸碱的小鼠实际上似乎可以免受对乙酰氨基酚相关的肝损伤。与此同时，在动物研究中，吴茱萸的果实多次被认为与肝毒性有关。同样，芸香碱从未经过过临床试验，因此很难说它对人类有什么作用。

paras.en: Acetaminophen isn’t the only potential interaction. CYP1A2 breaks down numerous other common drugs, such as the asthma drug theophylline and the antipsychotics clozapine and olanzapine.
paras.zh: 对乙酰氨基酚并不是唯一潜在的相互作用。 CYP1A2 分解许多其他常见药物，例如哮喘药物茶碱以及抗精神病药物氯氮平和奥氮平。

paras.en: Pieter Cohen, an associate professor of medicine at Harvard Medical School, says that rutaecarpine “does not have safety data to support its use.” In addition, there are potential concerns around heart and liver damage raised by animal studies that should give pause, he says.
paras.zh: 哈佛医学院医学副教授彼得·科恩 (Pieter Cohen) 表示，芸香碱“没有安全数据支持其使用”。此外，他说，动物研究提出了对心脏和肝脏损伤的潜在担忧，应该暂停。

paras.en: Cohen adds that he is “not aware” of any medication or substance that can “safely offset the effects of caffeine.”
paras.zh: 科恩补充说，他“不知道”有任何药物或物质可以“安全地抵消咖啡因的影响”。

paras.en: If people do choose to take supplements, Cohen recommends picking substances that have only one plant extract on the label, do not make health claims and have been certified by a high-quality third-party supplement screening organization, such as the U.S. Pharmacopeia.
paras.zh: 如果人们确实选择服用补充剂，科恩建议选择标签上仅含有一种植物提取物、不做出健康声明且已获得美国药典等高质量第三方补充剂筛选机构认证的物质。

paras.en: The best strategy for consuming caffeine later in the day without sacrificing sleep is to switch to beverages with a lower concentration, such as green tea. Another option is to try engaging in natural energy-boosting activities, such as taking light exercise or a quick nap. Cohen recommends not consuming more than 100 milligrams of caffeine, roughly equivalent to an eight-ounce (237-milliliter) cup of coffee, after 1 P.M.
paras.zh: 在当天晚些时候摄入咖啡因而不影响睡眠的最佳策略是改喝浓度较低的饮料，例如绿茶。另一种选择是尝试进行自然的能量增强活动，例如轻微运动或小睡一会儿。科恩建议下午 1 点后摄入的咖啡因不要超过 100 毫克，大约相当于一杯 8 盎司（237 毫升）的咖啡。

paras.en: If you must go the chemical route, safer alternatives may exist. Paraxanthine, the compound that caffeine is converted to in the body, has also been picking up steam as a supplement among biohackers. And it’s started to appear in mainstream energy drinks and supplements, including one recently co-founded by Kim Kardashian. One of the selling points of paraxanthine is that it has a shorter half-life than caffeine, meaning it reaches 50 percent of initial dosage sooner in the bloodstream.
paras.zh: 如果您必须采用化学途径，可能存在更安全的替代品。副黄嘌呤是咖啡因在体内转化为的化合物，作为一种补充剂也受到了生物黑客的青睐。它开始出现在主流能量饮料和补充剂中，包括最近由金·卡戴珊 (Kim Kardashian) 共同创立的一款。副黄嘌呤的卖点之一是它的半衰期比咖啡因短，这意味着它在血液中更快达到初始剂量的 50%。

paras.en: Small-scale studies in humans indicate that paraxanthine may improve attention, reaction time and short-term memory compared with a placebo, with no known safety issues at doses of up to 200 mg. The evidence of these benefits is substantially lacking compared with that of the effects of caffeine, however, and many of the existing studies of paraxanthine were funded by supplement companies looking to sell the compound.
paras.zh: 对人类的小规模研究表明，与安慰剂相比，副黄嘌呤可以改善注意力、反应时间和短期记忆，并且剂量高达 200 毫克时没有已知的安全问题。然而，与咖啡因的作用相比，这些益处的证据严重缺乏，并且许多现有的副黄嘌呤研究都是由寻求销售该化合物的补充剂公司资助的。

paras.en: Considering how ever present caffeine is in our society, wanting to mitigate its unwanted side effects is understandable. T. ruticarpum may have a centuries-long history in traditional Chinese medicine, but that isn’t the same as clinical evidence.
paras.zh: 考虑到咖啡因在我们社会中的存在程度，想要减轻其不良副作用是可以理解的。黄果木在中医中可能有数百年的历史，但这与临床证据并不相同。

paras.en: “Any highly concentrated individual compound, regardless of whether it originated in a plant or a chemist’s laboratory, poses the same challenges,” Cohen reiterates. “We must first determine if it is safe for human consumption.”
paras.zh: “任何高度浓缩的单一化合物，无论它是源自植物还是化学家实验室，都会带来同样的挑战，”科恩重申。 “我们必须首先确定它对人类食用是否安全。”

articles.title: The first mission to sample Mars’s moons launches today

paras.en: What’s the first thing you think of when you hear the word “Mars”? The answer is probably rovers or dunes of pale red sand or maybe even apocryphal canals and science-fiction cities populated with little green men. But you probably don’t think of “moons,” even though Mars actually has two, named Phobos and Deimos. That’s because they’re both relatively small, unassuming space rocks rather than giant majestic orbs like Earth’s moon. Yet in some ways, they’re even more mysterious than our own natural satellite; we don’t know quite what they are, where they came from or how long they’ve been around. But we’re about to find out by grabbing a chunk of one.
paras.zh: 当你听到“火星”这个词时，你首先想到的是什么？答案可能是漫游者或淡红色沙丘，甚至可能是虚构的运河和居住着小绿人的科幻城市。但你可能不会想到“卫星”，尽管火星实际上有两个，名为火卫一和火卫二。这是因为它们都是相对较小、不起眼的太空岩石，而不是像月球那样巨大的雄伟球体。然而在某些方面，它们甚至比我们自己的天然卫星更加神秘。我们不太清楚它们是什么，它们来自哪里，也不知道它们存在了多久。但我们将通过抓住其中的一大块来找出答案。

paras.en: On Monday afternoon EDT, the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) will launch its Martian Moons Exploration mission (MMX). Over the next five years, MMX will travel to the Mars system, take samples from Phobos and return back to Earth.
paras.zh: 美国东部时间周一下午，日本宇宙航空研究开发机构 (JAXA) 将启动火星卫星探索任务 (MMX)。未来五年，MMX 将前往火星系统，从火卫一采集样本，然后返回地球。

paras.en: The mission’s goal is to learn more about Phobos’s origins and those of the Mars system itself, said Lindsay Hays, NASA’s acting director of planetary science, in a press conference detailing the U.S. space agency’s contributions to MMX last week. NASA provided some of the scientific instruments, and several NASA scientists are actively involved in the mission.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局行星科学代理主任林赛·海斯在上周的新闻发布会上详细介绍了美国航天局对 MMX 的贡献，他说，此次任务的目标是更多地了解火卫一的起源以及火星系统本身的起源。美国宇航局提供了一些科学仪器，几位美国宇航局科学家也积极参与了这项任务。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “The mission’s science and return samples will complement decades of Mars exploration and help inform future discoveries and perhaps, in the even further future, crewed missions,” Hays said. A proof-of-concept for retrieving Martian material is especially important to NASA because its own Mars Sample Return project is now stuck in limbo, with dozens of cached specimens awaiting pickup on the Red Planet’s surface.
paras.zh: 海斯说：“这次任务的科学和返回样本将补充数十年的火星探索，并有助于为未来的发现提供信息，也许在更遥远的未来，为载人任务提供信息。”取回火星材料的概念验证对美国宇航局尤其重要，因为其自己的火星样本返回项目目前陷入困境，有数十个隐藏的样本等待在红色星球表面拾取。

paras.en: “If you talk to the average person, they’re probably going to be more excited about a mission to a potentially habitable world or something like that and not a barren rock that is essentially a dented potato the size of Manhattan,” says Asa Stahl, an author and an astronomer at the nonprofit advocacy group the Planetary Society. “But there’s real science here.”
paras.zh: “如果你和普通人交谈，他们可能会对去一个可能适合居住的世界或类似的东西更感兴趣，而不是一块贫瘠的岩石，本质上是曼哈顿大小的凹痕土豆，”非营利组织行星协会的作家和天文学家阿萨斯塔尔说。 “但这里有真正的科学。”

paras.en: One of the biggest questions MMX could answer concerns the origins of Mars’s moons. It’s possible, scientists say, that Phobos and Deimos were two asteroids passing by that were each separately caught in Mars’s orbit. Or the moons could be pieces of debris that were created when Mars crashed into something else. By capturing samples of Phobos, researchers can better understand the composition of the moons and perhaps piece together the puzzle of their birth.
paras.zh: MMX 可以回答的最大问题之一是火星卫星的起源。科学家表示，火卫一和火卫二可能是两颗路过的小行星，分别被困在火星轨道上。或者，卫星可能是火星撞上其他物体时产生的碎片。通过捕获火卫一的样本，研究人员可以更好地了解卫星的组成，或许还能解开它们诞生的谜团。

paras.en: But beyond that, the samples will provide precious clues about the Mars system’s deep history—and possibly even about the history of life itself, says Wataru Fujiya, JAXA’s leader of the sample analysis team for MMX.
paras.zh: 但除此之外，这些样本还将提供有关火星系统深厚历史的宝贵线索，甚至可能提供有关生命本身历史的宝贵线索，JAXA MMX 样本分析团队负责人藤谷渡 (Wataru Fujiya) 表示。

paras.en: “Understanding the origin of Phobos would have implications far beyond Phobos itself,” he says. “Regardless of which hypothesis is correct, the origin of the moon involves interactions between a small body and Mars. Determining what kind of body interacted with Mars could therefore help us understand how the building blocks of life, such as water and organic matter, were delivered to terrestrial planets from external sources and how these planets evolved into worlds that could potentially support life.”
paras.zh: “了解火卫一的起源所产生的影响将远远超出火卫一本身，”他说。 “无论哪种假设是正确的，月球的起源都涉及一个小天体与火星之间的相互作用。因此，确定哪种天体与火星相互作用可以帮助我们了解生命的组成部分，例如水和有机物，是如何从外部来源传递到类地行星的，以及这些行星如何演化成可能支持生命的世界。”

paras.en: The mission is set to launch today at 3:41 P.M. EDT, to arrive at Mars in August 2027 and to study the moons for a few years before MMX lands on Phobos in 2030. MMX’s sample-return capsule, planned to carry at least 10 grams of Phobos, is expected to arrive back at Earth in 2031.
paras.zh: 该任务定于今天下午 3:41 发射。 EDT，将于 2027 年 8 月抵达火星，并在 2030 年 MMX 登陆火卫一之前对卫星进行几年研究。MMX 的样本返回舱计划携带至少 10 克火卫一，预计将于 2031 年返回地球。

paras.en: The mission carries 13 instruments, including two samplers, called the C-sampler and P-sampler. The C-sampler, a corer, will dig into the moon’s surface to extract material, while the P-sampler will blow high-pressure nitrogen gas at the surface to loosen and collect rocks and dust.
paras.zh: 该任务携带 13 台仪器，包括两个采样器，称为 C 采样器和 P 采样器。 C采样器是一种取芯器，它将深入月球表面提取物质，而P采样器将向月球表面喷射高压氮气，以松动并收集岩石和灰尘。

paras.en: Bringing physical samples back to Earth is “one of the most scientifically bountiful things that you can do with a space mission,” Stahl says. “When we bring stuff back to Earth, then we can really dig down deep into it. We can throw all of our state-of-the-art equipment at it as much as we want. And most importantly, maybe, we can save some of those samples for equipment that we haven’t even invented yet.”
paras.zh: 斯塔尔说，将物理样本带回地球是“在太空任务中可以做的最科学丰富的事情之一”。 “当我们把东西带回地球时，我们就可以真正深入挖掘它。我们可以随心所欲地将所有最先进的设备投入其中。最重要的是，也许我们可以将其中一些样本保存到我们尚未发明的设备中。”

paras.en: The mission involves an international collaboration among half a dozen space agencies, with Japan at the helm, and reflects JAXA’s years of investment in deep-space sampling work. The agency has also retrieved material from two asteroids, Itokawa and Ryugu.
paras.zh: 该任务涉及六个航天机构之间的国际合作，由日本主导，反映了日本宇宙航空研究开发机构多年来对深空采样工作的投资。该机构还从两颗小行星糸川小行星和龙宫小行星上回收了物质。

paras.en: “Japan has found kind of an interesting niche in its planetary and space science specialty—[with JAXA as] ‘the sample-return agency,’” says Casey Dreier, chief of space policy at the Planetary Society. “And they’ve gotten really good at it.”
paras.zh: “日本在其行星和空间科学专业领域找到了一个有趣的利基——[JAXA]作为‘样本返回机构’，”行星协会空间政策负责人凯西·德雷尔（Casey Dreier）说。 “而且他们已经非常擅长了。”

paras.en: If astronomers are really lucky, Stahl says, the retrieved bits of Phobos “could have a little bonus in them”: a piece of Mars itself. Scientists have calculated that when asteroids hit Mars, the planet’s gravitational field is meager enough that some of the ejected debris can readily reach Phobos. If the Phobos sample happens to include some of that debris, this would be the first physical samples of Mars returned to Earth. (Mars-sourced meteorites fall to our planet occasionally, but most are unrecovered, and none are pristine.)
paras.zh: 斯塔尔说，如果天文学家真的很幸运，取回的火卫一碎片“可能会带来一点好处”：火星本身的一部分。科学家计算出，当小行星撞击火星时，火星的引力场非常微弱，一些喷射出的碎片很容易到达火卫一。如果火卫一样本恰好包含其中一些碎片，这将是第一个返回地球的火星物理样本。 （来自火星的陨石偶尔会落到我们的星球上，但大多数都未被回收，而且没有一个是原始的。）

paras.en: “We might find kind of Mars rock that we’ve never had in hand before,” Stahl speculates. “I love to imagine some scientists, bent over an instrument in the laboratory, trying to pick out individual grains from Phobos and saying, ‘That one’s from Mars!’”
paras.zh: “我们可能会发现一种我们以前从未接触过的火星岩石，”斯塔尔推测。 “我喜欢想象一些科学家在实验室里弯腰看着仪器，试图从火卫一上挑选出单个颗粒，然后说，‘那个来自火星！’”

articles.title: Many American diets may not include enough of this essential nutrient
articles.author: Aimee Cunningham

paras.en: Grocery store shelves are bursting with fancy salts: Himalayan, kosher, sea salt and more. Considering these choices, it can be easy to forget about the public health victory found in basic, iodized table salt.
paras.zh: 杂货店的货架上摆满了各种精美的盐：喜马拉雅盐、犹太盐、海盐等等。考虑到这些选择，人们很容易忘记基本的加碘食盐在公共卫生方面取得的胜利。

paras.en: The nutrient iodine is a crucial component of thyroid hormones, necessary for fetal and early childhood brain development and health throughout life. At the start of the last century, iodine deficiency was a rampant and visible public health problem in the United States, with the telltale sign of enlarged thyroid glands, called goiters, especially prevalent in much of the north. A series of steps taken by a medical society in Michigan and U.S. salt producers brought iodized salt to tables across the country, and by the 1950s, occurrences of goiters had dropped precipitously.
paras.zh: 营养物质碘是甲状腺激素的重要组成部分，是胎儿和幼儿大脑发育以及一生健康所必需的。上世纪初，碘缺乏在美国是一个严重且明显的公共卫生问题，其明显迹象是甲状腺肿大，称为甲状腺肿，在北方大部分地区尤其普遍。密歇根州的一个医学会和美国盐生产商采取了一系列措施，将碘盐带入了全国各地的餐桌，到 20 世纪 50 年代，甲状腺肿的发病率急剧下降。

paras.en: But more recently, the United States appears to be backsliding on iodine nutrition. In 2017 and 2018, 24 percent of women and 30 percent of men, aged 14 and older, weren’t getting an adequate amount of the nutrient. That’s about twice as many as in 2001 and 2002, researchers reported in the Journal of Nutrition in 2025. Breaking the data down further, nearly half of pregnant women haven’t been getting enough iodine. The study reflects an estimated, short-term look at population iodine levels.
paras.zh: 但最近，美国在碘营养方面似乎出现了倒退。 2017 年和 2018 年，14 岁及以上的 24% 女性和 30% 男性没有获得足够的营养。研究人员在 2025 年《营养杂志》上报告称，这一数字约为 2001 年和 2002 年的两倍。进一步细分数据发现，近一半的孕妇没有摄入足够的碘。该研究反映了对人口碘水平的短期估计。

paras.en: Long-term, a consistent dearth of iodine robs the body of the ability to produce sufficient amounts of thyroid hormones. If iodine levels in the population continue to trend down, that could eventually result in more goiters and harm brain development in children.
paras.zh: 长期而言，持续缺乏碘会剥夺身体产生足够量甲状腺激素的能力。如果人口中的碘含量继续下降，最终可能会导致更多的甲状腺肿并损害儿童的大脑发育。

paras.en: “The group that has the most severe potential consequences of iodine deficiency is pregnant women,” says Elizabeth Pearce, an endocrinologist at Boston University Chobanian & Avedisian School of Medicine. “Even mild degrees of iodine deficiency in pregnancy may be associated with measurably lower IQ in children.”
paras.zh: 波士顿大学 Chobanian & Avedisian 医学院的内分泌学家 Elizabeth Pearce 说：“由于缺碘，潜在后果最严重的群体是孕妇。” “即使怀孕期间轻微缺碘也可能与儿童智商明显降低有关。”

paras.en: Yet women of reproductive age, at the U.S. population level, are on the cusp of mild iodine deficiency, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention stated in its 2026 Nutrition Report.
paras.zh: 然而，美国疾病控制与预防中心在其 2026 年营养报告中指出，美国人口中的育龄妇女正处于轻度缺碘的边缘。

paras.en: With all of the ways that diets, salt intake and noniodized options have changed over time, the importance of iodine nutrition may not be top-of-mind for the general public like it was a century ago. “Iodine deficiency is the leading cause worldwide of preventable developmental delay,” says Monica Serrano-Gonzalez, a pediatric endocrinologist at Hasbro Children’s and Brown University’s Warren Alpert Medical School in Providence, R.I. “People have kind of forgotten this is a risk.”
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，饮食、盐摄入量和非碘选择发生了各种变化，碘营养的重要性可能不再像一个世纪前那样成为公众关注的首要问题。 “碘缺乏是全世界可预防的发育迟缓的主要原因，”孩之宝儿童医院和罗德岛州普罗维登斯布朗大学沃伦阿尔珀特医学院的儿科内分泌学家 Monica Serrano-Gonzalez 说，“人们有点忘记了这是一种风险。”

paras.en: When iodine deficiency keeps the thyroid gland from making enough hormones, the body calls for more, which stimulates and enlarges the gland. That supersized gland, called a goiter, bulges at the neck. In the United States, goiters were extremely common a century ago in the Northwest, Great Lakes and Appalachians; together, the area became known as the “goiter belt.” Iodine naturally occurs in seawater and soil. But in the noncoastal northern part of the country, soils and water sources have little iodine, so the crops produced in these inland areas lack the nutrient.
paras.zh: 当缺碘导致甲状腺无法产生足够的激素时，身体就会需要更多的激素，从而刺激并扩大腺体。那个巨大的腺体，称为甲状腺肿，在颈部凸出。在美国，一个世纪前，甲状腺肿在西北地区、五大湖和阿巴拉契亚地区极为常见。该地区一起被称为“甲状腺肿带”。碘天然存在于海水和土壤中。但在该国北部非沿海地区，土壤和水源中的碘含量很少，因此这些内陆地区生产的农作物缺乏营养。

paras.en: An examining physician for the World War I draft reported in 1918 that 30 percent of almost 600 men from a northern Michigan county had goiters, some large enough to be disqualifying. A 1922 Michigan Department of Health study of schoolchildren in four counties revealed that close to 50 percent had goiters. “It would have been a really visible public health problem at that time,” Pearce says.
paras.zh: 1918 年，一名参加第一次世界大战征兵检查的医生报告称，密歇根州北部一个县的近 600 名男子中，有 30% 患有甲状腺肿，有些甲状腺肿大到足以取消资格。 1922 年，密歇根州卫生部对四个县的学童进行的一项研究显示，近 50% 的学童患有甲状腺肿。 “当时这将是一个非常明显的公共卫生问题，”皮尔斯说。

paras.en: In response to the state’s iodine issues, the Michigan State Medical Society recommended the addition of the nutrient to table salt. The minimal expense for iodization meant this common kitchen staple would remain affordable. Companies introduced iodized salt in Michigan in the spring of 1924. By the fall, the Morton Salt Company, a major producer, was selling iodized salt nationwide. Over time, the goiters of the “belt” dwindled.
paras.zh: 为了应对该州的碘问题，密歇根州医学会建议在食盐中添加这种营养素。碘化费用极低，这意味着这种常见的厨房主食仍然可以负担得起。 1924 年春天，密歇根州的一些公司推出了碘盐。到了秋天，主要生产商莫顿盐业公司 (Morton Salt Company) 开始在全国范围内销售碘盐。随着时间的推移，“腰带”上的甲状腺肿逐渐减少。

paras.en: Salt iodization has been linked to rising IQ in the United States. For example, for men born in areas without natural sources of iodine, there was a significant jump in World War II Air Force acceptances, based on a qualifying exam, after widespread salt iodization. The increase did not occur among men born in areas with adequate natural sources of the nutrient, researchers reported in the Journal of the European Economic Association in 2017.
paras.zh: 在美国，食盐加碘与智商上升有关。例如，根据资格考试，在盐加碘广泛之后，对于出生在没有天然碘来源的地区的男性来说，二战时期空军的录取率大幅上升。研究人员在 2017 年《欧洲经济协会杂志》上报告称，出生在天然营养来源充足地区的男性并未出现这种增加。

paras.en: Adding iodine to salt was never mandated by the U.S. government. But for a long time, the voluntary approach — combined with how most people consumed salt and other dietary habits — did the trick to get people enough iodine. Today, different meal practices and available food options are tearing holes in the iodine safety net. “Iodized salt is important, but it may not be reaching everybody anymore,” Pearce says.
paras.zh: 美国政府从未强制要求在盐中添加碘。但长期以来，自愿的方法——结合大多数人的食盐方式和其他饮食习惯——成功地让人们获得了足够的碘。如今，不同的膳食习惯和可用的食物选择正在破坏碘安全网。 “碘盐很重要，但可能不再普及到每个人，”皮尔斯说。

paras.en: There are many more noniodized salt options today, with one analysis reporting that only 53 percent of table salt sold in U.S. stores is iodized. People get much of their salt from prepared, processed and packaged foods, which generally are made with noniodized salt. Milk can provide iodine, due to iodine-supplemented feed and the use of an iodine cleanser on cows’ udders. But the amount of iodine in milk can vary greatly, a recent analysis found, probably because industry practices can differ. Diets that restrict dairy may also put people at risk of consuming too little iodine.
paras.zh: 如今，有更多的非碘盐可供选择，一项分析报告称，美国商店销售的食盐中只有 53% 是加碘的。人们从预制、加工和包装食品中获取大部分盐，这些食品通常是用无碘盐制成的。由于添加了碘的饲料以及在奶牛乳房上使用了碘清洁剂，牛奶可以提供碘。但最近的一项分析发现，牛奶中的碘含量可能存在很大差异，这可能是因为行业实践可能有所不同。限制乳制品的饮食也可能使人们面临碘摄入过少的风险。

paras.en: The U.S. recommended dietary allowance for iodine for adults is 150 micrograms per day, which rises to 220 mcg for pregnant people and 290 mcg for those breastfeeding. The amount of the nutrient that iodized salt contains can vary, but will be listed on the container’s label. Based on a 2023 federal report on food iodine content, one teaspoon of salt has around 300 mcg of added iodine. (The American Heart Association recommends a limit of 2,300 milligrams of sodium per day; one teaspoon of salt has 2,400 mg of sodium.)
paras.zh: 美国建议成人的碘膳食摄入量为每天 150 微克，孕妇的碘摄入量升至 220 微克，哺乳期的碘摄入量升至 290 微克。碘盐所含营养素的含量可能有所不同，但会在容器的标签上列出。根据 2023 年联邦食品碘含量报告，一茶匙盐含有约 300 微克的添加碘。 （美国心脏协会建议每日钠摄入量不得超过 2,300 毫克；一茶匙盐含有 2,400 毫克钠。）

paras.en: The American Thyroid Association and the American Academy of Pediatrics recommend that pregnant and breastfeeding people, as well as those planning to become pregnant, take a daily supplement with 150 micrograms of iodine. Sufficient iodine is especially important in the first trimester of pregnancy, when a developing embryo relies solely on the mother’s supply.
paras.zh: 美国甲状腺协会和美国儿科学会建议怀孕、哺乳期以及计划怀孕的人每天补充 150 微克的碘。充足的碘在怀孕的前三个月尤其重要，因为此时发育中的胚胎完全依赖母亲的供应。

paras.en: When choosing table salt, “look for salt that’s iodized,” Pearce says. For people on a low-salt diet, it’s better to cut out packaged and prepared foods, Serrano-Gonzalez says. “We do want to have moderation with salt intake, but we need a little bit” of iodized salt, she says.
paras.zh: 皮尔斯说，选择食盐时，“寻找加碘的盐”。塞拉诺-冈萨雷斯说，对于低盐饮食的人来说，最好不要吃包装食品和预制食品。她说，“我们确实希望控制盐的摄入量，但我们需要一点”碘盐。

paras.en: People have largely forgotten why it’s important to choose iodized salt, Pearce says. It’s not a decision that many people have to make globally: One hundred and twenty-six countries mandate salt iodization, while only 21 have voluntary polices.
paras.zh: 皮尔斯说，人们基本上已经忘记了为什么选择加碘盐很重要。这并不是全球许多人必须做出的决定：126 个国家强制要求食盐加碘，而只有 21 个国家制定了自愿政策。

paras.en: An observational study of an iodine crisis in Ethiopia indicates the catastrophic consequences of losing the nutrient. The country adopted a salt iodization policy in the 1990s, and by 1995, 80 percent of households reported using iodized salt. But the country’s stock came from Eritrea, and in 1998, a conflict between the two countries closed the border and interrupted the supply of iodized salt. By 2005, the Ethiopian population was severely iodine deficient, with up to 40 percent of school-aged children and 36 percent of women of reproductive age developing goiters. Ethiopia’s government was able to reinstate mandatory salt iodization in 2012, and household coverage climbed to 85 percent by 2015.
paras.zh: 对埃塞俄比亚碘危机的一项观察性研究表明，失去这种营养素会带来灾难性的后果。中国在20世纪90年代开始实行食盐加碘政策，到1995年，80%的家庭使用加碘盐。但该国的库存来自厄立特里亚，1998年两国之间的冲突关闭了边境，中断了碘盐的供应。到2005年，埃塞俄比亚人口严重缺碘，高达40%的学龄儿童和36%的育龄妇女患有甲状腺肿。埃塞俄比亚政府于 2012 年恢复了强制食盐加碘，到 2015 年家庭覆盖率攀升至 85%。

paras.en: But the severe iodine disruption during the war had a devastating effect on the children born and raised in that period. In rural areas, which had very low soil iodine levels, mortality among children in the first two years of life reached 25 to 30 percent, compared with 10 percent in other areas, researchers reported in Nature Food in September. The children from rural areas who reached secondary school scored lower on national exams. The study team took other effects of the conflict into account, to focus on the impact of the iodine nutrition emergency.
paras.zh: 但战争期间严重的碘破坏对那个时期出生和长大的儿童造成了毁灭性影响。研究人员在 9 月份的《自然食品》杂志上报道称，在土壤碘含量极低的农村地区，出生前两年的儿童死亡率达到 25% 至 30%，而其他地区的死亡率为 10%。农村地区的孩子进入中学后在全国统考中的成绩较低。研究小组考虑了冲突的其他影响，重点关注碘营养紧急情况的影响。

paras.en: In the United States, the worst manifestation of iodine deficiency was the long ago “goiter belt.” “There needs to be public health education,” Pearce says, “so people understand again what the dangers are if we don’t have adequate iodine nutrition, and how to just ensure that they’re protected.”
paras.zh: 在美国，缺碘最严重的表现是很久以前的“甲状腺肿带”。 “需要进行公共卫生教育，”皮尔斯说，“让人们再次了解如果我们没有足够的碘营养会带来什么危险，以及如何确保他们受到保护。”

articles.title: Japan’s sample return mission to Phobos may also collect some Mars dust
articles.author: Meghan Bartels

paras.en: For decades, scientists have dreamed of getting Martian rocks into Earth’s laboratories — a Herculean feat that would revolutionize our knowledge of the Red Planet. An audacious mission from the Japanese space agency might offer the next best thing: rocks from Mars’ larger moon, Phobos.
