paras.zh: 几十年来，科学家们一直梦想着将火星岩石带入地球实验室——这是一项艰巨的壮举，将彻底改变我们对这颗红色星球的认识。日本航天局的一项大胆任务可能会提供下一个最好的东西：来自火星较大卫星火卫一的岩石。

paras.en: That’s the task confronting the Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) spacecraft, due to launch October 19 at 3:41 p.m. EDT. The mission aims to crack the long-standing mystery of how Mars got its two odd moons by delivering a sample of Phobos to Earth in 2031. These rocks are no substitute for true Martian material — but given that NASA’s plans to fetch the Perseverance rover’s prized samples are in limbo, scientists are eager for even an indirect glimpse of Mars.
paras.zh: 这就是火星卫星探索 (MMX) 航天器面临的任务，该航天器将于 10 月 19 日下午 3:41 发射。美东时间。该任务旨在通过在 2031 年向地球提供火卫一样本来解开火星如何获得两颗奇怪卫星的长期谜团。这些岩石并不能替代真正的火星物质，但鉴于 NASA 获取毅力号火星车珍贵样本的计划处于悬而未决的状态，科学家们甚至渴望间接一睹火星的风采。

paras.en: “It’s a chance to get a totally different sample and view of Martian materials,” says planetary scientist Briony Horgan of Purdue University in West Lafayette, Ind., who is not involved in the MMX mission. “It’ll be a great contribution to our sample collection back here on Earth.”
paras.zh: “这是一个获得完全不同的火星物质样本和视图的机会，”印第安纳州西拉斐特普渡大学的行星科学家布里奥尼·霍根（Briony Horgan）说道，他没有参与 MMX 任务。 “这将对我们在地球上的样本收集做出巨大贡献。”

paras.en: If it’s successful, MMX will be the first mission to reach Phobos. Three previous spacecraft from Russia failed.
paras.zh: 如果成功，MMX 将成为第一个到达火卫一的任务。俄罗斯之前的三艘航天器都失败了。

paras.en: The MMX itinerary is action-packed: After launch, the spacecraft will spend about one year cruising out to Mars, then slip into orbit around Mars alongside Phobos for about three years. During its stay, the spacecraft will deploy a small rover named Idefix to scout the moon for good sampling sites. The main spacecraft will then make two landings to grab 10 grams of sample, about the weight of four U.S. pennies. It will use two different devices to snag the sample: One will drill two centimeters down into the rock, while the other will blow pressurized gas at the surface to collect loose material.
paras.zh: MMX 的行程充满动感：发射后，航天器将花费大约一年的时间巡航到火星，然后与火卫一一起进入火星轨道大约三年。在停留期间，航天器将部署一个名为 Idefix 的小型漫游车，在月球上寻找良好的采样点。随后，主航天器将进行两次着陆，以获取 10 克样本，大约相当于 4 便士的重量。它将使用两种不同的设备来获取样本：一种设备将钻入岩石两厘米，另一种设备将在地表喷射加压气体以收集松散的物质。

paras.en: Once loaded up, MMX will zip past the smaller moon Deimos before making the one-year trek home to drop its cargo in Australia’s outback, just as Japan’s two previous asteroid sample-return missions have done. After the Japanese space agency JAXA sorts and catalogs the samples, it will share portions of them with other institutions.
paras.zh: 一旦装载完毕，MMX 将快速掠过较小的卫星火卫二，然后进行为期一年的长途跋涉，将货物运送到澳大利亚内陆地区，就像日本之前两次小行星样本返回任务所做的那样。日本宇宙航空研究开发机构对样本进行分类和编录后，将与其他机构分享其中的部分内容。

paras.en: Such a small handful of rock may not sound impressive, but it’s enough to thrill researchers. “A few grams of sample are going to be a real bonanza for scientists,” says planetary scientist Michael Zolensky of NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston, where 15 percent of the sample will eventually end up.
paras.zh: 这么一小把岩石可能听起来并不令人印象深刻，但足以让研究人员兴奋不已。美国宇航局休斯敦约翰逊航天中心的行星科学家迈克尔·佐伦斯基 (Michael Zolensky) 表示：“几克样本对科学家来说将是一笔真正的财富。”15% 的样本最终将到达那里。

paras.en: MMX is designed to reveal the enigmatic origins of Phobos and Deimos — the only moons in the inner solar system besides our own. “The Martian moons are so different from [the] terrestrial moon: They are two, very small [and] very dark,” says planetary scientist Tomoki Nakamura of Tohoku University in Sendai, Japan.
paras.zh: MMX 旨在揭示火卫一和火卫二的神秘起源——它们是内太阳系中除了我们自己的卫星之外的唯一卫星。日本仙台东北大学的行星科学家中村智树说：“火星卫星与地球卫星非常不同：它们是两颗，非常小，而且非常黑暗。”

paras.en: The strange objects look like rocks that wandered in from the outer asteroid belt and got trapped around Mars. But their tidy circular orbits suggest they coalesced after a massive collision tore material off the Red Planet. Or perhaps they came about some other way that scientists simply haven’t imagined, says planetary scientist Kiyoshi Kuramoto of Hokkaido University in Sapporo, Japan. “The natural world often reveals aspects that exceed our expectations,” he says.
paras.zh: 这些奇怪的物体看起来就像从小行星带外层徘徊并被困在火星周围的岩石。但它们整齐的圆形轨道表明，它们是在一次大规模碰撞将红色星球上的物质撕裂后合并在一起的。日本札幌北海道大学的行星科学家仓本清 (Kiyoshi Kuramoto) 表示，或许它们以科学家根本想象不到的其他方式出现。 “自然世界经常揭示出超出我们预期的方面，”他说。

paras.en: Studying the features and composition of Phobos’ surface could solve the mystery. But although MMX carries sophisticated instruments to explore Phobos, those observations may not suffice. Hence bringing rock back to Earth’s labs, where scientists can enlist equipment far too large or delicate to ever send to space.
paras.zh: 研究火卫一表面的特征和成分可以解开这个谜团。但是，尽管 MMX 携带先进的仪器来探索火卫一，但这些观察结果可能还不够。因此，将岩石带回地球实验室，科学家们可以在那里获得过于庞大或脆弱而无法发送到太空的设备。

paras.en: Although sample analysis will focus on understanding Phobos, researchers will also be able to use the rocks to fine-tune our understanding of Mars. For example, pinpointing the material’s age will allow scientists to calibrate the chronology of cosmic collisions in the neighborhood of Mars. Currently, scientists estimate ages on Mars based on a timeline based on our moon, which may not apply at the Red Planet.
paras.zh: 尽管样本分析的重点是了解火卫一，但研究人员也将能够利用这些岩石来微调我们对火星的了解。例如，查明材料的年龄将使科学家能够校准火星附近宇宙碰撞的年表。目前，科学家们根据月球的时间线来估计火星的年龄，这可能不适用于这颗红色星球。

paras.en: Scientists even have reason to hope that stray grains from Mars will be hidden amid the MMX treasure. This material could be ancient relics of the two bodies mixing during a moon-forming process, potentially including grains that hail from deeper in the Martian crust than scientists have seen so far in rare meteorites the cosmos has delivered us. No matter how Phobos formed, the material could also include fresher debris flung off the Red Planet by cosmic collisions.
paras.zh: 科学家们甚至有理由希望来自火星的杂散颗粒将隐藏在 MMX 宝藏中。这种物质可能是两个天体在月球形成过程中混合的古代遗迹，其中可能包括来自火星地壳深处的颗粒，这些颗粒比科学家迄今为止在宇宙向我们提供的稀有陨石中看到的要多。无论火卫一是如何形成的，其物质也可能包括因宇宙碰撞而从红色星球上抛下来的新鲜碎片。

paras.en: The biggest challenge may be positively identifying which grains came from Mars. Such lucky samples would lack valuable geologic context and be far from pristine. “They’re material that’s been blasted off Mars from some unknown location, micron-sized things, sitting on the airless body Phobos, getting irradiated by space,” says planetary scientist Nancy Chabot of the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory in Laurel, Md. Nonetheless, scientists are prepared to get creative and use the latest technology to tease out every secret they can manage in any sample they can snag.
paras.zh: 最大的挑战可能是积极识别哪些谷物来自火星。这些幸运的样本缺乏有价值的地质背景，而且远非原始状态。马里兰州劳雷尔约翰·霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室的行星科学家南希·查博特说：“它们是从火星上某个未知地点发射出来的微米大小的物质，位于没有空气的火卫一上，受到太空辐射。”尽管如此，科学家们已经准备好发挥创造力，并使用最新的技术，在他们能捕获的任何样本中找出他们能掌握的每一个秘密。

paras.en: MMX offers a very different type of sample return than what NASA has initiated with the Perseverance rover, which has spent years squirreling away fresh material drilled from the most interesting outcrops it can find. That’s all in hopes of a future mission ferrying the rock to Earth for scientists to hunt for signs of ancient microbes. But the U.S. Congress has axed funding for that successor due to spiraling costs and concerns about feasibility — particularly of accomplishing the first ever launch from Mars.
paras.zh: MMX 提供的样本返回类型与 NASA 毅力号火星车启动的样本返回方式截然不同，后者花了数年时间储存从它能找到的最有趣的露头中钻取的新鲜材料。这一切都是为了未来的任务将岩石运送到地球，以便科学家寻找古代微生物的迹象。但由于成本不断上升以及对可行性的担忧——特别是对完成首次火星发射的可行性的担忧，美国国会已经削减了对继任者的资助。

paras.en: Even if MMX can’t give scientists the satisfaction of an ultimate Mars sample return, there’s still plenty to learn, says planetary scientist Vicky Hamilton of the Southwest Research Institute in Boulder, Colo., who is not involved in the mission. “It’s always a happy day when we’re getting a sample from another object in space and bringing it back to Earth to study,” she says.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州博尔德市西南研究所的行星科学家维基·汉密尔顿（未参与此次任务）表示，即使 MMX 无法让科学家们对最终返回火星样本感到满意，但仍有很多东西需要学习。 “当我们从太空中的另一个物体获取样本并将其带回地球进行研究时，这总是令人高兴的一天，”她说。

articles.title: These tiny snakes cartwheel to escape danger
articles.author: Maria Temming

paras.en: Cartwheeling seems like it should require both arms and legs. But some itty-bitty snakes in Southeast Asia manage it without either.
paras.zh: 侧手翻似乎需要双臂和双腿。但东南亚的一些小蛇却可以在没有任何一种的情况下做到这一点。

paras.en: Scientists first shared snapshots of a dwarf reed snake (Pseudorabdion longiceps) cartwheeling away from danger in 2023. Now, videos of three Pseudorabdion species hightailing it down a racetrack in the lab have offered a closer look at this rare and strangely acrobatic behavior.
paras.zh: 2023 年，科学家们首次分享了矮芦苇蛇 (Pseudorabdion longiceps) 翻滚逃离危险的快照。现在，实验室中三种拟芦苇蛇在跑道上狂奔的视频让我们更近距离地观察了这种罕见且奇怪的杂技行为。

paras.en: Each snake starts with its body curled into a C shape, head lifted off the ground and facing the way it’s going. It then whips its tail out behind it, briefly becoming airborne. The snake flips its tail forward and down past its head. When the snake’s tail hits the ground in front of it, another roll begins, researchers report October 19 in Current Biology.
paras.zh: 每条蛇一开始都会把身体卷成C形，头离开地面并面向它前进的方向。然后它把尾巴甩到身后，短暂地浮在空中。蛇将尾巴向前向下翻转，越过头部。研究人员 10 月 19 日在《当代生物学》杂志上报道，当蛇的尾巴碰到它前面的地面时，另一次滚动开始。

paras.en: “What a cool snake behavior,” says Jessica Tingle, a biologist at Brown University in Providence, R.I., not involved in the work. “I find it especially amazing that an elongate animal like a snake can manage to roll, especially given that they do it in such an explosive way, which probably asks a lot of their muscles and bones.”
paras.zh: “蛇的行为多么酷啊，”​​罗德岛州普罗维登斯布朗大学的生物学家杰西卡·廷格尔（Jessica Tingle）说道，她没有参与这项工作。 “我觉得特别令人惊奇的是，像蛇这样的细长动物能够滚动，特别是考虑到它们以如此爆炸性的方式滚动，这可能需要大量的肌肉和骨骼。”

paras.en: Yosuke Kojima was equally surprised when a colleague in Sarawak, Malaysia recounted witnessing this “very weird” behavior in 2019. So the researchers collected snakes from Malaysia’s Kubah National Park. They scooped up 11 P. saravacense, one P. collaris, one P. longiceps, plus six Calamaria reed snakes for comparison.
paras.zh: 当马来西亚沙捞越州的一位同事讲述了 2019 年目睹的这种“非常奇怪”的行为时，小岛洋介同样感到惊讶。因此，研究人员从马来西亚的库巴国家公园收集了蛇。他们挖出了 11 条 P. saravacense、1 条 P. colonis、1 条 P. longiceps 以及 6 条鱿鱼芦苇蛇进行比较。

paras.en: Finding the snakes was no easy task. They were only about 11 to 28 centimeters long. “They always hide under the leaves,” says Kojima, an ecologist at Toho University in Chiba, Japan. But were any of the snakes able to cartwheel away from the researchers? “No,” Kojima laughs. “We are quicker than them.”
paras.zh: 找到蛇并不是一件容易的事。它们的长度只有11到28厘米左右。 “它们总是躲在树叶下面，”日本千叶东邦大学的生态学家小岛说。但是，有没有蛇能够侧手翻，远离研究人员呢？ “不，”小岛笑道。 “我们比他们快。”

paras.en: The team set up a 2.2-meter-long racetrack and placed the snakes one at a time at one end. A gentle tap coaxed the snakes to move and cameras above and beside the track recorded the action. None of the Calamaria snakes cartwheeled, but all of the Pseudorabdion snakes did. At full tilt, they tumbled at 1.7 to 3.7 meters per second — about six to 13 kilometers per hour.
paras.zh: 研究小组搭建了一条2.2米长的跑道，并将蛇一条一条地放置在一端。轻轻的敲击声会诱使蛇移动，轨道上方和旁边的摄像机记录了这一动作。没有一条卡拉马利亚蛇会侧翻，但所有的拟兔蛇都会侧翻。全倾斜时，它们以每秒 1.7 至 3.7 米的速度翻滚，即每小时 6 至 13 公里。

paras.en: Through it all, the snakes held their heads fairly steady — reminiscent of how flying snakes hold their heads stable while launching into the air, the researchers say.
paras.zh: 研究人员说，在整个过程中，蛇都保持着相当稳定的头部——这让人想起飞蛇在飞向空中时如何保持头部稳定。

paras.en: A cartwheeling snake first rolls its body along the ground to whip its tail out behind its head. Then, it swings its tail up and over its head. Finally, it brings its tail down on either the left or right side of its head. Once it the tail hits the ground, the snake is ready for another roll. In the cartwheel seen on top, the snake brings its tail down on the left side of its head, angling its whitish belly toward the viewer. In the cartwheel on the bottom, the snake’s tail lands on the right side of its head, showing its darker back to the viewer.
paras.zh: 侧手翻的蛇首先沿着地面滚动身体，将尾巴从头后面甩出来。然后，它把尾巴举过头顶。最后，它将尾巴垂到头部的左侧或右侧。一旦尾巴落地，蛇就准备好再次滚动。在顶部的侧手翻中，蛇将尾巴垂到头部左侧，将白色的腹部朝向观察者。在底部的侧手翻中，蛇的尾巴落在其头部的右侧，向观看者展示其较暗的背部。

paras.en: “I am very curious how such a strange and possibly demanding movement evolved … whether dwarf reed snakes have something special in their anatomy, physiology or neural control that lets them do it when their close relatives apparently can’t or don’t,” Tingle says. “Are their brains different in some way to let them coordinate a fast and unusual movement? Or do all snakes have the basic equipment, and they just don’t use it?”
paras.zh: “我很好奇这种奇怪且可能要求很高的运动是如何进化的……矮芦苇蛇在解剖学、生理学或神经控制方面是否有一些特殊的东西，可以让它们在它们的近亲显然不能或不做的情况下做到这一点，”廷格尔说。 “它们的大脑是否在某些方面有所不同，可以让它们协调快速且不寻常的运动？或者所有蛇都拥有基本装备，但它们只是不使用它？”

paras.en: Those may be open mysteries. But catching snakes cartwheeling on camera does tie up one loose end for Tingle.
paras.zh: 这些可能是未解之谜。不过，在镜头中捕捉到蛇翻滚的镜头确实为 Tingle 解决了一个未解之谜。

paras.en: “Some writers in the 1800s talked about ‘hoop snakes’ and described their motion as rolling, but that seemed pretty fantastical to me, and I chalked it up to overly inventive imaginations,” Tingle says. Those 19th century authors may or may not have been describing the exact behavior Kojima’s team recorded. “Either way, it’s neat to find out a real animal does something reminiscent of a fantastical old story.”
paras.zh: “1800 年代的一些作家谈论‘环蛇’，并将它们的运动描述为滚动，但这对我来说似乎非常梦幻，我将其归咎于过于创造性的想象力，”廷格尔说。这些 19 世纪的作者可能会也可能不会描述小岛团队记录的确切行为。 “不管怎样，发现一只真正的动物做了一些让人想起一个奇幻的古老故事的事情真是太棒了。”

articles.title: How Many Steps a Day Does It Take to Sharpen Your Attention? A 14-Year Study Hints at The Range
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: A daily step count is a simple way to keep track of how much we move. It may also offer clues about our attention and decision-making skills.
paras.zh: 每日步数是跟踪我们移动量的简单方法。它还可能提供有关我们的注意力和决策技能的线索。

paras.en: Researchers examined activity records and cognitive test results from 3,093 US adults across 14 years to explore how everyday movement relates to thinking. They also looked at blood pressure.
paras.zh: 研究人员检查了 3,093 名美国成年人 14 年来的活动记录和认知测试结果，以探索日常运动与思维的关系。他们还检查了血压。

paras.en: "Across several cognitive domains, individuals in the more active groups tended to perform better on the cognitive measures," psychiatrist Olaoluwa Okusaga of Baylor College of Medicine told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 贝勒医学院的精神病学家奥拉卢瓦·奥库萨加 (Olaoluwa Oksaga) 告诉 ScienceAlert，“在多个认知领域中，活跃群体中的个体往往在认知测量方面表现更好。”

paras.en: The team used Fitbit records and blood pressure measurements from the US National Institutes of Health's All of Us Research Program. Participants ranged from 18 to 93 years old, with an average age of about 58.
paras.zh: 该团队使用了来自美国国立卫生研究院“我们所有人研究计划”的 Fitbit 记录和血压测量值。参与者年龄从18岁到93岁不等，平均年龄约58岁。

paras.en: Many earlier studies relied on people reporting their own activity levels, which can be inaccurate. Wearable devices gave the researchers an objective measure of daily movement.
paras.zh: 许多早期的研究依赖于人们报告自己的活动水平，这可能不准确。可穿戴设备为研究人员提供了日常运动的客观测量。

paras.en: The records covered a 14-year window, from 2009 to 2023. Not everyone had data for the whole period, so the researchers estimated each person's activity pattern from the measurements available.
paras.zh: 这些记录涵盖了从 2009 年到 2023 年的 14 年窗口。并不是每个人都有整个时期的数据，因此研究人员根据可用的测量数据估计了每个人的活动模式。

paras.en: From September 2023 onward, participants completed a single round of cognitive testing. Four tasks assessed sustained attention, the ability to ignore distracting information, preferences for immediate versus delayed rewards, and recognition of facial emotions.
paras.zh: 从 2023 年 9 月起，参与者完成了单轮认知测试。四项任务评估了持续注意力、忽略分散注意力的信息的能力、对即时奖励与延迟奖励的偏好以及对面部情绪的识别。

paras.en: Three groups emerged from the activity records, averaging 5,108, 8,875, and 14,161 daily steps. Both more active groups scored better than the least active group on the attention, distraction-control, and reward-choice tasks.
paras.zh: 活动记录中出现了三组，平均每日步数为 5,108、8,875 和 14,161。在注意力、分心控制和奖励选择任务上，两个更活跃的组都比最不活跃的组得分更高。

paras.en: For example, after accounting for age, education, income, marital status, and birthplace, sustained-attention scores were an estimated 1.76 points higher in the middle activity group and 2.17 points higher in the most active group, compared with the least active group. The cognitive differences were small.
paras.zh: 例如，考虑到年龄、教育程度、收入、婚姻状况和出生地后，与最不活跃组相比，中等活动组的持续注意力得分估计高出 1.76 分，最活跃组的持续注意力得分高出 2.17 分。认知差异很小。

paras.en: The findings add to research exploring how daily steps relate to health. Here, the associations extended across skills with possible applications in everyday life.
paras.zh: 这些发现丰富了探索日常步数与健康之间关系的研究。在这里，这些关联扩展到了日常生活中可能应用的技能。

paras.en: "Examples might include maintaining concentration at work, avoiding impulsive decisions, and adhering to long-term goals such as saving money or following a health plan," Okusaga explained.
paras.zh: “例子可能包括在工作中保持专注，避免冲动决定，以及坚持长期目标，例如省钱或遵循健康计划，”奥萨加解释说。

paras.en: Blood pressure showed a narrower association. Higher systolic pressure, the top number in a reading, was linked to slightly poorer performance on the reward-choice task. After adjustment for other factors, diastolic pressure, the bottom number, was not significantly associated with any of the four tests.
paras.zh: 血压显示出更窄的关联。较高的收缩压（读数中最高的数字）与奖励选择任务的表现稍差有关。调整其他因素后，舒张压（底部数字）与四项测试中的任何一项均没有显着相关性。

paras.en: In a follow-up analysis, lower systolic pressure could statistically account for about 5 percent of the association between step counts and reward-choice scores. This estimate does not establish that lowering blood pressure improves cognition.
paras.zh: 在后续分析中，较低的收缩压在统计上可以解释约 5% 的步数和奖励选择分数之间的关联。这一估计并不能证明降低血压可以改善认知能力。

paras.en: The researchers suggested that improved glucose metabolism, reduced inflammation, and the brain's ability to adapt could help explain the link between activity and cognition. These mechanisms were not tested in this study.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，改善葡萄糖代谢、减少炎症和大脑的适应能力有助于解释活动与认知之间的联系。本研究中未测试这些机制。

paras.en: Facial emotion recognition did not differ significantly between activity groups, and changes in activity over time were not significantly associated with cognitive performance.
paras.zh: 面部情绪识别在活动组之间没有显着差异，并且活动随时间的变化与认知表现没有显着相关。

paras.en: The step counts also do not establish a daily target for better attention.
paras.zh: 步数计数也没有建立每日目标以提高注意力。

paras.en: "Our study was observational and was not designed to determine an optimal number of daily steps for cognitive health," Okusaga said.
paras.zh: “我们的研究是观察性的，并不是为了确定认知健康的最佳每日步数，”奥萨加说。

paras.en: Because cognition was measured only once, the researchers could not determine whether participants' thinking skills had improved or declined. People's existing cognitive abilities could also influence how active they remained. Everyday behavior, such as concentration at work or financial decisions, was not directly assessed.
paras.zh: 由于认知仅测量一次，研究人员无法确定参与者的思维能力是提高还是下降。人们现有的认知能力也会影响他们的活跃程度。日常行为，例如工作注意力或财务决策，没有被直接评估。

paras.en: The analysis could not account for smoking or obesity. The sample was largely White, about two-thirds were women, and nearly all had at least some college education, which limits how broadly the results apply.
paras.zh: 该分析无法解释吸烟或肥胖的原因。样本主要是白人，大约三分之二是女性，几乎所有人都至少受过大学教育，这限制了结果的适用范围。

paras.en: "Our findings support an association between long-term physical activity and later cognitive performance, but they do not prove that physical activity causes better cognition," Okusaga said.
paras.zh: 奥萨加说：“我们的研究结果支持长期体力活动与后期认知表现之间的关联，但并不能证明体力活动可以带来更好的认知。”

paras.en: Repeated cognitive assessments in future All of Us data could help researchers investigate whether staying active is associated with changes in attention and other thinking skills over time.
paras.zh: 未来的重复认知评估“所有人”数据可以帮助研究人员调查保持活跃是否与注意力和其他思维技能随时间的变化有关。

paras.en: The research has been published in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学报告》上。

articles.title: Probiotics May Protect From Signs of Early Cognitive Decline, Clinical Trial Finds
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: Food for the gut may possibly feed the brain as well.
paras.zh: 肠道食物也可能为大脑提供食物。

paras.en: A rigorous new clinical trial has now found evidence that certain probiotic mixes may protect from some initial signs of cognitive decline.
paras.zh: 一项严格的新临床试验现已发现证据表明，某些益生菌混合物可以预防认知能力下降的一些初步迹象。

paras.en: Among older adults with early cognitive impairment, taking a multistrain probiotic supplement daily for roughly six months resulted in a number of benefits.
paras.zh: 对于患有早期认知障碍的老年人来说，每天服用多菌株益生菌补充剂大约六个月会带来许多好处。

paras.en: Most notably, probiotic use compared to a placebo was associated with better scores on several cognitive tests, and it also led to a significant reduction in plasma levels of pTau181.
paras.zh: 最值得注意的是，与安慰剂相比，使用益生菌可以在多项认知测试中获得更好的分数，并且还导致血浆 pTau181 水平显着降低。

paras.en: This is a blood-based biomarker of Alzheimer's disease that measures levels of a phosphorylated form of tau protein in the blood, which can reflect Alzheimer's-related changes in the brain.
paras.zh: 这是阿尔茨海默病的一种血液生物标志物，可测量血液中磷酸化 tau 蛋白的水平，从而反映大脑中与阿尔茨海默病相关的变化。

paras.en: In cases of dementia, tau proteins can fold abnormally, leading to tangles that can clog up brain cells.
paras.zh: 在痴呆症中，tau 蛋白可能会异常折叠，导致缠结，从而堵塞脑细胞。

paras.en: Prior to the onset of dementia symptoms, pTau181 often increases in the blood.
paras.zh: 在痴呆症状出现之前，血液中的 pTau181 通常会增加。

paras.en: These new findings, published in the Journal of Alzheimer's Disease, are exciting but still preliminary.
paras.zh: 这些发表在《阿尔茨海默病杂志》上的新发现令人兴奋，但仍处于初步阶段。

paras.en: To be clear, they do not show that probiotics can directly reduce tau tangles in the brain.
paras.zh: 需要明确的是，他们并没有表明益生菌可以直接减少大脑中的 tau 蛋白缠结。

paras.en: However, they do join growing evidence that suggests the gut microbiome is closely linked to brain health, and that it may be a useful target for future dementia treatments.
paras.zh: 然而，他们确实加入了越来越多的证据，表明肠道微生物组与大脑健康密切相关，并且它可能是未来痴呆症治疗的有用目标。

paras.en: "Collectively," the trial authors conclude, "these findings indicate that maintaining or restoring the gut microbial balance through probiotic supplementation may represent a promising strategy to mitigate early Alzheimer's disease-related pathological processes during the prodromal stage of Alzheimer's."
paras.zh: 试验作者总结道：“总的来说，这些发现表明，通过补充益生菌维持或恢复肠道微生物平衡可能是减轻阿尔茨海默病前驱阶段早期阿尔茨海默病相关病理过程的一种有前景的策略。”

paras.en: The trial took place among 87 participants within a larger, longitudinal study on cognitive decline in South Korea, called the Gwangju Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (GARD) cohort.
paras.zh: 该试验在韩国一项名为“光州阿尔茨海默氏症和相关痴呆症 (GARD)”队列的更大型纵向认知能力下降研究中的 87 名参与者中进行。

paras.en: Of the 100 participants originally randomized, 40 completed the 24-week probiotic intervention, while another 47 completed the placebo treatment.
paras.zh: 在最初随机分组的 100 名参与者中，40 名完成了 24 周的益生菌干预，另外 47 名完成了安慰剂治疗。

paras.en: Neither the participants nor the researchers knew who was taking what.
paras.zh: 参与者和研究人员都不知道谁服用了什么。

paras.en: The probiotic given to participants has the code name KL-P301, and it consists of three bacterial strains, including subspecies of Bifidobacterium animalis, Limosilactobacillus fermentum, and Levilactobacillus brevis.
paras.zh: 给参与者的益生菌代号为KL-P301，由三种菌株组成，包括动物双歧杆菌、发酵柠檬酸杆菌和短乳杆菌亚种。

paras.en: Participants could choose to consume the powder alone or dissolved in water.
paras.zh: 参与者可以选择单独食用粉末或溶解在水中。

paras.en: Compared to those given a placebo, those who were given a daily probiotic supplement showed a significant reduction in plasma pTau181 by the end of the trial.
paras.zh: 与服用安慰剂的患者相比，每日补充益生菌的患者在试验结束时血浆 pTau181 显着降低。

paras.en: After just 24 weeks, they also showed significantly better scores on a Clinical Dementia Rating system.
paras.zh: 仅仅 24 周后，他们在临床痴呆评级系统上的得分也明显提高。

paras.en: In fact, their performance on tasks that tested their ability to interpret visual information, understand spatial organization, and draw complex shapes improved significantly, although not all comparisons with the placebo group were statistically significant.
paras.zh: 事实上，他们在测试其解释视觉信息、理解空间组织和绘制复杂形状的能力的任务中的表现显着提高，尽管并非所有与安慰剂组的比较都有统计学意义。

paras.en: "The parallel reduction in plasma pTau181 and the preservation of visuospatial construction and visual memory provide converging evidence supporting the potential involvement of microbiota–immune–brain interactions in early neurodegenerative processes," the trial authors conclude, led by neurologists Kang-Ho Choi and Kun Ho Lee from the Republic of Korea.
paras.zh: 由来自韩国的神经学家 Kang-Ho Choi 和 Kun Ho Lee 领导的试验作者总结道：“血浆 pTau181 的平行减少以及视觉空间结构和视觉记忆的保存提供了一致的证据，支持早期神经退行性过程中微生物群-免疫-大脑相互作用的潜在参与。”

paras.en: Previously, some clinical trials on probiotics have found similar results but with key differences.
paras.zh: 此前，一些益生菌的临床试验也发现了类似的结果，但存在关键差异。

paras.en: For instance, in patients with clinically diagnosed Alzheimer's disease, multistrain probiotic supplements that include both Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus were associated with improved brain-derived markers in the blood.
paras.zh: 例如，在临床诊断的阿尔茨海默病患者中，包含双歧杆菌和乳酸杆菌的多菌株益生菌补充剂与血液中脑源性标记物的改善相关。

paras.en: They were also linked to lower circulating inflammatory and oxidative stress markers.
paras.zh: 它们还与较低的循环炎症和氧化应激标志物有关。

paras.en: But this new trial takes an important step forward. It examines blood markers associated with tau pathology alongside cognitive function, with inflammation potentially playing a role.
paras.zh: 但这项新试验向前迈出了重要一步。它检查与 tau 蛋白病理学和认知功能相关的血液标记物，其中炎症可能发挥了作用。

paras.en: After 24 weeks, changes to most inflammatory markers were generally modest.
paras.zh: 24 周后，大多数炎症标志物的变化通常不大。

paras.en: But one marker in particular, called IL-1β, declined to a greater extent in the probiotic group than the placebo group.
paras.zh: 但益生菌组中一种名为 IL-1β 的标志物的下降程度比安慰剂组更大。

paras.en: "This finding may suggest a selective anti-inflammatory effect of the multistrain probiotic on specific cytokine pathways," the authors suggest.
paras.zh: 作者表示：“这一发现可能表明多菌株益生菌对特定细胞因子途径具有选择性抗炎作用。”

paras.en: In other words, probiotics may improve gut health, and reduce some signals of systemic inflammation that may reach the brain. This, in turn, may somehow reduce tau markers in the blood.
paras.zh: 换句话说，益生菌可以改善肠道健康，并减少一些可能到达大脑的全身炎症信号。反过来，这可能会以某种方式减少血液中的 tau 标记物。

paras.en: Poor gut health, for instance, may activate immune responses that could weaken the blood–brain barrier or contribute to neuroinflammation and damage to neurons.
paras.zh: 例如，肠道健康状况不佳可能会激活免疫反应，从而削弱血脑屏障或导致神经炎症和神经元损伤。

paras.en: But whether or not probiotics can restore gut health is still under investigation and poorly understood.
paras.zh: 但益生菌是否可以恢复肠道健康仍在研究中，人们对此知之甚少。

paras.en: Figuring out how these supplements might impact the brain via the gut is a whole other step.
paras.zh: 弄清楚这些补充剂如何通过肠道影响大脑则完全是另一回事。

paras.en: Animal studies have shown positive results, but these don't always translate to humans. Larger clinical trials are now needed.
paras.zh: 动物研究已显示出积极的结果，但这些结果并不总是适用于人类。现在需要更大规模的临床试验。

paras.en: "While preliminary, these findings warrant larger and longer trials incorporating tau/amyloid-β PET imaging to assess their durability, clinical relevance, and the utility of visuospatial cognition as a potential endpoint," the study authors conclude.
paras.zh: 研究作者总结道：“虽然是初步的，但这些发现需要进行更大规模、更长时间的试验，结合 tau/淀粉样蛋白-β PET 成像来评估其耐久性、临床相关性以及视觉空间认知作为潜在终点的效用。”

paras.en: "Overall, these results support further investigation of this multistrain probiotic formulation as a potential non- pharmacological approach in early stage of Alzheimer's disease."
paras.zh: “总的来说，这些结果支持进一步研究这种多菌株益生菌制剂作为阿尔茨海默病早期的潜在非药物方法。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Journal of Alzheimer’s Disease.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《阿尔茨海默病杂志》上。

articles.title: ADHD Drugs May Reduce The Risk of Early Death, Major Study Finds
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: People with ADHD face more than issues with attention, focus, and impulses: It's a serious condition that may take years off a person's life.
paras.zh: 患有注意力缺陷多动症的人面临的不仅仅是注意力、注意力和冲动问题：这是一种严重的疾病，可能会夺去一个人数年的生命。

paras.en: For the 5 percent of children and 2.5 percent of adults who have ADHD, the way their brains work means they struggle with tasks that require focus and planning.
paras.zh: 对于患有多动症的 5% 儿童和 2.5% 成人来说，他们的大脑工作方式意味着他们很难完成需要集中注意力和计划的任务。

paras.en: Sometimes, that can look like forgetting an appointment, misplacing the car keys, or drinking too much on a work night. Those 'blips' are harmless enough, though they can compound over a lifetime.
paras.zh: 有时，这可能看起来像是忘记约会、忘记了车钥匙，或者在工作的晚上喝了太多酒。这些“小插曲”是无害的，尽管它们可能会在一生中不断加剧。

paras.en: A lapse in focus can lead to traffic accidents; a missed appointment can delay healthcare treatment; a tendency to give in to impulses can make bad habits harder to quit.
paras.zh: 注意力不集中可能导致交通事故；错过预约可能会延误医疗治疗；屈服于冲动的倾向会使坏习惯更难戒掉。

paras.en: At the most serious end of things, people with ADHD face a higher risk of an early death.
paras.zh: 最严重的是，患有多动症的人面临着更高的早逝风险。

paras.en: A large review published in JAMA Network Open offers strong new evidence of the link between ADHD and mortality from any cause, as well as from suicide, injury, or natural causes.
paras.zh: 《JAMA Network Open》上发表的一篇大型评论提供了强有力的新证据，证明 ADHD 与任何原因以及自杀、受伤或自然原因导致的死亡率之间存在联系。

paras.en: The review also suggests ADHD medication may reduce the risk of early death among those living with the disorder.
paras.zh: 该评论还表明，多动症药物可能会降低患有该疾病的人过早死亡的风险。

paras.en: Researchers from institutions across the UK reviewed 19 existing studies published between 2012 and 2025. Each study had a slightly different research focus and was conducted in populations from across the world: the US, Canada, Sweden, Taiwan, the UK, Finland, and Denmark.
paras.zh: 来自英国各地机构的研究人员回顾了 2012 年至 2025 年间发表的 19 项现有研究。每项研究的研究重点略有不同，并且在来自世界各地的人群中进行：美国、加拿大、瑞典、台湾、英国、芬兰和丹麦。

paras.en: But all of them examined mortality patterns related to ADHD or its treatment.
paras.zh: 但他们都检查了与多动症或其治疗相关的死亡率模式。

paras.en: Together, that data spans more than 15.9 million participants, a sample size that researchers can rarely achieve in a single study. Pooling results from multiple studies can help researchers identify patterns that are less likely to occur due to random chance.
paras.zh: 这些数据总共涉及超过 1590 万名参与者，这是研究人员在一项研究中很少能达到的样本量。汇集多项研究的结果可以帮助研究人员识别由于随机机会而不太可能发生的模式。

paras.en: This is why reviews and meta-analyses like this are so valuable: Scientists can look across multiple studies to find prevailing trends or potential outliers in the research.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么像这样的评论和荟萃分析如此有价值：科学家可以浏览多项研究，以发现研究中的普遍趋势或潜在的异常值。

paras.en: The data from 12 of these studies were pooled together to calculate hazard ratios based on the death statistics for people with and without ADHD.
paras.zh: 将其中 12 项研究的数据汇总在一起，根据患有和不患有 ADHD 的人的死亡统计数据计算风险比。

paras.en: The results reiterate the risks of leaving ADHD undiagnosed or untreated.
paras.zh: 结果重申了多动症未经诊断或未经治疗的风险。

paras.en: People with ADHD had a 70 percent higher hazard of death from any cause than people without the condition.
paras.zh: 患有多动症的人因任何原因死亡的风险比没有这种疾病的人高 70%。

paras.en: The risk of death from suicide was 90 percent higher among people with ADHD. Their risk of death from unintentional or intentional injury was 50 percent higher, and even the risk of death from natural causes was 30 percent higher.
paras.zh: 患有 ADHD 的人死于自杀的风险要高出 90%。他们因无意或故意伤害而死亡的风险高出 50%，甚至因自然原因死亡的风险也高出 30%。

paras.en: These findings generally agree with the results of an earlier review, except for the part about deaths from natural causes. The earlier review did not find evidence for higher mortality from natural causes among folks with ADHD.
paras.zh: 除了有关自然原因死亡的部分外，这些发现总体上与早期审查的结果一致。早期的审查没有发现多动症患者自然原因死亡率较高的证据。

paras.en: "This difference may reflect the inclusion of more recently published studies or differences in the studies and effect estimates included," the authors suggest.
paras.zh: 作者表示：“这种差异可能反映了最近发表的研究的纳入或研究和效果估计之间的差异。”

paras.en: The good news is that prescription medications used to treat ADHD are associated with a lower risk of death from any cause in ADHD populations.
paras.zh: 好消息是，用于治疗多动症的处方药可以降低多动症人群全因死亡的风险。

paras.en: The study doesn't distinguish between the effects of different medications, but generally, stimulants are the drugs prescribed for ADHD.
paras.zh: 该研究没有区分不同药物的效果，但一般来说，兴奋剂是治疗多动症的药物。

paras.en: The methods used for this research are not intended to show cause and effect: We can't say that ADHD is the cause of these mortality rates, nor that ADHD medication caused the reduction in mortality rates.
paras.zh: 这项研究使用的方法并不是为了显示因果关系：我们不能说多动症是这些死亡率的原因，也不能说多动症药物导致了死亡率的降低。

paras.en: The authors also saw a lot of variation between studies, which might be related to factors like the balance of gender in study populations, the cultural attitudes and healthcare services in different countries, and changes in ADHD diagnosis and management over the past decade or so.
paras.zh: 作者还发现研究之间存在很大差异，这可能与研究人群的性别平衡、不同国家的文化态度和医疗服​​务以及过去十年左右多动症诊断和管理的变化等因素有关。

paras.en: "Pooled estimates should be interpreted as average associations across diverse populations and study contexts rather than as being universally applicable," the authors note.
paras.zh: 作者指出：“汇总估计值应被解释为不同人群和研究背景之间的平均关联，而不是普遍适用。”

paras.en: "The current evidence suggests that there are multiple factors that may increase risk for mortality outcomes in people with ADHD, reinforcing the importance of support for managing health risks in this population and attention to addressing structural determinants of poor health disproportionately experienced by people with ADHD," the authors conclude.
paras.zh: 作者总结道：“目前的证据表明，有多种因素可能会增加多动症患者的死亡风险，这凸显了支持管理该人群健康风险的重要性，以及关注解决多动症患者健康状况不佳的结构性决定因素的重要性。”

paras.en: The research has been published in JAMA Network Open.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《JAMA Network Open》上。

articles.title: Something strange is happening beneath a volcano near 2 million people

paras.en: Something strange is happening beneath a volcano near 2 million people
paras.zh: 一座靠近 200 万人的火山下面正在发生奇怪的事情

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered evidence of two hidden magma sources beneath Nicaraguaâs Masaya volcano, where satellite observations revealed mysterious ground movements suggesting magma is shifting deep underground. The findings could improve eruption forecasting for the active volcano, which sits near 2 million people and attracts tourists to its spectacular lava lake.
paras.zh: - 科学家在尼加拉瓜马萨亚火山下方发现了两个隐藏岩浆源的证据，卫星观测揭示了神秘的地面运动，表明岩浆正在地下深处移动。这些发现可以改善对这座活火山喷发的预测，这座活火山拥有近 200 万人，吸引着游客前往其壮观的熔岩湖。

paras.en: A volcano famous for its glowing lava lake is hiding a surprisingly complex system of magma deep underground. Scientists at Penn State have uncovered evidence of two previously unrecognized magma sources beneath Nicaragua's active Masaya volcano, raising new questions about how molten rock moves beneath the surface.
paras.zh: 一座以其发光的熔岩湖而闻名的火山，在地下深处隐藏着令人惊讶的复杂岩浆系统。宾夕法尼亚州立大学的科学家在尼加拉瓜马萨亚活火山下方发现了两个以前未被识别的岩浆源的证据，提出了关于熔岩如何在地表下移动的新问题。

paras.en: The discovery is particularly important because approximately 2 million people live within 13 miles of the volcano, which is also a popular tourist destination. Understanding its underground activity could help scientists recognize warning signs of future eruptions and better protect nearby communities.
paras.zh: 这一发现尤为重要，因为大约 200 万人居住在距火山 13 英里的范围内，而火山也是热门的旅游目的地。了解其地下活动可以帮助科学家识别未来火山喷发的警告信号，并更好地保护附近的社区。

paras.en: Using six years of satellite observations, researchers tracked subtle changes in the ground around Masaya. They discovered that one part of the volcano initially sank before beginning to rise, possibly indicating that fresh magma was entering a deep reservoir. Meanwhile, the ground around its active Santiago crater and lava lake continued to sink, suggesting that a separate, shallower magma reservoir was behaving differently.
paras.zh: 通过六年的卫星观测，研究人员追踪了马萨亚周围地面的微妙变化。他们发现火山的一部分在开始上升之前最初下沉，这可能表明新鲜的岩浆正在进入深层水库。与此同时，其活跃的圣地亚哥火山口和熔岩湖周围的地面继续下沉，这表明一个单独的、较浅的岩浆库的行为有所不同。

paras.en: The findings, published in Geophysical Research Letters, reveal that the volcano's underground magma system may be considerably more complicated than previously understood.
paras.zh: 发表在《地球物理研究快报》上的研究结果表明，火山的地下岩浆系统可能比之前理解的要复杂得多。

paras.en: "These observations help scientists better understand how magma moves beneath Masaya and may improve monitoring and eruption forecasting in the future," said lead author Lizzie Johnson, who earned her bachelor's degree in geosciences from Penn State in May.
paras.zh: “这些观察结果有助于科学家更好地了解岩浆如何在马萨亚地下移动，并可能改善未来的监测和喷发预测，”主要作者 Lizzie Johnson 说，她于 5 月从宾夕法尼亚州立大学获得了地球科学学士学位。

paras.en: Located near Managua, Nicaragua's capital, Masaya is a geologically complex volcano featuring multiple overlapping craters and calderas. Calderas are large depressions that generally form when the ground collapses after magma is removed from an underground chamber.
paras.zh: 马萨亚火山位于尼加拉瓜首都马那瓜附近，是一座地质复杂的火山，拥有多个重叠的火山口和破火山口。破火山口是大型凹陷，通常是岩浆从地下房间排出后地面塌陷时形成的。

paras.en: Although scientists have studied Masaya for years, the movement of magma through its underground reservoirs and passageways remains poorly understood. These systems can change over time, making it difficult to determine exactly what is happening beneath the volcano.
paras.zh: 尽管科学家们对马萨亚进行了多年的研究，但人们对岩浆通过地下储库和通道的运动仍然知之甚少。这些系统会随着时间的推移而发生变化，因此很难准确确定火山下方正在发生什么。

paras.en: "Having a thorough understanding of Masaya's volcanic activity and its related hazards is critical as around 2 million people live near Masaya and the caldera is a national park and popular tourist destination," Johnson said. "Although Masaya last produced a major lava flow in 1772, its persistent degassing often produces dangerously high concentrations of sulfur dioxide volcanic gas."
paras.zh: 约翰逊说：“全面了解马萨亚的火山活动及其相关危害至关重要，因为大约 200 万人居住在马萨亚附近，而火山口是国家公园和热门旅游目的地。” “虽然马萨亚最后一次产生大量熔岩流是在 1772 年，但其持续脱气经常会产生危险的高浓度二氧化硫火山气体。”

paras.en: Sulfur dioxide is a potentially harmful volcanic gas released as magma approaches or remains near the surface. Even without a major eruption, elevated concentrations can create dangerous conditions for visitors and surrounding communities.
paras.zh: 二氧化硫是一种潜在有害的火山气体，当岩浆接近或停留在地表附近时释放出。即使没有大规模喷发，浓度升高也会给游客和周边社区带来危险。

paras.en: Young Cheol Kim, who completed his doctorate in geosciences at Penn State this summer, explained that monitoring the volcano continuously is essential for distinguishing normal activity from changes that might signal increasing volcanic hazards.
paras.zh: 今年夏天在宾夕法尼亚州立大学完成了地球科学博士学位的 Young Cheol Kim 解释说，持续监测火山对于区分正常活动和可能预示火山灾害增加的变化至关重要。

paras.en: "Doing continuous monitoring allows us to understand the baseline activity and identify see if things are changing," he said, explaining that certain shifts in volcanic behavior could indicate a period of heightened activity or a possible eruption. "And then if there is a need to warn people, we can do that in a timely manner."
paras.zh: 他说：“进行持续监测使我们能够了解基线活动并确定情况是否正在发生变化。”他解释说，火山行为的某些变化可能表明一段时期的活动加剧或可能爆发。 “然后，如果需要警告人们，我们可以及时采取行动。”

paras.en: Satellites Reveal Hidden Movements Beneath the Volcano
paras.zh: 卫星揭示火山下方隐藏的运动

paras.en: To investigate Masaya's underground activity, the researchers analyzed measurements collected by the Sentinel-1 satellite, which observes the volcano approximately once every 12 days.
paras.zh: 为了调查马萨亚的地下活动，研究人员分析了 Sentinel-1 卫星收集的测量数据，该卫星大约每 12 天观测一次火山。

paras.en: The team used a technique called interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR), which can detect extremely small changes in the elevation of Earth's surface. By comparing satellite measurements taken at different times, scientists can identify areas where the ground is rising or sinking.
paras.zh: 该团队使用了一种称为干涉合成孔径雷达（InSAR）的技术，该技术可以检测地球表面高度的极小变化。通过比较不同时间的卫星测量结果，科学家可以识别地面上升或下沉的区域。

paras.en: The technique combines two important capabilities. Synthetic aperture radar sends microwave signals toward Earth's surface, allowing satellites to collect measurements even when clouds obscure the ground. Interferometry compares the returning radar signals to detect changes in distance between the satellite and the surface.
paras.zh: 该技术结合了两种重要的功能。合成孔径雷达向地球表面发送微波信号，即使云层遮挡地面，卫星也能收集测量数据。干涉测量法比较返回的雷达信号以检测卫星与表面之间距离的变化。

paras.en: This is especially valuable in tropical regions, where frequent cloud cover can make conventional satellite imagery less reliable.
paras.zh: 这在热带地区尤其有价值，因为那里频繁的云层覆盖会使传统卫星图像的可靠性降低。

paras.en: "Cloud penetration is important for volcanoes because many of them, like Masaya, are in tropical areas where there is often cloud cover," Kim explained. "And when we look at all the different satellite images across multiple years, we can see how the distance between the satellite and the ground changes, where it is uplifting or subsiding."
paras.zh: “云的穿透力对于火山来说很重要，因为许多火山，如马萨亚，都位于热带地区，那里经常有云层覆盖，”金解释道。 “当我们查看多年来所有不同的卫星图像时，我们可以看到卫星与地面之间的距离如何变化，哪里隆起或下沉。”

paras.en: By examining these subtle movements over time, researchers can investigate processes happening far below the surface without directly observing the magma itself.
paras.zh: 通过检查这些随着时间的推移发生的微妙运动，研究人员可以研究发生在地表以下深处的过程，而无需直接观察岩浆本身。

paras.en: Two Magma Reservoirs Behaving in Different Ways
paras.zh: 两个岩浆库表现不同

paras.en: The satellite measurements revealed an intriguing pattern between 2018 and 2024. During the first part of the study, the ground within Masaya's caldera gradually subsided, meaning it moved downward. Later, the same general area began to rise.
paras.zh: 卫星测量结果揭示了 2018 年至 2024 年间的一个有趣的模式。在研究的第一部分中，马萨亚火山口内的地面逐渐下沉，这意味着它向下移动。后来，同样的面积开始上升。

paras.en: Scientists believe this transition could reflect changes in the amount of magma stored underground. When magma drains away from a reservoir, the overlying ground can sink. When additional magma enters and increases pressure within a reservoir, the surface may rise.
paras.zh: 科学家认为，这种转变可能反映了地下储存的岩浆量的变化。当岩浆从水库中排出时，上面的地面就会下沉。当额外的岩浆进入并增加储层内的压力时，地表可能会上升。

paras.en: The most surprising finding was that the area surrounding Santiago crater did not follow the same pattern. Instead, it continued to sink throughout the six-year study, even as the broader caldera began rising.
paras.zh: 最令人惊讶的发现是圣地亚哥陨石坑周围的区域并没有遵循相同的模式。相反，在整个六年的研究中，即使更广泛的火山口开始上升，它仍然继续下沉。

paras.en: "When it's subsiding, that means that there's probably magma draining away from the volcano, but once the ground starts uplifting again, that can mean that there's potentially new magma moving in," Johnson said. "At the same time, the area directly around the active Santiago crater deflated over the entire study period independently of the transition to inflation of the main reservoir. This indicates that the plumbing system is more complex and could be due to decreasing magma in a second, shallower reservoir."
paras.zh: “当它下沉时，这意味着可能有岩浆从火山中流失，但一旦地面再次开始隆起，这可能意味着可能有新的岩浆进入，”约翰逊说。 “与此同时，在整个研究期间，圣地亚哥活动火山口直接周围的区域都在收缩，与主储层向膨胀的过渡无关。这表明管道系统更加复杂，可能是由于第二个较浅的储层中岩浆减少所致。”

paras.en: Together, these observations suggest that Masaya may have at least two distinct parts of its magma storage system undergoing different changes. A deeper source could be supplying additional magma to the main reservoir, while a shallower reservoir near Santiago crater may be losing magma.
paras.zh: 总之，这些观察结果表明，马萨亚的岩浆储存系统可能至少有两个不同的部分正在经历不同的变化。较深的源头可能会向主储层提供额外的岩浆，而圣地亚哥陨石坑附近较浅的储层可能会失去岩浆。

paras.en: This would help explain why different sections of the same volcano moved in opposite directions.
paras.zh: 这将有助于解释为什么同一座火山的不同部分向相反的方向移动。

paras.en: What the Discovery Means for Future Eruptions
paras.zh: 这一发现对未来的火山喷发意味着什么

paras.en: Understanding these underground movements is important because changes in the ground can provide clues about where magma is accumulating, where it is moving, and how it might eventually reach the surface.
paras.zh: 了解这些地下运动非常重要，因为地面的变化可以提供有关岩浆在哪里积聚、在哪里移动以及最终如何到达地表的线索。

paras.en: The researchers emphasized that their observations did not reveal any immediate danger to communities surrounding Masaya. However, identifying the volcano's normal behavior and understanding its magma supply system could make it easier to recognize unusual changes in the future.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，他们的观察结果并未显示马萨亚周围社区面临任何直接危险。然而，识别火山的正常行为并了解其岩浆供应系统可以更容易地识别未来的异常变化。

paras.en: Continued satellite observations, combined with more detailed computer models, could also help scientists better understand the connections between underground magma reservoirs and volcanic activity at the surface.
paras.zh: 持续的卫星观测与更详细的计算机模型相结合，还可以帮助科学家更好地了解地下岩浆库与地表火山活动之间的联系。

paras.en: "Further long-term geodetic and modeling studies will provide a more thorough understanding and allow for effective hazard monitoring and mitigation at Masaya and other lava-lake hosting basaltic volcanoes," Johnson said.
paras.zh: 约翰逊说：“进一步的长期大地测量和建模研究将提供更全面的了解，并有助于对马萨亚和其他玄武岩火山熔岩湖进行有效的灾害监测和缓解。”

paras.en: The findings may therefore have implications beyond Nicaragua, particularly for other active volcanoes that contain persistent lava lakes and complex underground magma systems.
paras.zh: 因此，这些发现可能对尼加拉瓜以外的地区产生影响，特别是对于其他含有持续熔岩湖和复杂地下岩浆系统的活火山。

paras.en: From Undergraduate Research to Volcano Science
paras.zh: 从本科研究到火山科学

paras.en: Johnson became involved in the project after attending a presentation by Christelle Wauthier, a Penn State professor of geosciences and computational sciences hub director at the university's Institute for Computational and Data Sciences.
paras.zh: 约翰逊在参加了宾夕法尼亚州立大学计算和数据科学研究所地球科学和计算科学中心主任 Christelle Wauthier 教授的演讲后参与了该项目。

paras.en: She completed the research as part of her Schreyer's Honors College thesis, working alongside graduate researchers, including Kim, to analyze satellite measurements and develop her scientific skills.
paras.zh: 她完成了这项研究，作为施赖尔荣誉学院论文的一部分，与包括 Kim 在内的研究生研究人员合作，分析卫星测量结果并培养她的科学技能。

paras.en: "I appreciated learning how a research group works," said Johnson, who has recently started a doctoral program in Earth sciences at the University of Hawaii at Manoa, where she will continue studying volcanoes using seismic waves to image below the surface of Kilauea volcano. "I had never had any experience with research, so it was great to be able to join in the group meetings and get to hear about everybody's work. And learning coding was also useful as I continue with my Ph.D."
paras.zh: “我很高兴了解研究小组的工作方式，”约翰逊说，她最近在夏威夷大学马诺阿分校开始了地球科学博士课程，在那里她将继续使用地震波对基拉韦厄火山表面下方进行成像来研究火山。 “我从未有过任何研究经验，因此能够参加小组会议并了解每个人的工作真是太好了。在我继续攻读博士学位时，学习编码也很有用。”

paras.en: The research received support from the U.S. National Science Foundation through awards 1945417 and 2523375, along with computational resources provided by Penn State's Institute for Computational and Data Sciences. The authors are solely responsible for the findings and conclusions, which do not necessarily represent the views of the funding organizations.
paras.zh: 该研究通过奖项 1945417 和 2523375 获得了美国国家科学基金会的支持，以及宾夕法尼亚州立大学计算和数据科学研究所提供的计算资源。作者对研究结果和结论承担全部责任，并不一定代表资助组织的观点。

paras.en: Materials provided by Penn State University. Original written by Emma Stefanacci. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由宾夕法尼亚州立大学提供。原创作者为艾玛·斯特凡纳奇。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - E. Johnson, Y. C. Kim, C. Wauthier. Double Trouble: Two Active Magma Reservoirs Identified at Masaya Volcano, Nicaragua, Using Satellite Geodesy. Geophysical Research Letters, 2026; 53 (14) DOI: 10.1029/2026GL123214
paras.zh: - E. Johnson、Y. C. Kim、C. Wauthier。双重麻烦：使用卫星大地测量学在尼加拉瓜马萨亚火山发现了两个活跃的岩浆库。地球物理研究快报，2026； 53（14）DOI：10.1029/2026GL123214

articles.title: Why some people escape Alzheimer’s despite carrying a high-risk gene

paras.en: Why some people escape Alzheimerâs despite carrying a high-risk gene
paras.zh: 为什么有些人携带高危基因却逃脱了阿尔茨海默病

paras.en: - Columbia University Irving Medical Center
paras.zh: - 哥伦比亚大学欧文医学中心

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered why some people with a high genetic risk of Alzheimerâs remain mentally sharp into their 80s, uncovering a rare mutation that protects the brain from harmful protein buildup. The findings reveal a potential new way to prevent early brain damage and could pave the way for treatments that mimic this natural defense.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了为什么一些患有阿尔茨海默氏症的高遗传风险的人到了 80 多岁仍然精神敏锐，并发现了一种罕见的突变，可以保护大脑免受有害蛋白质积聚的影响。这些发现揭示了一种预防早期脑损伤的潜在新方法，并可能为模仿这种自然防御的治疗铺平道路。

paras.en: Some people carry one of the strongest genetic risk factors for Alzheimer's disease yet never develop it, remaining mentally sharp well into their 80s. For years, scientists have wondered what protects these individuals despite their increased genetic vulnerability.
paras.zh: 有些人携带阿尔茨海默病最严重的遗传风险因素之一，但从未患上这种病，直到 80 多岁仍保持思维敏锐。多年来，科学家们一直想知道，尽管这些人的遗传脆弱性有所增加，但什么可以保护他们。

paras.en: Now, researchers at Columbia University have uncovered a biological mechanism that could help explain this remarkable resistance. Their findings point to a rare genetic mutation that protects the brain's blood vessels from damage, potentially opening a new path toward Alzheimer's treatments.
paras.zh: 现在，哥伦比亚大学的研究人员发现了一种生物机制，可以帮助解释这种显着的抵抗力。他们的发现指出了一种罕见的基因突变，可以保护大脑血管免受损伤，可能为阿尔茨海默氏症的治疗开辟一条新途径。

paras.en: The discovery builds on research the team published two years ago involving APOE ε4, a gene variant strongly associated with Alzheimer's risk. The scientists found that some people carrying APOE ε4 also possess a rare protective mutation in the fibronectin (FN1) gene.
paras.zh: 这一发现建立在该团队两年前发表的涉及 APOE ε4 的研究基础上，APOE ε4 是一种与阿尔茨海默病风险密切相关的基因变异。科学家发现，一些携带 APOE ε4 的人的纤连蛋白 (FN1) 基因也具有罕见的保护性突变。

paras.en: Fibronectin is a protein that helps support the structure of tissues. However, in people with APOE ε4, excessive amounts can accumulate around blood vessels in the brain, potentially compromising a critical protective system known as the blood-brain barrier. The rare FN1 mutation appears to limit this buildup and the damage associated with it.
paras.zh: 纤连蛋白是一种有助于支撑组织结构的蛋白质。然而，对于患有 APOE ε4 的人来说，过量的物质会积聚在大脑血管周围，可能会损害称为血脑屏障的关键保护系统。罕见的 FN1 突变似乎限制了这种积累以及与之相关的损害。

paras.en: That earlier discovery suggested an intriguing possibility: What if scientists could develop a treatment that recreates the protection provided by this rare mutation?
paras.zh: 这一早期发现提出了一个有趣的可能性：如果科学家能够开发出一种治疗方法来重现这种罕见突变所提供的保护，结果会怎样呢？

paras.en: A new study published in Nature Aging brings that possibility closer by identifying how excess fibronectin damages the brain's protective barrier and revealing potential ways to interrupt the process.
paras.zh: 发表在《自然衰老》上的一项新研究通过确定过量的纤连蛋白如何损害大脑的保护屏障并揭示中断这一过程的潜在方法，使这种可能性更接近。

paras.en: "This new study takes us from a genetic clue to a disease mechanism," says Caghan Kizil, the study's corresponding author and professor of neurological sciences in the Department of Neurology and the Taub Institute for Research on Alzheimer's Disease and the Aging Brain at Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons.
paras.zh: “这项新研究让我们从遗传线索到疾病机制，”该研究的通讯作者、哥伦比亚大学瓦杰洛斯内外科医学院神经病学系和陶布阿尔茨海默病和大脑老化研究所的神经科学教授 Caghan Kizil 说。

paras.en: "We knew that changes in fibronectin could protect against Alzheimer's, but we didn't know why excess fibronectin was harmful in the first place. This study gives us that detailed mechanism -- and with it, ideas for how to reproduce that natural protection."
paras.zh: “我们知道纤连蛋白的变化可以预防阿尔茨海默病，但我们不知道为什么过量的纤连蛋白首先是有害的。这项研究为我们提供了详细的机制 - 以及如何重现这种自然保护的想法。”

paras.en: How an Alzheimer's Risk Gene Weakens the Blood-Brain Barrier
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默病风险基因如何削弱血脑屏障

paras.en: The blood-brain barrier serves as a protective boundary between the bloodstream and the brain. Made up of tightly connected cells surrounding the brain's blood vessels, it carefully regulates which substances can enter brain tissue while helping maintain conditions necessary for removing potentially harmful waste.
paras.zh: 血脑屏障充当血流和大脑之间的保护性边界。它由大脑血管周围紧密连接的细胞组成，仔细调节哪些物质可以进入脑组织，同时帮助维持清除潜在有害废物所需的条件。

paras.en: When this barrier becomes damaged or excessively permeable, substances that would normally be kept out can enter the brain more easily. Such disruptions may contribute to inflammation and other processes involved in neurological diseases, including Alzheimer's.
paras.zh: 当这一屏障受损或渗透性过强时，通常被排除在外的物质就会更容易进入大脑。这种干扰可能会导致炎症和其他与神经系统疾病有关的过程，包括阿尔茨海默病。

paras.en: To investigate the role of fibronectin, the Columbia team combined several advanced research approaches. They examined human brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid, the clear liquid surrounding the brain and spinal cord, using genetic and epigenetic analyses to explore changes in DNA and gene activity.
paras.zh: 为了研究纤连蛋白的作用，哥伦比亚团队结合了几种先进的研究方法。他们检查了人类脑组织和脑脊液（大脑和脊髓周围的透明液体），利用遗传和表观遗传分析来探索 DNA 和基因活性的变化。

paras.en: Their investigation also included single-cell sequencing, which reveals the activity of individual cells, and spatial imaging to examine where biological changes occur within tissues. Additional experiments involved human stem-cell models, three-dimensional cultures of blood vessels, and studies in zebrafish and mice.
paras.zh: 他们的研究还包括单细胞测序（揭示单个细胞的活动）和空间成像（检查组织内发生生物变化的位置）。其他实验涉及人类干细胞模型、三维血管培养以及斑马鱼和小鼠的研究。

paras.en: Despite the variety of methods, the findings consistently pointed to the same mechanism: APOE ε4 promotes the production and accumulation of fibronectin around the brain's blood vessels.
paras.zh: 尽管方法多种多样，但研究结果一致指出了相同的机制：APOE ε4 促进大脑血管周围纤连蛋白的产生和积累。

paras.en: In mice engineered to carry human APOE ε4, researchers measured nearly twice as much fibronectin in the brain as in mice carrying APOE ε3, another common version of the gene. The greater accumulation was accompanied by evidence that the blood-brain barrier had become leaky.
paras.zh: 在携带人类 APOE ε4 的小鼠中，研究人员测量到其大脑中纤连蛋白的含量几乎是携带 APOE ε3（该基因的另一种常见版本）小鼠的两倍。更大的积累伴随着血脑屏障发生渗漏的证据。

paras.en: Scientists Discover How Fibronectin Causes Brain Damage
paras.zh: 科学家发现纤连蛋白如何导致脑损伤

paras.en: One experiment provided especially important evidence that fibronectin does more than simply accumulate in damaged blood vessels.
paras.zh: 一项实验提供了特别重要的证据，证明纤连蛋白的作用不仅仅是在受损的血管中积累。

paras.en: The researchers increased human fibronectin specifically in astrocytes, specialized support cells that help maintain the blood-brain barrier and keep the brain functioning properly.
paras.zh: 研究人员特别增加了星形胶质细胞中的人类纤连蛋白，星形胶质细胞是一种特殊的支持细胞，有助于维持血脑屏障并保持大脑正常运作。

paras.en: Increasing fibronectin in these cells was enough to disrupt the barrier, allowing it to become more permeable. Conversely, reducing fibronectin improved the barrier's ability to function normally.
paras.zh: 这些细胞中纤连蛋白的增加足以破坏屏障，使其变得更具渗透性。相反，减少纤连蛋白可以提高屏障正常发挥功能的能力。

paras.en: These results provided experimental evidence that excess fibronectin can directly contribute to blood-brain barrier damage rather than merely appearing alongside it.
paras.zh: 这些结果提供了实验证据，表明过量的纤连蛋白可以直接导致血脑屏障损伤，而不仅仅是与之并存。

paras.en: "The animal experiments allowed us to move beyond association," says co-first author Prabesh Bhattarai, an associate research scientist in the Kizil lab. "When we increased fibronectin in astroglia, the barrier became permeable. When we reduced fibronectin, barrier function improved."
paras.zh: “动物实验让我们超越了关联，”共同第一作者、克孜尔实验室的副研究科学家普拉贝什·巴特拉伊 (Prabesh Bhattarai) 说。 “当我们增加星形胶质细胞中的纤连蛋白时，屏障变得可渗透。当我们减少纤连蛋白时，屏障功能得到改善。”

paras.en: The team then investigated the molecular events responsible for the damage.
paras.zh: 研究小组随后调查了造成损害的分子事件。

paras.en: They found that excessive fibronectin interferes with communication between cells by activating abnormal signals through integrins, proteins that help cells sense and respond to their surroundings, and an enzyme known as focal adhesion kinase.
paras.zh: 他们发现，过量的纤连蛋白会通过整合素激活异常信号，从而干扰细胞之间的通讯。整合素是帮助细胞感知和响应周围环境的蛋白质，以及一种称为粘着斑激酶的酶。

paras.en: These abnormal signals disrupt a network of growth factors called VEGF, HBEGF, and IGF1. Although growth factors are often associated with cell development and repair, these particular signaling molecules also help astrocytes and blood vessel cells coordinate their activities to maintain a healthy blood-brain barrier.
paras.zh: 这些异常信号破坏了称为 VEGF、HBEGF 和 IGF1 的生长因子网络。尽管生长因子通常与细胞发育和修复有关，但这些特殊的信号分子还可以帮助星形胶质细胞和血管细胞协调其活动，以维持健康的血脑屏障。

paras.en: When their communication becomes disrupted, the barrier can lose its integrity, potentially leaving brain tissue more vulnerable to damage.
paras.zh: 当他们的沟通受到干扰时，屏障就会失去完整性，从而可能使脑组织更容易受到损害。

paras.en: "Single-cell analysis allowed us to examine this pathway in the different cells that maintain the brain's blood vessels," says co-first author Elanur Yilmaz, an associate research scientist in the Kizil lab. "We observed the same biological pattern across experimental models and human Alzheimer's tissue, making the mechanism especially compelling."
paras.zh: “单细胞分析使我们能够检查维持大脑血管的不同细胞中的这条通路，”共同第一作者、克孜尔实验室的副研究科学家 Elanur Yilmaz 说。 “我们在实验模型和人类阿尔茨海默病组织中观察到相同的生物学模式，使得该机制特别引人注目。”

paras.en: Evidence From Human Brains Strengthens the Alzheimer's Connection
paras.zh: 来自人类大脑的证据加强了阿尔茨海默氏症的联系

paras.en: Importantly, the researchers found signs of similar biological disturbances in human samples, suggesting that the process identified in laboratory experiments may also contribute to Alzheimer's disease in people carrying APOE ε4.
paras.zh: 重要的是，研究人员在人类样本中发现了类似的生物干扰迹象，这表明实验室实验中发现的过程也可能导致携带 APOE ε4 的人患阿尔茨海默病。

paras.en: Analyses of brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid showed that elevated fibronectin levels were associated with inflammation in astrocytes.
paras.zh: 对脑组织和脑脊液的分析表明，纤连蛋白水平升高与星形胶质细胞的炎症有关。

paras.en: Genetic and gene-regulation analyses also connected FN1 to blood vessel disease and changes involving VEGFA, a growth factor that plays an important role in maintaining healthy brain blood vessels.
paras.zh: 遗传和基因调控分析还将 FN1 与血管疾病和涉及 VEGFA 的变化联系起来，VEGFA 是一种生长因子，在维持健康的脑血管中发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: Together, these findings provide multiple lines of evidence linking excess fibronectin to the vascular damage associated with APOE ε4.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现提供了多种证据，证明纤连蛋白过多与 APOE ε4 相关的血管损伤有关。

paras.en: "The convergence of these independent human datasets strengthens the case that fibronectin is part of the APOE ε4-related vascular disease process," says Badri Vardarajan, associate professor of neurological science in the Department of Neurology, Gertrude H. Sergievsky Center, and Taub Institute, who collaborated on this discovery of the FN1 mutation.
paras.zh: “这些独立的人类数据集的融合强化了纤连蛋白是 APOE ε4 相关血管疾病过程的一部分的证据，”格特鲁德·谢尔吉耶夫斯基中心和 Taub 研究所神经病学系神经科学副教授 Badri Vardarajan 说，他参与了 FN1 突变的发现。

paras.en: A Rare Genetic Defense Could Inspire New Alzheimer's Treatments
paras.zh: 罕见的基因防御可能会激发新的阿尔茨海默病治疗方法

paras.en: The potential implications are significant because APOE ε4 is the strongest common genetic risk factor for Alzheimer's disease. Approximately one in five people carries at least one copy of this gene variant.
paras.zh: 潜在的影响是重大的，因为 APOE ε4 是阿尔茨海默氏病最强的常见遗传风险因素。大约五分之一的人至少携带该基因变体的一个副本。

paras.en: Although carrying APOE ε4 does not guarantee that someone will develop Alzheimer's, it increases their likelihood of developing the disease. Understanding why certain carriers remain unaffected could reveal new opportunities for prevention and treatment.
paras.zh: 虽然携带 APOE ε4 并不能保证某人一定会患上阿尔茨海默氏症，但它会增加他们患上这种疾病的可能性。了解为什么某些携带者不受影响可能会揭示预防和治疗的新机会。

paras.en: The latest findings suggest several possible approaches.
paras.zh: 最新的发现提出了几种可能的方法。

paras.en: One strategy would be to prevent harmful amounts of fibronectin from accumulating around the brain's blood vessels. Another would involve blocking the abnormal cellular signals triggered by excess fibronectin. A third possibility would be to restore the growth factor signaling that allows astrocytes and blood vessel cells to maintain the blood-brain barrier.
paras.zh: 一种策略是防止有害量的纤连蛋白在大脑血管周围积聚。另一种方法是阻断由过量纤连蛋白触发的异常细胞信号。第三种可能性是恢复允许星形胶质细胞和血管细胞维持血脑屏障的生长因子信号传导。

paras.en: Researchers are already investigating these possibilities through laboratory experiments.
paras.zh: 研究人员已经通过实验室实验研究这些可能性。

paras.en: However, translating the discovery into a treatment will require considerable care. Fibronectin performs essential functions throughout the body, including supporting tissue structure and helping damaged tissues heal. Any future therapy would therefore need to target its harmful accumulation or effects without disrupting these beneficial activities.
paras.zh: 然而，将这一发现转化为治疗方法需要相当谨慎。纤连蛋白在整个身体中发挥重要功能，包括支持组织结构和帮助受损组织愈合。因此，任何未来的治疗都需要针对其有害的积累或影响，而不破坏这些有益的活动。

paras.en: By identifying the molecular mechanisms involved, scientists now have a more precise framework for designing such treatments. The findings may also help researchers determine when interventions would be most effective and how to measure whether they are successfully protecting the brain.
paras.zh: 通过确定所涉及的分子机制，科学家们现在有了一个更精确的框架来设计此类治疗方法。这些发现还可能帮助研究人员确定干预措施何时最有效以及如何衡量干预措施是否成功保护大脑。

paras.en: "By showing how fibronectin contributes to early vascular damage, this study gives us new therapeutic targets and potential ways to measure whether treatments are working," says Richard Mayeux, chair of the Department of Neurology and a collaborator on the project. "Clinically, it connects a major genetic risk factor for Alzheimer's to an early disease process that may be possible to modify."
paras.zh: “通过展示纤连蛋白如何导致早期血管损伤，这项研究为我们提供了新的治疗靶点和衡量治疗是否有效的潜在方法，”神经病学系主任、该项目的合作者理查德·梅厄克斯（Richard Mayeux）说。 “临床上，它将阿尔茨海默氏症的一个主要遗传风险因素与可能改变的早期疾病过程联系起来。”

paras.en: Although these potential therapies remain experimental, the discovery offers a promising new direction in Alzheimer's research. Rather than focusing only on the damage that develops as the disease progresses, scientists may eventually be able to reproduce a natural genetic defense that helps protect vulnerable brains before significant damage occurs.
paras.zh: 尽管这些潜在的疗法仍处于实验阶段，但这一发现为阿尔茨海默病的研究提供了一个有希望的新方向。科学家们最终可能能够重现一种自然的基因防御，帮助在重大损害发生之前保护脆弱的大脑，而不是仅仅关注疾病进展过程中产生的损害。

paras.en: Materials provided by Columbia University Irving Medical Center. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由哥伦比亚大学欧文医学中心提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。
